rgyud sde so sor 'grel ba'i bstan bcos dang*/ rgyud sde spyir 'grel ba'i bstan bcos so// dang po la bzhi las/ dang po bya rgyud phyogs kyi rgyud 'grel gyi bstan bcos ni/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i rim par phye ba rgya cher bshad pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud kyi tshig don bshad pa la sogs pa mang du bzhugs pa rnams so// gnyis pa spyod rgyud phyogs kyi rgyud 'grel bstan bcos ni/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel bshad slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa la sogs pa rnams so// gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud phyogs kyi rgyud 'grel bstan bcos ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud de nyid bsdus pa'i rgya cher bshad pa ko sa la'i rgyan slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dang*/ de kho na nyid snang bar byed pa slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa la sogs pa rnams so// bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla med rgyud phyogs kyi rgyud 'grel bstan bcos ni/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po kye rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgya cher 'grel pa byang chub sems dpa'i rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa dang*/ dka' 'grel padma can slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa dang*/ kau mū dī sbyangs dka' zla bas mdzad pa la sogs pa rnams dang*/ bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje gur gyi dka' 'grel int+ra bhū tis mdzad pa dang*/ kha sbyor rgyud kyi 'grel pa man ngag gi snye ma zhes bya ba 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa la sogs pa rnams dang*/ bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel pa dri ma med pa'i 'od spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis mdzad pa la sogs pa rnams so// shes rab kyi rgyud dam rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud phyogs kyi rgyud 'grel la mngon brjod 'bum pa las 'byung ba nyung ngu'i rgyud kyi don rnam par bshad pa byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/

mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa gru gzings slob dpon padma rdo rjes mdzad pa la sogs pa rnams so// rnal 'byor chen po thabs rgyud phyogs kyi rgyud 'grel la gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags pa'i lugs la/ sgron ma gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i rgya cher bshad pa dang*/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa sogs dang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs pa'i lugs la/ rgyud 'grel slob ma la phan pa zhes bya ba la rab tu zhi ba'i ye shes dang bi shwa na mi tras mdzad pa la sogs pa rnams so// gnyis pa ni/ rgyud sde gong 'og de dag las mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i lhag pa'i lha mang du bstan pa rnams kyi sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang*/ smin byed dbang dang*/ grol byed lam gyi rim pa yan lag tu bcas pa zab cing rgya che ba'i tshogs dpag tu ma mchis pa bzhugs pa rnams so// 'dir smras pa/ nyi ma'i rgyud 'khrungs rgyal ba'i 'dzum sgros dang*// gsang gsum byin rlabs rjes su gnang las skyes// legs gsungs mjal ba'i rab dga' rgyas pa'i gzugs// shong ba stong gsum snod 'di e ma yangs// sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan 'dzum brgya mi bstsu zhing*// lhas rtsen go la'i khyim du mi rgyu bar// mdo sngags rgyal bstan nyin mor byed pa yis// yid srubs gnas su brnag dka'i mun pas gtibs// de mthus chos min smra ba'i sngo bsangs ma// pha mthar bgyid pa kho nas rta bdun pa'i// rjes su 'gro min mngon mtho nges legs kyi// lam kun ma bsgribs ston pa 'dis kyang ngo*// lta byed dbang po ya bral skyes bu yis// dpyad bya'i gzugs don phra zhib dpyod nus min// de bzhin dgongs 'grel med pa'i bka' gcig pus// thub pa'i dgongs don ji bzhin rtogs pa nyung*// legs par phye'o a sho ka'i 'dab ma// gong bur yur ba mtshar sdug rkang pa'i rtses// mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i lkog gyur rgyal ba'i bka'// dgongs 'grel mkhas pa'i bstan bcos phreng bas so// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/

'jug yul shes pa'i ched du bstan pa'i rnam par gzhag pa'i sarga ste dang po'o// //spyi don gnyis pa 'jug sgo shes pa'i ched du thos bsam la rim gyis slob pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ thos bsam gyi dgos pa bstan pa/ brgyud ldan gyi slob dpon bsten tshul/ thos bsam la rim par slob tshul lo// dang po ni/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs kyi bshes pa'i spring yig las/ mgo'am gos la glo bur me shor na// de dag phyir bzlog bgyi ba btang nas kyang*// yang srid med par bgyi slad 'bad 'tshal te// 'di bas ches mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis// zhes gnas skabs tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i bde don tsam bsgrub pa'i zhar byung gi tshul gyis ma yin par 'jig rten 'di'i bde 'byor snying po med pa thams cad blos bor nas/ bsgrub par bya ba'i snying po'am gtso bo ni gzhan don du srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bsgrub par bya dgos te/ de sgrub pa'i thabs ni bslab pa gsum gyi lam la ma brten par mi 'grub pa'i phyir ro// de la'ang thog mar thos bsam bsgom gsum gcig la gcig ltos kyi tshul du go rim ma log par nyams su bstar dgos te/ mgon po byams pas/ 'di na dang po thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung*/ tshul bzhin yid la byed las yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung*// de las chos thob de yod de las blo gros rab tu skye// gang tshe de na so sor rang gir med na ji ltar nges// zhes dang 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ shes rab rgyas par byed pa thos pa ste// de dang bsam pa gnyis ni yod gyur na// de las bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor// des ni dngos grub bla na med par 'gyur// zhes so// de'ang yang dag pa'i ye shes bsgom byung gi yon tan rnams rgyud la bskyed pa la/ thos pa'i don la rnam par dpyod pa'i bsam byung gi shes rab sngon du 'gro dgos so// de'i sngon du'ang sngon chad thos par ma gyur pa'i phyi dang nang gi shes bya'i gzhung lugs gong du smos pa mtha' dag gam/

bye brag tu gang la gang dgos pa'i chos rnams legs par thos dgos te/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur// thos pas sdig las ldog par 'gyur// thos pas don med spang bar 'gyur// thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob// ces dang*/ skyes rabs las/ gang zhig thos pas yid ni dad gyur nas// legs par dga' la brtan pa nyid du 'gyur// shes rab skye zhing gti mug med par 'gyur// rang gis shes kyang de ni nyo bar rigs// thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin// rkun po la sogs mi 'khyer nor gyi mchog /kun tu rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin// thabs tshul man ngag ston pas grogs kyi mchog /phongs par gyur kyang mi 'gyur mdza' bo yin// gnod pa med pa mya ngan nad kyi sman// nyes pa chen po'i dgra 'joms dpung gi mchog /grags dang dpal gyi gter gyi mchog kyang yin// ya rabs rnams dang 'phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las kyang*/ rgyal sras rnams la mi slob pa'i// dngos de 'ga' yang yod ma yin// de ltar gnas pa'i mkhas pa la// bsod nams mi 'gyur gang yang med// ces gsungs pas so// lhag par rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can gnas skabs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa rnams gang la gang 'dul gyi thabs sna tshogs pa ston pa'i sgo nas smin par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mthar thug don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ shes bya'i yul mtha' dag la mi bslab pa 'ga' yang med de/ mgon po byams pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na// 'phags pa'i mchog ste thams cad mkhyen nyid ga la thob// de ltar gzhan dag tshar gcad pa dang rjes gzung phyir// bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson bya// zhes dang*/

'jam mgon sa skya paṇḍi tas kyang*/ rang blo shes bya kun la ma sbyangs na// thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' ltar ring*// de ltar dgongs nas rgyal dang de sras kyis// shes bya'i gnas kun sbyangs zhes legs par gsungs// zhes so// des na rgyal ba'i myu gu blo dang ldan pa rnams ni shes bya rig pa'i gnas yan lag dang bcas pa mtha' dag la thos bsam gyi bslab sbyang bya dgos par gsungs so// kha cig na re de ni rgyal ba'i sras blo mchog dang ldan pa rnams kyi ngor gsungs kyi deng dus rang cag lta bu'i blo gros rtul zhing brtson 'grus shin tu dman pa'i mthar thug pa dag la ni ma yin te/ rang nyid kyis nyams su len pa dang gzhan la 'chad pa la sogs pa bsgrub pa'i nus pa phra ba'i phyir zhe na/ rang nyid kyis nyams su len pa dang gzhan la phan gdags par 'dod pa'i bsam pa sems bskyed kyis zin pa la ni bslab sbyang mi 'os pa 'ga' yang med cing thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang sgrub pa la dgos pa shin tu che mod/ de skad smra ba po des rang mtshang gzhan la ngom par zad do// ci'i phyir snyam na/ des ni dge sbyor sna re bsgrubs kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam du 'gyur ba lta zhog phan pa shin tu chung ba'i gyi na nyid du mngon te/ nges 'byung gi bsam pas gtan nas ma zin pa'i phyir ro// der gnod byed gzhan yang blun po dang zog po phal cher bslab sbyong dgos pa la ngo tsha bar byed cing*/ mkhas pa rnams ni bslab sbyangs ma byas pa la ngo tsha bar 'dzin pas kyang nang rtags phyi rol du ngom pa mngon te/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi tas/ blun po slob par ngo tsha 'dzin// mkhas rnams ma bslabs ngo tshar 'dzin// des na mkhas rnams rgas gyur kyang*// phyi ma'i don du rig pa bslab// ces dang*/ skye ba snga mar ma bslabs pa// tshe 'dir blun par mthong nas ni// phyi mar blun por skyes dogs nas// tshe 'dir dka' yang 'bad de mnyan// sgom na thos pa mi dgos zhes// blun po blo rgya chung ngur smra// thos pa med pa'i bsgom pa tsam// 'bad kyang dud 'gro'i sgrub thabs yin// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na legs par bshad pa ni byis pa'i ngag la 'dug kyang gus pas mnyan pa dgos ched khyad par can du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa brgyud ldan gyi slob dpon bsten tshul la gsum/

slob dpon bsten pa'i dgos pa/ bstan bya'i slob dpon/ de bsten pa'i tshul lo// dang po la gnyis/ byis pa blo ldan du gzhug pa'i slob dpon dang*/ blo ldan bstan pa la gzhug pa'i slob dpon no// dang po ni/ byis pa las dang po pa blo dang ldan pa'i go sar bkri bar byed pa'i thabs ni yon tan thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa yi ge'i klog la shin tu byang chub par byed dgos na'ang*/ de ni slob dpon gyi ngag la ma ltos par rang stobs kyis mkhas par mi 'gyur te/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi tas/ byis pa 'jug sgo'i 'grel par/ byis pa blo gsal ba dag gis slob dpon gyi thad du phyin la me tog phul te tshig 'di skad kyis gsol ba gdab bo// mkhan po gson cig yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur cing*// gsal zhing rdzogs par rab phye la// tshul bzhin brjod na don 'gyur ba'i// klog gi cho ga bdag zhu'o// zhes brjod/ des kyang 'di skad du/ bu gang zhig shes na don 'gyur zhing*// mkhas par gyur na ngo mtshar che// nga yis ji ltar bstan pa bzhin// bsgrub par 'dod na rjes su gzung*// zhes gsal zhing zur phyin par tshig smra'o// des kyang de bzhin bgyi'o zhes brjod do// mkhan pos kyang de ltar legs so zhes smras nas rjes su gzung ba'i tshul sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de ltar dgos pa'ang rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos/ gang gis yi ge'i bye brag dang*// dbye bsdu 'byung gnas mi shes par// sgra klog brjod par mkhas ma yin// don yang rnam par 'khrul par 'gyur// zhes yi ge'i bye brag dang*/ dbye bsdu dang*/ sgra'i 'byin thabs rnams ma 'khrul zhing zur phyin pa legs par shes dgos so zhes gsungs mod kyi/ de dag slob dpon mkhas pa zhig med par rang dgar zhugs pas shes par mi 'gyur zhing ngal ba snying pos dben pa'i phyir ro// des na de la mkhas par bya ba la bdun te/

ngo bo gzung dang byed las dang*// nges tshig dbye bsdu rgyu klog tshul// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po ni/ yi ge'i ngo bo skad kyi gdangs 'ba' zhig ste/ rnam 'grel las/ yi ge kun slong shes pa las// skye la shes pas sgra skye'o// zhes so// gnyis pa yi ge'i gzugs ni/ de'i rnam par dbye ba mdo rgya cher rol pa las/ tshangs pa'i yi ge kha roṣṭā'i yi ge padma'i snying po'i yi ge aṅga'i yi ge baṅga'i yi ge ma ga dha'i yi ge bkra shis pa'i yi ge sor gdub kyi yi ge sa kā nī'i yi ge sā dha nī'i yi ge ā hu'i yi ge rtsub mo'i yi ge 'gro lding ba'i yi ge mon yul gyi yi ge lho phyogs pa'i yi ge drag po'i yi ge grangs kyi yi ge spyi'u tshugs kyi yi ge rjes su mthun pa'i yi ge dha ra da'i yi ge khyā sya'i yi ge rgya nag gi yi ge hū na'i yi ge dbus kyi yi ge rgyal gyi yi ge lha'i yi ge klu'i yi ge gnod sbyin gyi yi ge dri za'i yi ge mi'am ci'i yi ge lto 'phye chen po'i yi ge lha ma yin gyi yi ge nam mkha' lding gi yi ge ri dwags 'khor lo'i yi ge bya rog skad kyi yi ge sa lha'i yi ge bar snang gi lha'i yi ge nub ba lang spyod kyi yi ge byang sgra mi snyan gyi yi ge shar lus 'phags po'i yi ge 'degs pa'i yi ge gzhag pa'i yi ge rab tu gzhag pa'i yi ge rgya mtsho'i yi ge rdo rje'i yi ge 'phrin yig rab tu spring ba'i yi ge rnam par gzhag pa'i yi ge chung ngu ma yin pa'i yi ge bstan bcos bskor ba'i yi ge rtsis bskor ba'i yi ge 'degs pa bskor ba'i yi ge rkang pas bris pa'i yi ge tshig phyi ma gnyis grub pa'i yi ge ji srid tshig phyi ma bcu grub pa'i yi ge bar ma sgrub pa'i yi ge sgra thams cad kun du sdud pa'i yi ge rig pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i yi ge rnam par bsres pa'i yi ge drang srong dka' thub kyis gdungs pa'i yi ge gsal ba'i yi ge

sa rab tu lta ba'i yi ge sman thams cad kyi rgyu mthun pa'i yi ge snying po thams cad kun bsdus pa'i yi ge ste yi ge drug cu rtsa bzhir gsungs pa de dag tshang ba bod du ma byung yang da ltar dar srol yod pa tshangs pa'i yi ge lāñtsa na dang*/ de dang cha mthun pa dha ri ka'i yi ge de'i mgo gyen du bzed pa na ga ra'i yi ge mi 'dra ba rnams dang*/ de'i mgo thur du bkug pa klu'i yi ge wartu la dang*/ 'dra min shes che ba kasmi ra'i yig rigs mi 'dra ba gsum tsam dang*/ gzhan yang gau ḍa'i yi ge dang*/ gha hu ra'i yi ge dang*/ sindhū'i yi ge dang*/ go la'i yi ge dang*/ ma ga dha'i yi ge dang*/ ka ma ta dang*/ pukkaṃ dang*/ rgya mtsho mtha'i yi ge dang*/ sindha ka ra srin po'i yi ge rnams 'dri klog gi srol mchis pa ste/ de rnams la dbyangs yig bcu drug gsal byed la ka la sogs pa'i sde pa lnga/ mthar gnas bzhi dang dro ba bzhi dang kṣa yig ste sum cu rtsa bzhi'o// gzhan yang rgya dang hor gyi yi ge dang*/ bod kyi yi ge la slob dpon thu mi sambho ṭas mdzad pa'i gzhung sum cu pa las/ ā li gsal byed i sogs bzhi// kā li sum cu tham pa'o// zhes dang*/ sa paṇa gyis yi ge'i sbyor ba las kyang de dang mthun par gsungs pas dbyangs yig la i u e o bzhi dang*/ gsal byed la ka la sogs pa sum cur bzhed la/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos ka nas ha'i bar gyi nyer dgu ni pha'i yi ge dang*/ a yig ni ma'i yi ge ste pha ma sum cu zhes bzhed do// gsum pa byed pa ni/ thu mi sambho ṭas/ bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing*// rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu// ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi// yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya// zhes tshul khrims la sogs pa'i bslab pa kun gyi gzhi'ang yi ge la rag las pa dang*/ nges brjod la sogs pa'i rig byed rnams dang*/ sgra dang tshad ma la sogs pa rig pa'i gnas lnga yan lag dang bcas pa smra ba'i rgyu yang yi ge yin pa dang*/

ming dang tshig tu brjod pa kun gyi gzhi yang yi ge yin pas yi ge'i byed las zhes bya ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ yi ge'i skad dod la a kṣa ra zhes pa mi 'gyur ba'i don to// yul tha dad pa'i skad la 'gyur ba yod kyang dbyangs dang gsal byed mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ byañdza na zhes pa gsal byed de ming tshig brjod pa gsal bar byed pa'i phyir/ warṇaṇa zhes pa nus pa dang ldan pa ste/ rjod par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de'ang ji skad du/ mi 'gyur ba dang gsal byed dang*// rjod par byed pa'i nus ldan phyir// yi ge zhes ni brjod pa yin// zhes gsungs pas so// lnga pa dbye bsdu la/ ka lā pa las bcu bzhi rnams dbyangs so zhes dang*/ ka la sogs pa rnams gsal byed do zhes dbyangs rnams bcu bzhi dang gsal byed sum cu rtsa bdun rnams yin no// dbyangs yig kyang bsdu na/ mtshungs pa dang mtshungs pa ma yin pa dang*/ nā min dang nā min ma yin pa gnyis sam/ mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge dang mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge ma yin pa gnyis rnams su 'du'o// gsal byed la'ang sde pa yin min gnyis/ sgra ldan sgra med gnyis su 'du'o// tsand+ra pa las kyang*/ a i uṇa/ ṛ l̥k e o/ ai auts/ ha ya wa ra la ṇa/ nya ma da ṇa nam/ dzña bha ny/ gha ḍha dha ṣ/ dza ba ga ḍa da sh kha ba tsha ṭha tha tsa ṭa tab/ ka pa y/ sha ṣa sar/ hal/ zhes pa'o// de dag gi ngos 'dzin ni/ dharm+ma dā pas/ gcig las gyur pa ṇa nga nya ba rnams// gnyis las ṇa ṣa bzhi las ka tsa dag /lnga las ra sha ma ya rnams shes bya// drug las la ni bsgrub par bya ba yin// zhes gsungs pa'i bar gyi yi ge rnams go bar bya ba'i ched du'o// de'i dbye ba la a a u ṛ bzhi la thung ngu ring po shin tu ring po ste gsum gsum/ de dag re re la'ang tsand+ra go mis yi ge'i mdo las/ mthon po rnams kyis u dātta// dma' bas a nu dātta'o// de dag bar ma swa ri ta'o// zhes skad gdangs mtho dma' bar ma gsum gsum ste sum cu so drug

de rnams la sna ldan dang sna med so drug re ste bsdoms pas bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ mtshams sbyor yi ge bzhi la thung ba med pas ring po dang shin tu ring po gnyis/ l̥ la ring po med pas thung ngu dang shin tu ring po gnyis/ de dag lnga po re re la'ang skad gdangs mtho dman bar ma gsum gsum du phye bas sum cu/ de rnams la sna ldan dang sna med sum cu re bsdoms pas drug cu ste/ gong gi de dag bsdoms pas dbyangs la brgya so gnyis/ gsal byed la sum cu so gsum yod pa las/ ka gcig pu la yang dbyangs brgya sum cu so gnyis bzhugs te/ bsdoms pa gsal byed bzhi stong sum brgya nga drug yod do// bod kyi yi ge'i dbye bsdu la/ sa skya paṇḍi tas/ dbyangs dang gsal byed gnyis ka'i rtsa ba a'o// de las dbyangs rnams 'byung ba na i u gnyis 'byung*/ de dag sbyar ba las e o ṛ l̥ bzhi 'byung bas bdun no// yang de las gsal byed rnams 'byung ba na/ a las ka tsa ṭa ta pa ha ste drug 'byung bas rtsa ba'i phyi mo bcu gsum mo// rtsa ba de dag las dbyangs bcu drug dang gsal byed kyi gtso bo bco brgyad 'byung ba'i tshul ni dbyangs thung ngu bdun las ring po bdun 'byung bas bcu bzhi/ sna ldan nam nga ro dang rnam par gcad pa gnyis 'grub pas bcu drug go /gsal byed drug po'i steng du i las ya dang*/ u las wa/ ṛ l̥ las ra dang la/ aḥtsheg drag can las sha ṣa sa/ aṃ nga ro can dang mthun pa nga nya ṇa na ma lnga'o// de dag las gsal byed kyi nying lag sum cu rtsa gsum 'byung ba'i tshul ni/ kha la sogs pa gnyis pa rnams ni ka la sogs pa dang po rnams dang khong nas 'byung ba'i sgra sbyar ba'am/ ga la sogs pa gsum pa rnams ni ka la sogs pa dang po rnams dang a'i sgra sbyar ba'o// gha la sogs pa bzhi pa rnams ni ga la sogs pa gsum pa rnams dang ha'i sgra sbyar ba'o// de dag phan tshun sbyar ba las lo 'dab dang 'dra ba'i yi ge du mar 'gyur ba yin no// slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos/

bod kyi yi ge sum cu bdun// sgra yi pha ma sum cur 'dus// srog rkyen yan lag yi ge bdun// de dag a yi khongs su 'du// zhes yi ge sum cu po de yang bsdu na dbyangs a dang gsal byed nyer dgu po sgra'i pha ma gnyis su 'du zhing*/ yongs su grags pa'i a ni rang nyid kyis brjod bya rjod byed du rung bas gzhan gyi grogs mi dgos pa'i phyir seng ge lta bu'i a zhes bya'o// de'i dbye ba tshig dang kyog dang shad dang yan lag i u e o bzhi ste/ bdun po ji ltar bsdu zhe na/ a'i dbye ba brgyad las/ dang po tsheg nyid srog gi a de'i ngo bo yin no// de rgya gar la don gyis ston pas mi dgos kyang bod kyi yi ge'i bar du gsal bar byed pa ste/ de nyid las/ rang nyid brjod par mi nus te// thig le chen po yi ge med// yi ge kun la 'jug pa'i phyir// thig le stong pa yi ge brgya// de nyid bod kyis gsal bar byed// ces gsungs pas ngag tu brjod pa med kyang bar gyi sa mtshams gsal bar byed pa la de nyid rag las pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du dang por 'jug pa'i dang kyog dang tha mar 'jug pa'i shad gnyis ni rkyen gyi yi ge ste/ de'ang dang po ni glang po'i sna lta bu'i a dang*/ phyi ma ni rnam par gcod pa'i a zhes bya'o// i u e o bzhi ni ka la sogs pa'i lus rnams kyi yan lag tu 'gyur ba'i phyir yan lag gi yi ge zhes tha snyad du byas pa'o// drug pa rgyu brjod pa la/ slob dpon tsand+ra go mis/ gnas dang byed pa dang rtsol ba rnams las yi ge rnams skye'o zhes dang*/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos/ khog pa mgrin pa rkan dang lce// sna dang spyi bo so dang mchu// so so'am ni 'dus pa las// sgra rnams thams cad 'byung bar bshad// ces gsungs pas/ a ku ha ྈka mgrin pa las// i tsu ya sha rkan las byung*// ita eta ota rnams mgrin rkan las// ṛ ṭu ra ṣa spyi bo las// l̥ tu la sa so las 'byung*// u pu nypa rnams mchu dag las// uta ota auta rnams mchu mgrin las// wa yig mchu dang so las byung*// rjes su nga ro sna las te// sna dang rang gi gnas las kyang*// sde pa'i lnga pa rnams 'byung ngo*// zhes pa ltar ro// byed pa ni/

byed pa lce yi rtsa ba ni// lce rtsa can gyi yin par bshad// sogs so// bdun pa klog tshul ni/ thung ngu phyi mo gcig pa ste// ring po phyi mo gnyis pa'o// plu ta phyi mo gsum pa yin// zhes gcig gi yun dang gnyis dang gsum gyi yun klog pa sogs rgya bod kyi yig klog rnams zhib par slob dpon mkhas pa'i ngag dang sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis gsal bar bshad pa ltar shes par bya ba las 'dir yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas ma bris so// gnyis pa ni/ blo dang ldan pa bstan pa la 'jug pa la dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam slob dpon bsten pa la rag las te/ slob dpon sogs la ma bsten par rang nyid kyis dpe tsam la brten nas chos kyi tshig don zab mo khong du chud par mi 'gyur zhing*/ brgya lam dpe la bltas pas don go ba tsam byung yang brgyud pa med par rang rdol du byung ba'i chos kyis phan 'dogs mi 'byung bar ma zad mkhas pa'i mdun sar rang nyid ngo tsha ba'i rgyu ste/ de nyid las/ g.yar ba'i rgyan dang brkus pa'i nor// slob dpon med pa'i rig pa rnams// yod kyang gzhan gyis brtsi ba med// ces dang*/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa 'di// thams cad mkhyen pa'i khyad chos yin// ma bslabs pa la kun mkhyen du// 'gro na rgyu 'bras ga la bden// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na legs par 'dod pa'i blo gros can rnams kyis gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas skabs thams cad du bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa ni legs pa'i yon tan thams cad rim gyis 'phel ba'i gzhi yin par shes pa'i ched du/ bshes spring las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa tshangs par spyod// yongs su rdzogs par thub pas gsungs de'i phyir// skyes bu dam pa bsten bgyi rgyal ba la// brten nas rab tu mang pos zhi ba thob// ces dang*/ shes phyin sdud pa las/ bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu bsten par bya// ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la gnyis/

dge ba'i bshes sam bla ma'am slob dpon zhes bya ba ste de'i mtshan nyid dang*/ sgra don gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba// yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs la smra mkhas ldan// brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la brten// zhes rang bzhin gyis rgyud 'jam pas zhi ba/ bslab pa gsum gyis rgyud legs par sbyangs pas nye bar zhi ba/ mang du thos pa'i lung gi yon tan dang*/ de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa/ dam pa'i chos dang sems can gyi don sgrub pa la gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ lung don rigs pas 'byed par nus pa'i rnam par dpyod pa dang ldan pa/ bshad bya'i chos kyi tshul de gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham par go bde zhing rna bar snyan par smra mkhas pa/ rnyed bkur sogs la ma ltos par sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du smra ba'i bdag nyid can de lta bu'i bla ma dam pa de nyid skyo ba med pas bsten par bya ste yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni dam pa'i chos 'dul ba las rab tu 'byin par byed pa la mkhan po zhes bya ste/ de'ang nyer bsgyur u pa dang a dhi sngon ma'i ing klog pa'i dbyings la gha nya'i rkyen byin pas u pa dhya ya zhes pa mkhan po ste/ bslab pa rnams nye bar klog pa'am nye bar lung 'bogs pas sam klog tu 'jug pa'i phyir de skad ces bya'o// yang na ka lyā ṇa mi tra zhes pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen te dge ba la spyod pa'i grogs skyes bu dam pa yin pa'i phyir/ yang na nyer bsgyur āng sngon ma'i tsar 'gro ba'i dbyings la ghyaṇa rkyen byin pas/ ā tsāryāḥzhes pa slob dpon te/ slob ma la kun du spyod pa rnams ston pa'i phyir/ yang na gu ru zhes pa gong ma dang bla ma dang lci ba dang mchog rnams la 'jug ste rang gi gong ma'am bla ma'i mchog tu bkur bar 'os pa'i yul yin pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa la gnyis/

bsam pa'i sgo nas bsten pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i sgo nas bsten pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ thos bsam don du gnyer ba'i slob ma ni dad pa dang ldan pa zhig ste/ de med na seng ge'i 'o ma snod phal par mi chags pa ltar chos kyi snod min te/ chos bcu pa'i mdo las/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la// dkar po'i chos rnams mi skye ste// sa bon me yis tshig pa la// myu gu sngon mo ji bzhin no// zhes gsungs pas so// dad pa de'ang ji lta bu zhig la bya snyam pa/ chos mngon pa las/ dad pa gang zhe na/ las dang 'bras bu dang bden pa dang dkon mchog la mngon par yid ches pa dang 'dod pa dang sems dang ba'o zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// des na chos mnyan pa la dad pa nyid gtso che ste/ dkon mchog ta la'i gzungs las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste// yon tan thams cad 'byung zhing 'phel bar byed// dogs pa sel zhing chu bo rnams las sgrol// dad pa bde ba'i grong khyer mtshon par byed// dad pa rnyog pa med cing sems dang byed// nga rgyal spong zhing gus pa'i rtsa ba yin// dad pa nor dang gter dang rkang pa'i mchog /lag pa bzhin du dge sdud rtsa ba yin// zhes gsungs so// de'ang chos smra ba la gus pa bya ba'i tshul yang*/ 'dul ba las/ lhan cig gnas pa dang nye gnas kyis mkhan po dang slob dpon la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o zhes gsungs shing*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung lugs las/ bla ma la sangs rgyas lta bur blta bar gsungs te/ 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa la ji ltar gus par bya ba de bzhin du/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la'ang bsten par bya'o zhes gsungs kyi/ der sangs rgyas dngos su blta bar gsungs pa med la/ gsang sngags pas dbang bskur thob phyin chad nas/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos nyid du blta bar bya ba ste/ 'dus pa'i rgyud las/

dbang bskur ba'i rdo rje slob dpon la ji ltar blta bar bgyi zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// yan lag byang chub sems dpa' ste// ba spu rnams ni dgra bcom nyid// spyi gtsug rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas nyid// 'jig rten pa ni zhabs kyis mnan// 'od zer gnod sbyin gsang ba la'o// rnal 'byor can gyis rtag tu brtag /ces dang*/ gzhan yang rdo rje gur dang*/ bde mchog rdo rje phreng ba/ bla ma lnga bcu pa sogs las rgya cher gsungs so// des na dbang bskur nas sngags kyi sdom pas ma sbrel na/ bla ma de bzang zhing grub thob yin na'ang pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs ltar rim gyis 'bras bu 'grub pa'i rgyu byed pa tsam las ma 'das te/ dbang ma bskur ba'i bla ma de sangs rgyas dngos su blta bar ma bshad pa'i phyir/ dper na rab byung ma thob pa'i btsun pa de la mkhan po'i tha snyad med pa dang*/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur ma thob pa la gsang sngags kyi bla ma'i tha snyad yod pa mi srid de/ des na sngags kyi bla ma min pa la gsol ba btab kyang gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu tsam mam/ yang na de'i steng du rim gyis sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur mod kyi/ tshe 'di'am bar do sogs su sangs rgyas nyid 'byin par mi nus te/ der bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor bsams nas gsol ba 'debs pa gsungs pa'i phyir/ de skad du'ang sa skya paṇḍi tas/ nyan thos rnams kyi bla ma de// bzang yang gang zag kho nar bas// pha rol phyin pa'i bla ma ni// bzang na dge 'dun dkon mchog yin// gsang sngags pa yi bla ma mchog /dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med yin// des na de la gsol btab pas// dkon mchog gsum po tshe 'dir 'grub// ces gsungs so// de la'ang chos smra ba de skyon bral yon tan kun dang ldan pa zhig mthong dgos pa la/ rtsod ldan dbang gis bla ma skyon dang yon tan 'dres// zhes pa ltar rang re las dang nyon mongs pas bsgribs shing skal ba dman pa'i gdul bya'i snang ngor bla ma la skyon dang yon tan 'dres mar rtogs par 'gyur mod/

rang rgyud las dang nyon mongs pa stug pos bsgribs pa'i mthus de ltar du snang ba yin snyam du shes dgos te/ ba tsha chu klung gi mdo las/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na// nga nyid slob dpon gzugs kyis gnas// nga yin snyam du yid byos la// de tshe de la gus pa skyed// ces gsungs pa sogs kyis skyon rtog gi blo de dgag par bya ste/ de bkag pas yon tan kun dang ldan pa zhig shugs kyis rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// dpe dang gtan tshigs gzhan yang*/ slob dpon thogs med kyis rje btsun byams pa spyi bor bzhag nas bstan pas sus kyang ma mthong bar rgan mo sdig pa cung zad bsrabs pa zhig gis khyi mor mthong ba dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis 'phags pa 'jam dpal khyim btsun chos gos kyis thod byas nas zhing rmod pa la sogs pa mthong ba dang*/ nā ro ta pas tai lo pa nya gson por sreg par mthong ba sogs kyang log lta ma byas pa'i 'bras bu ji ltar 'byung ba rnams kyis nges shes bskyed dgos par sems so// gnyis pa ni/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ 'dir mang smos pa ci zhig dgos// bla ma dgyes byed gang yin bya// mi mnyes byed kun spang ba ni// de dang de la 'bad de brtag /ces bla ma ston par gyur pa gang yin pa de mnyes pa'i bya ba byed cing mi mnyes pa'i bya ba ni rnam pa thams cad du spang ba'i sgo nas bsten par bya ste/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pas tshigs su bcad pa re thos pa'i ched du lus dang longs spyod rnams kyang zhen pa med par btang ba dang*/ nā ro pas tai lo pa mnyes pa'i bya ba bsgrub pa la sogs pa rnams kyang bsams kyin yid ches bskyed do// 'on te deng sang bstan pa nyams dmas shing*/ chos la gal chung byed pa'i dus 'dir bla ma chos smra ba'i phyir lus srog la ltos pa med pa'i dka' spyad de lta bu las dang po pas dngos su bsgrub nus pa gyur na/ sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa'i rjes su snyeg pa'i phyir rab tu gyur mod/

ma nus pa rnams kyang rim gyis bslab 'gyur gyi yul du byas nas/ las dang po pas da ltar dngos su bsgrub nus pa don yod rnam pa bzhi ste/ de'ang lus don yod pa'i phyir phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bskor ba byed pa dang*/ mnyes pa'i las bsgrub/ ngag don yod pa'i phyir bla ma'i yon tan brjod pa dang*/ bstod pa 'don pa dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs pa bya/ yid don yod pa'i phyir bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus bsgom zhing*/ skyon gyi rtog pa thams cad spangs nas mdzad spyod thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mdzad par blta/ longs spyod don yod pa'i phyir bdog pa thams cad kyi phud nas mchod pa'i yod byad dang maṇḍal du byas nas 'bul ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas bla ma mnyes par bya ste/ de mnyes pas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byas par 'gro ba'ang*/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ de bas thabs ni thams cad du// rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma mchog /rjes su mthun pas mnyes par bya// de mnyes sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes// zhes dang*/ sdom pa 'byung ba las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs te// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i// ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur// bla med mdzad pa'i slob dpon ni// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod na// de yis bsod nams ma byas shing*// dka' thub ma bsten ci zhig yod// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de lta bu'i tshul gyis bla ma mnyes pa'i zhal las chos nyan pa sogs kyi tshe/ chos kyi tshig don la yid mi gtod pa dang*/ dran shes kyis mi 'dzin pa dang*/ nga rgyal la sogs pa snod kyi skyon thams cad spangs nas gus pa'i ri mor bcas pas mnyan dgos te/ skyes pa'i rabs las/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni skyed par byed// dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta// tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin// rab tu dang la dri med blos// nad pas sman pa'i ngag nyan bzhin// ri mor byas te chos nyon cig

/ces gsungs pas kun spyod dang gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas bstan pa'i rgyun la phan par dgongs pa rnams kyis legs par mnyan dgos par sems so// 'dir smras pa/ gnyis med gsung ba sras dang bcas pa yis// legs gsungs bdud rtsis nyal ba'i dal 'byor rten// 'di phyi gtan 'dun grub pa'i skal ba can// lhar bcas skye dgu'i phyag 'os bla na med// srid zhi'i dngos po mtha' dag rjod byed kyi// lam nas bde bar 'dren byed yi ge nas// nyer brtsams gtsug lag rig pa'i ngo mtshar gzugs// snang byed mkhas pa'i me long gang byon dang*// rgyal bstan brjod byar gyur pa'i so sor thar// byang chub sems bskyed sdom pa zung gi rgyun// 'bogs pa'i byed po dge ba'i bshes kyi drin// gzugs can zhig na srid pas ci ste theg /ring min phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos// 'grub byed sngags kyi sdom pas skal ba bzang*// sku bzhi'i sa bon 'jog pa'i slob dpon de// dkon mchog gsum las logs shig dmigs su ci// e ma skyabs mchog yid bzhin nor bu rnams// deng nas byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar// 'bral med gtsug gi rgyan du mnyam 'grogs par// nyin mtshan gsol 'debs gser gyi skud pas btsems// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ 'jug sgo shes pa'i ched du thos bsam la rim gyis slob pa'i tshul gyi sarga ste gnyis pa'o// //spyi don gsum pa thos don yid ches ched du chos kyi brgyud rim bstan pa la gnyis/ bstan pa'i 'jug sgo so thar gyi sdom par gnas pa'i chos kyi brgyud rim/ sdom par gnas pas thos bsam ji ltar byas pa'i chos kyi brgyud rim mo// dang po ni/ chos mngon pa mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas// bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyar// zhes dang*/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo las/

shin tu legs par tshul khrims gang*// sdom pa'i mi de mdzes pa'i gzugs// 'dul ba la ni nye bar gnas// tshul khrims bslab pa rang yid ches// mi de nyi ma gcig la yang*// bsod nams phung po dpag tu med// gsog cig sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'grub// ces dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyis kyang*/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags pa gsungs// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi gzhi tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la gnas pa ste thos bsam sgom gsum gyi dge ba gang dag bsags pa thams cad byang chub chen po'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i phan yon yod pa rjes su thos pa'i 'grogs bshes dag gis khrid de/ rang lo bcu gcig tu son par 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma'i rgyun chen po dal gyis gzhol phyogs su gya gyur bgrod pa'i 'gram ngogs yin pas ldan yul zhes grags pa ga la ba der/ dpal sa skya'i lha khang bla brang gi gdung brgyud dri ma med pa mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu la dbang 'byor ba 'jam dpal dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhabs kyis bcags shing legs par bskrun pa'i dgon sde sa dkar bsam 'grub gling zhes btags pa/ de nas brtsams te lha rigs bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' blo gros pa dang*/ de'i sku dbon mthu stobs dbang phyug kun dga' bsod nams pa zung gis phebs shing gdan sar mdzad de chos srid zung 'brel gyi phrin las gser gyi 'khor los mdo khams kyi ljongs chen por dbang sgyur bar mdzad pa'i sa'i thig le de nyid du/ mkhar dkar dmar zhes pa'i bla brang khag gnyis byung ba'i mkhar dmar po'i bdag po drung pa kun dga' rgya mtsho zhes pa skar nag rtsis dang gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs la shin tu mkhas shing*/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang*/

mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa dang*/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang shes bya bzang po la sogs pa las sdom pa gsum gyi bka' lung zab cing rgya che ba thob cing*/ de dag gi bslab bya rnams la gces spras su mdzad pa de nyid kyi drung du skra phud phul bas/ tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phog ste/ kun dga' bsod nams zhes ming du gdags pa bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'og tu tshigs gsum rim nos kyi bstan pa la rim gyis slob pa'i skabs su dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa yang bskyar du thob pa'i brgyud par bsdoms pa las 'dir zur pa ma dgos so// gnyis pa sdom par gnas pas thos bsam ji ltar byas pa'i brgyud rim la gnyis te/ thun mong ba phyi rig pa'i gnas thos pa'i brgyud rim dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa nang rig pa'i gnas thos pa'i brgyud rim gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na// 'phags mchog ci sems thams cad mkhyen pa thob mi 'gyur// de bas gzhan dag tshar gcad pa dang rjes gzung phyir// bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed// ces gsungs pa'i go rim dang mthun par mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo las kyang*/ de yul brda sprod rtog ge dang*// gso ba phyi nang rig ces gsungs// gzhan la gzhan dag rnam bshad pa// 'di yi nang du 'dus shes bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ log rtog tshar gcod pa brda sprod rig pa sgra dang*/ rtog ge rig pa tshad ma dang*/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa gso ba rig pa tshe'i rig byed dang*/ phyi rol rig pa bzo'i rig byed dang*/ bdag nyid kun shes par byed pa nang rig pa sde snod dang rgyud sder gtogs pa rnams rim par gsungs pa'i go rim dang mthun par 'chad pa la/ dang po tshig gi log rtogs tshar gcod par byed pa sgra rig pa thos pa'i brgyud rim la dngos dang*/

zhar byung gnyis/ dang po la sgra mkhan dbang phyug go chas gzhon nu kartī ka bsgrubs pas zhag bdun na gzhon nu gdong drug lag na mdung thung thogs pa byung nas gsungs pa'i legs sbyar gyi bstan bcos/ byā ka ra ṇa'i 'grel pa 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i bshad sbyar gzhung don rab gsal dang*/ de'i 'grel pa karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i kar ṭīka gi steng nas ri mo'i lag khrid gzhung 'bebs legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi mes po

sgra'i byung tshul rnams las sum cu rtsa gsum du sgra mkhan sarba dzñā zhes pa byung ba des lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sgra bslabs zhes 'byung ba de 'di dang gcig par sems so// tshangs pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin/ drang srong gzhon nu gdong drug phur bu/ slob dpon dbang phyug go cha/ rgyal po bde spyod bzang po/ jo bo drag 'byor/ mkhas pa chen po tsand+ra go mi/ slob dpon dharma dā sa/ mkhas pa ratna ma ti/ paṇa chen pūrṇa tsand+raḥ slob dpon 'chi med seng ge paṇa chen lakṣ+mī ka ra/ 'jig rten mig gcig shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ shong lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ lo chen mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros dpung rgyan mdzes pa'i tog dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ sgra bsgyur nam mkha' bzang po/ skad gnyis smra ba thugs rje dpal gyi zhabs/ zhwa lu lo chen legs pa'i rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos skyong bzang po/ skyogs ston karma lo tsā ba rin chen bkra shis blo gros ngo mtshar bye ba'i gter mdzod/ dpal khang lo tsā ba dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde/ sgang ra lo tsā ba 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ smon 'gro paṇa chen rig gnas rgya mtsho pa tshe dbang don grub/ de sras gnas lnga rig pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags/ chab mdo byams gling gi skad gnyis smra ba kun dga' legs pa/ che tshang mkhas pa gsung rab rgya mtsho/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag karm+ma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i tha snyad du/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes btags pa la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na rnam gling paṇa chen nas/ che tshang mkhas pa gsung rab rgya mtsho man sngar bzhin no// yang na paṇa chen tshe dbang don grub nas/

ngam ring mkhan po mang yul lo chen tshe brtan rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho man 'dra'o// yang na lo chen thugs rje dpal nas/ dpal sdings skad gnyis smra ba grags pa'i mtshan can/ zhwa lu lo chen man 'dra/ yang na thugs rje dpal nas/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ zhwa lu lo chen man 'dra'o// 'di bsdus don dang gzhung 'bebs gtso bor sbyar ba'i brgyud pa yin la/ mtha' dpyod gtso bor sbyar ba'i brgyud pa ni/ zhwa lu lo chen nas/ dpon pad dkar chos skyong*/ 'brug pa lo tsā ba spyang mo ngag dbang grags pa/ lo chen dbang phyug zhabs/ shong ston sprul pa'i zlos gar sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ smon 'gro paṇa chen tshe dbang don grub man 'dra'o// sgra mdo 'di'i rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs ni ind+ra byā ka ra ṇa gtso che bar bzhed do// rgyu mtshan brgya byin gyis ind+ra byā ka ra ṇa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos byas/ brgya byin gyis sgra bslabs pa'i slob bu drang srong phur bu yin pa'i phyir ro// kā lā pa'i nye brgyud ni/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ des rgya gar shar phyogs ti ra ka'i paṇḍi ta shrī ma ṇi ka la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang du ka lā pa'i bshad pa gnang*/ des bal po shing kun gyi mchod rten la bskor ba mdzad dus/ bo dong lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis zhus/ de las snar thang lo tsā ba saṃ gha shrīs zhus/ de las zhwa lu lo tsā ba legs rgyal gyis zhus/ de las zhwa lu skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po chos skyong bzang pos zhus pa man chad snga ma rnams dang 'dra'o// ༈ //rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig 'phags ma dbyangs can mas gnas lnga rig pa'i slob dpon chen po a nu bhū ti swa ru pā tsarya ste rjes su 'byor pa rang bzhin bzang po la dngos su stsal ba'i brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po dbyangs can byā ka ra ṇa dang*/ slob dpon de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa rab tu bya ba gsal ldan dang bcas pa'i steng nas dka' ba'i gnad kyi lag khrid thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rgyal ba'i yum gyur 'phags ma dbyangs can ma/ gnas lnga rig pa a nu bhū ti swa ru pā tsarya nas rim par/ 'phags yul nub phyogs ku ru kṣe tra bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs pa paṇḍi ta pa la bha dra/ go kū la na tha mi shra/ 'dar pa lo tsā ba ngag dbang lhun grub phun tshogs/ rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags/ byams gling mkhas pa kun dga' legs pa/ che tshang smra ba'i dbang phyug gsung rab rgya mtsho/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho 'dzin pa karma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// ༈ //bod kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa thu mi sambho ṭa rgya gar du brdzongs te/ paṇḍi ta lha rigs pa seng ge dang bram ze li byin bsten nas/ legs sbyar gyi brda sprod la mkhas par gyur pas rgya yig lnga bcu bod yig sum cur gtan la phab ste bstan bcos chen po brgyad mdzad pa'i nang tshan sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa gnyis kyi 'grel pa thams cad mkhyen pa chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i steng nas legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bram ze li byin/ thu mi sambho ṭa nas rim par/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos skyong bzang po/ skyogs ston karma lo tsā ba rin chen bkra shis blo gros ngo mtshar bye ba'i gter mdzod/ dpal khang lo tsā ba dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde/ sgang ra lo tsā ba 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ paṇḍi ta chen po smon 'gro tshe dbang don grub/ de sras 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje nas rim par se ra theg chen gling gi rab 'byams pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na lo chen chos skyong bzang po nas rim par/ tshe bhrūm̐ pa karma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //gnyis pa ni/ sa skya paṇḍi tas/ gzhan las gzhan dag rnam bshad pa// 'di yi nang du 'dus zhes bshad// ces gsungs pas rig pa'i gnas lnga'i nang du rig gnas gzhan thams cad 'dus pa'i lugs la ni/

zhar byung sgra'i yan lag tu 'gyur zhing*/ rig pa'i gnas chung ba lnga zhes so sor bgrang ba'i lugs la ni/ sgra shes na don la mi rmongs pas rjod byed kun gyi gzhir bzung nas/ de'i steng du sdeb sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs/ mngon brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs/ snyan ngag shes na tshig rgyan la mi rmongs/ zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs/ zhes dpang lo/ snar thang saṃ gha shrī/ rin spungs sa spyod sogs mkhas pa 'ga' zhig sgra lan gnyis su bgrangs pa'i lngar 'dod pa dang*/ stag tshang lo tsā bas/ skar rtsis snyan ngag sdeb sbyor dang*// mngon brjod zlos gar 'di lnga la// rig gnas lnga zhes 'phags yul na// grags pa'i ba dan rlung ltar sgrog /ces sgra mi bgrangs par dus 'khor gyi rtsis dang dbyangs 'char gyi rtsis rig gcig tu bgrangs pa'i chung ba lnga zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad mod/ don la 'gal bar mi sems te/ nges par che chung gi tha snyad de ltar dgos pa'i grub mtha' 'cha' na gong gi mdo sde rgyan gyi lung de la yang ma khyab pa'i skyon yod par thal/ der sdeb sbyor dang snyan ngag la sogs pa gzhan lnga po rgyal ba'i sras kyis bslab byar ma bstan pa'i phyir ro// des na gang ltar yang*/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi mkhas pa sgo drug tu grags pa'i ya gyal rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa chen po rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyis bṛtta dzā ti ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi ri mo dang bcas pa legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ paṇḍi ta chen po rin chen 'byung gnas/ paṇa chen sa dbang bzang po/ shong lo tsā ba mched gnyis/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan pa/ dpang lo chen po/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ lo chen nam mkha' bzang po/ skad gnyis smra ba thugs rje dpal/ dpal sdings lo chen grags pa'i mtshan can/ 'gos lo tsā ba gsum pa chos skyong bzang po/

skyogs ston karma lo tsā ba/ dpal khang lo tsā ba dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde/ sgang ra lo tsā ba 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ shes bya kun rig smon 'gro tshe dbang don grub/ de sras paṇa chen 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags/ byams gling mkhas pa kun dga' legs pa/ mkhas dbang gsung rab rgya mtsho/ brda sprod smra ba'i dbang phyug karma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na zhwa lu lo chen nas/ lo chen pad dkar chos skyong*/ grangs chen 'jam dpal rdo rje/ smon 'gro paṇa chen man 'dra// ༈ //chos kyi rgyal po sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos sna tshogs me tog gi chun po rig gnas mtha' dag gi gsal byed mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo/ sgra la 'jug pa/ sgra nyer bsdus/ sgra'i gnas kyi gnad bsdus rnams kyi lung rkyang gi brgyud pa ni/ paṇḍi ta saṃ gha shrī/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal ba/ rgyal ba na bza' brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ chos rje byang chub seng ge shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje don grub rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun grub pa khams ston nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //ma hā paṇḍi ta dpal 'dzin sdes mdzad pa'i mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba las/

'jig rten mig gcig chos skyong bzang pos mngon brjod nye bar mkho zhing grags che ba che long zhig logs su bkar ba skad gnyis shan sbyar du yod pa/ slob dpon chen po 'chi med seng ges mdzad pa'i mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos a ma ra ko ṣa dang*/ sa paṇa gyi tshig gter sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi yi ge la brten nas dka' ba'i gnad rnams legs par thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen 'chi med seng ge slob dpon rab 'byor zla ba/ mkhas pa phun tshogs byed pa/ shong lo mched gnyis/ lo mchog pa/ dpang lo chen po/ lo chen byang rtse/ lo chen nam mkha' bzang po/ sgra bsgyur thugs rje dpal/ mang thos legs pa rgyal mtshan/ zhwa lu lo tsā ba chen po/ skyogs ston karma lo tsā ba/ dpal khang pa dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde/ de las sgang rwa ba 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang grangs chen 'jam dpal rdo rje gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las paṇa chen tshe dbang don grub/ de nas sras 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags/ byams gling mkhas pa kun dga' legs pa/ che tshang gsung rab rgya mtsho/ karma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// tshig gi gter gyi lung rkyang gi brgyud pa ni/ gong gi sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog chun po'i brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// ༈ //'phags pa'i yul gyi snyan ngag mkhan kun gyi gtsug tu mngon par mtho ba/ tshangs pa'i bu mos rjes su bzung ba'i slob dpon daṇṭi ste dbyug pa can zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i snyan dngags me long gi bstan bcos lam rnam par dbye ba/ don rgyan sgra rgyan gab tshig dang bcas pa/ de'i bsdus don lo chen chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa dang*/ dka' 'grel thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs dang 'bras spungs sgo mang gi paṇa chen blo gros nyi mas mdzad pa dper brjod rnams dang bcas pa'i steng nas khrid bshad pa rtsom rgyugs kyi dogs sel dang bcas pa'i sgo nas shin tu zhib par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/

ngag gi dbang phyug lha mo dbyangs can ma/ paṇa chen kīrti bhu ti/ paṇḍi ta chen po dpal ldan dbyug pa can/ paṇa chen pūrṇa tsand+ra/ mkhas pa 'chi med seng ge slob dpon rab 'byor zla ba/ paṇa chen lakṣ+mī kā ra/ shong ston lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ gcung blo gros brtan pa/ lo chen mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ dpang lo tsā ba chen po blo gros brtan pa/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ sgra bsgyur nam mkha' bzang po/ mkhas pa shes rab dpal/ lo chen thugs rje dpal/ mkhas mchog sangs rgyas mtshan can/ mang thos legs pa rgyal mtshan/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ dbon pad dkar chos skyong*/ grangs chen lo tsā ba 'jam dpal rdo rje/ smon 'gro paṇa chen tshe dbang don grub/ 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ rnam gling mkhas pa chen po dkon mchog chos grags/ chab mdo byams gling gi snyan dngags mkhan kun dga' legs pa/ che tshang smra ba'i dbang phyug gsung rab rgya mtsho/ gtsug lag bye ba'i gter mdzod karma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal/ de las bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis legs par nos so// yang na zhwa lu lo tsā ba nas/ karma lo tsā ba rin chen bkra shis/ dpal khang lo tsā ba mang thos chos kyi rgya mtsho/ sgang ra lo tsā ba 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ smon 'gro paṇa chen man 'dra'o// yang na pad dkar chos skyong nas/ spyang mo lo tsā ba/ lo chen dbang phyug lo chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ zhang mkhar paṇa chen 'jam dpal rdo rje/ rgyal dbang kun mkhyen lnga pa/ rnam gling paṇḍi ta dkon mchog chos grags/ drung yig kun dga' legs pa/ mkhas dbang gsung rab rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen karma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// 'dir 'ga' zhig slob dpon chos kyi grags pas/ shes rab can ni phyogs kyi glang po ste// tsand+ra go mi brjod pa rnam par dag

/snyan dngags dpa' bo las byung sdeb sbyor mkhas// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba nga min su// zhes gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ slob dpon dbyug pa can dang mkhas mchog dpa' bo gcig par 'dod pa mi rigs pa'i shes byed snar thang lo chen saṃ gha shrīs/ daṇḍī'i bstan bcos dri ma med// ji bzhin 'gyed la dpa' bo dang*// skal mnyam blo gros mig thob pa// ma nor lam 'di bdag gis bshad// ces bshad pa dang*/ lam rnam dbye'i skabs su/ de dag dbye ba snyan ngag mkhan// so so la gnas brjod mi nus// zhes pa 'grel pa rnams su nag mo'i khol po dpa' bo sogs bgrangs pa mang ba'i phyir ro// zlos gar gyi bstan bcos skad rigs kyi dbang gis bod du 'jug chung bas grags chung zhing mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad srol las don gyis thon pa las zur du nos pa med la/ de la mkho bas paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'i rol mo'i bstan bcos kyi lung brgyud ni sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi chun po sogs dang 'dra'o// ༈ //'phags pa'i yul na snyan ngag mkhan kun gyi dbus su nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor ltar gsal ba chos kyi rgyal po dge ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing yal 'dab brgya dang bdun/ de'i kha skong le'u gcig sras zla ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa dang bcas pa'i yal 'dab brgya rtsa brgyad pa chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bkas bskul ltar skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skyar bsgyur ba la slad kyi lo tsā ba zhwa lu pa chos skyong bzang pos 'gyur bcos dang zhus dag gis legs par bstar ba'i steng nas lung thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston mchog shākya seng ge chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang po/ de sras zla ba'i dbang po/ paṇḍi ta lakṣ+mī kā ra/ shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ gcung blo gros brtan pa/
dbon po chos skyong dpal/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang

'di dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung bar grags/ grags pa/ kun spangs rnam rgyal grags pa/ 'bum rab 'byams pa rin chen chos dbang*/ rab 'byams chos rje tshul khrims dbang phyug dpal khang lo tsā ba mang thos chos kyi rgya mtsho/ mdo khams pa bla chen yon tan rgya mtsho/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ gong dkar ba chos sde ba/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i rtse mo/ mkhyen brtse chen po'i dbon po yin tshe dbang kun mkhyen yang zer/ kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ gong dkar drung yig ri grong pa/ g.yu lo bkod pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ gong dkar zur 'chad pa/ dpal 'byor gling pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ gong dkar 'phying ru thod dkar ba/ nor gong dkar ba/ rgyas gling pa rin chen rgya mtsho/ don grub chos gong dkar ba/ gling bstan pa dar rgyas/ dol pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ mkhas btsun chen po kun dga' rgya mtsho/ de las bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis legs par nos so// yang na dpal khang lo tsā ba nas/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i rtse mo man gong ltar ro// yang na stag lung ngag dbang grags pa nas/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ dpal khang lo tsā ba man 'dra/ yang na dpal 'byor gling pa nas/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rin chen rgya mtsho man gong bzhin no// ༈ //dpal dus kyi 'khor lo phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyi rol shes pa'i yan lag rtsis skor rnams dus 'khor gyi cha lag tu bgrangs kyang mi 'thad pa ma yin mod/ rig gnas che ba lngar bsdu ba'i tshe sgra rig pa'i 'khor du 'byung zhing*/ rig gnas chung ba lngar dbye ba'i tshe skar rtsis rig gnas chung ba'i ya gyal gcig tu mdzad pa khungs dang 'brel ba nas/

padma dkar po'i zhal lung gi dgongs don gtso bor bzung*/ phug pa man ngag lugs kyi phyag len gyis rnam par spras pa'i bstan bcos bai ḍūr dkar po'i steng nas lnga bsdus/ sgra gcan lo 'pho zla 'pho/ gza' 'dzin/ gza' lnga tshes dang nyin zhag la spyod pa/ de dag gi myur rtsis kyi rigs mi 'dra ba rnams nyi ldog 'khor lo/ dus sbyor tatkāl dang dum bu drug pa/ zhag gsum gyi rnam par dbye ba/ g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba las btus pa thor bu rnams dang bcas pa rnams lag khrid du nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa/ de las mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho dang phug pa lhun grub rgya mtsho gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las mkhas pa chos legs rin chen/ de nas phug nas chos rje dpal mgon phrin las pa nas rim par/ 'di nas brgyud pa 'ga' zhig btsal dgos/ ser theg chen gling gi chu mig spyi khang pa'i rab 'byams pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na yan chad btsal/ bka' blon mkhas pa kun dga' phun tshogs/ mnga' ris mkhas btsun kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// phug lugs kyi gza' lnga nyin zhag ma myur rtsis re mig rgya mtsho sogs kyi lag len che phra rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje phrin las pa nas/ mkhas grub dpal gyi seng ge mkhas dbang bkra shis mtshan can/ ldum bu don grub dbang rgyal/ rnam gling paṇa chen nam/ lo chen chos dpal bzang po gang rung nas/ rdor grags padma'i mtshan can/ bla mkhyen bsod nams rgyal/ de las bdag gis so// ༈ //bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs pa byed pa'i rtsis kyi lnga bsdus/ sgra gcan/ lo bdag rgyal blon/ kar myong rtsis/ nyi zlar sgra gcan 'jug pa'i rtsis la sogs pa de la nye bar mkho ba'i rigs rnams legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yan chad kyi brgyud pa btsal/

dpal sa skya'i mkhas pa dge slong lags/ de las rtsis kyi gtsug lag smra ba'i dbang phyug kun dga' rgya mtsho/ mkhas btsun dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas chos 'phel/ de las bdag gis legs par nos so// yang na sangs rgyas chos 'phel nas/ rtsis rig 'dzin pa kun dga' rgya mtsho/ de las bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// ༈ //'di de sngon lag len ma thob kyang thob 'gyur dbang gis bris/ dpal gtsug na zla bas gsungs pa'i dbyangs 'char gyi rgyud le'u bcu pa'i dgongs 'grel mchog tu dga' ba'i sgra dbyangs dang*/ ngo mtshar rgyan gyi me tog gi steng nas dbyangs 'char gyi phyag len yongs su rdzogs pa nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa chen po/ lha chen dbang phyug chen po/ dpal rta mgrin mgon po/ de'i sras dpal ldan tshangs lha nā tha/ dpal zla ba kun dga' mgon po/ dpal utpal bzang po/ dpal gsang ba'i mtshan can/ dpal yi dam bzang po/ dpal a bhi naṃ gupta ra na/ dpal shaṅka ra bha dra/ dpal phun sum tshogs 'dzin bzang po/ dpal seng ge go cha/ dpal 'jam dpal dga' byed/ dpal 'od mdzad/ dpal dza ya ā nanda/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ bla ma chos rje/ slob dpon rin chen rgyal po/ slob dpon rin chen dbang phyug bla ma gzhon nu rin chen/ sngags 'chang lhun grub dpal/ mkhas grub chos rje/ mkhas mchog ārya de wa/ mkhas dbang sangs rgyas blo gros/ dus zhabs pa chen po dpal mgon phrin las/ mkhas pa dpal gyi seng ge bla mkhyen g.yu lo ba/ gnyags ban ngag dbang 'jam dpal blo gros/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho yin nam/ de nas brgyud pa gsum bzhi ma rnyed pa btsal dgos/ de nas smra mkhas ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// ༈ //'phags pa'i yul du nag rtsis zhes bya ba'i tha snyad ma grags la shar phyogs ma hā tsi na'i yul gyi 'gro ba rnams kun rdzob rtsis kyi bden pas 'dul bar dgongs nas/

mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar trikṣa shing gi lba ba las byis pa'i tshul gyis brdzus te 'khrungs nas legs gsungs bdud rtsi'i sgo 'phar phye bas yul de shin tu dar rgyas su byung la/ slad kyi tshe 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sprul pa 'un shing kong jos pur rgyal bod du byon dus rten 'brel rtsis kyi gtsug lag rnams spyan drangs pa nas brtsams te bod yul du rtsis dkar nag ces yongs su dar srol byung ba'i skor la rtsa ba'i rde'u drug gcod 'dral gyi rde'u nyi shu rtsa gcig zhe bdun ma/ bcu bzhi ma/ brgyad ma/ thang shing rtsis/ tshe rtsis/ bag rtsis/ gshin rtsis sogs zhib tu nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ lo tsā ba khams pa phra mo sogs nas rim par/ khyung nag shāka dar/ phug pa mkhas mchog ārya de wa/ mtshungs med sangs rgyas blo gros/ rtsis rig smra ba'i gtsug rgyan dpal mgon phrin las pa/ de nas se ra theg chen gling gi rab 'byams pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ de las bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis nos so// yang na dpal mgon phrin las nas/ mkhas mchog dpal gyi seng ge bla mkhyen g.yu lo ba/ gnyags ban nang rwa ba ngag dbang 'jam dpal blo gros/ zur chen pa man gong dang 'dra'o// ༈ //gnyis pa tshar gcod rig pa tshad ma ni/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi tas/ de ltar sgrub dang sun 'byin gyi// rig pa'i gzhung lugs gang gis shes// mkhas pa des ni rdzogs pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa 'dzin// zhes gsungs pa rigs par smra ba'i khyu mchog slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i mdo/ shes bya rig gnas lnga'i skabs su bzhi pa tshad ma/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin kun mkhyen g.yag ston sangs rgyas dpal dang*/ red mda' ba gzhon nu dpal dag gi skabs su sa skya dang ngam ring sogs su po ti grags chen bco brgyad kyi rnam gzhag mdzad par/

tshad mdo 1 rnam 'grel 2 rnam nges 3 tshad ma'i skor// 'dul ba mdo 4 dang mdo rtsa 5 'dul ba'i skor// kun las btus 6 dang mdzod gnyis 7 mngon pa'i skor// byam 8 sa chos 9 lnga 10 dang pha 11 ra phyin 12 dbu ma yi// rtsa 13 'ju 14 ga bzhi 15 gsum ches 16 zab dbu ma'i skor// sde bdun mdo bcas dgongs 'grel rig 17 gter dang*// sde snod rgyud sde kun 'grel 18 sdom gsum ste// pusti grags chen bco brgyad zhes su grags// zhes pa ltar las dang po tshad ma kun las btus pa zha ma seng rgyal bas bsgyur ba le'u drug gi bdag nyid can gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ dgra bcom pa chos skyob/ me waṃ ga dbyig gnyen/ dpal ldan phyogs kyi glang po/ slob dpon dbang phyug sde/ dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa/ paṇḍi ta lha dbang blo gros/ paṇa chen shākya blo gros/ slob dpon dul ba'i lha/ shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros/ paṇa chen nyi ma sbas pa/ slob dpon dza ma ri/ dzñā na shrī mi tra/ paṇḍi ta chos mchog bram ze shaṅka ra nanda/ waṅgu paṇḍi ta ngag dbang*/ kha che paṇḍi ta shākya shrī/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge zhang mdo sde dpal/ sde bdun pa dpal ldan seng ge mkhas pa nor bzang dpal/ mkhan chen brtson 'grus dpal/ g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma/ rong ston shes bya kun rig mkhas pa don yod dpal/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ sa skya'i las chen ye shes lhun grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog mkhan chen phrin las bzang po/ dpal ldan shākya bstan 'dzin/ shākya nor bu kun dga' legs pa/ bshes gnyen rnam rgyal/ smra dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' lhun grub/ rje btsun sangs rgyas bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ chos rje bsam gtan phun tshogs/ e waṃ pa rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ des bdag bande tshul khrims chen la'o// ༈ //rigs pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma sde bdun gyi ya gyal rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel le'u bzhi pa sa skya paṇḍi ta'i 'gyur gyi steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

ston pa yang dag pa thub pa'i dbang po/ mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ dgra bcos pa chos skyob/ mkhas pa me waṃ ga rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na me waṃ ga zhes snang*/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbyig gnyen/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po/ slob dpon dbang phyug sde/ rig pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi grags pa/ slob dpon paṇḍi ta lha dbang blo gros/ slob dpon shākya blo gros/ paṇḍi ta 'od kyi blo gros/ paṇḍi ta shes rab rgyan mkhan por yang grags/ 'byung gnas sbas pa/ slob dpon dza tshad ma'i brgyud 'debs su ya mā ri zhes 'byung ba ma dag pa 'dra'am snyam/ ma ri/ paṇḍi ta chos mchog rgyal rnga bdun pa'ang zer/ slob dpon dul ba'i lha/ 'di gsan yig 'ga' zhig na ma byung ba brtag bram ze shaṅka ra nanda/ bde byed dga' bar bsgyur 'dug waṃ gu paṇḍi ta/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ paṇḍi ta su ga ta shrī/ paṇa chen dā na shī la/ bal po saṃ gha shrī/ de bzhi ga las chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas gsan/ de nas 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhas pa brtson 'grus dpal/ g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma/ rong ston mkhas pa yon tan dpal/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ sa skya'i las chen ye shes lhun grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog mkhan chen phrin las bzang po/ dpal ldan shākya bstan 'dzin man gong bzhin no// ༈ //sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i dgongs 'grel rigs pa smra ba'i dbang phyug sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'i tshad ma rig pa'i gter rtsa 'grel gyi brgyud pa ni/ kha che paṇḍi ta shākya shrī yan rnam 'grel dang 'dra ba la/ de nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan/ dpal ldan blo gros brtan pa/

chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgyal mtshan/ brang ti mkhas pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ 'dren mchog nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ 'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ chos rje don grub rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun grub pa khams ston nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sa skya paṇa chen nas/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ zhang dkon mchog dpal ba/ na bza' brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'dul 'dzin pa/ chos rje byang chub seng ge shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o// ༈ //gsum pa gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa rig pa'i gnas la bzo dang gso ba gnyis/ dang po bzo rig pa ni/ stag tshang lo tsā ba'i rig gnas kun shes las/ bzo la lus bzo ngag bzo yid bzo gsum// zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ rig pa'i gnas phal cher bzo rig pa'i khongs su 'du bar gsungs shing*/ 'dir bzo rig bye brag pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang*/ 'grel chen dri med 'od dang*/ bde mchog sdom pa 'byung dang*/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po rgyud 'grel bcas dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ bslab pa kun las btus pa la sogs pa nas gsungs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rgyal yum sogs dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo khro mo sogs kyi sku'i thig rtsa ci rigs par bshad pa rnams dang*/ de dag gi bzhed pa ma nor bar ston par byed pa mkhas dbang sman bla don grub pas mdzad pa'i sku gzugs kyi tshad kyi rab tu byed pa'i gzhung ni/

bod yul 'dir rgya gzhung tshad ldan lta bur khas len dgos pas/ gzhung der de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i mtshan dang dpe byad bshad pa/ tshad kyi gzhung du grags pa 'ga' zhig rang bzos bslad pa'i mi 'thad pa'i phyogs dgag pa/ tshad dang mi ldan pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i nyes skyon brjod pa/ mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs chen po rnams kyi lung gis tshad ldan gyi lugs dgod pa/ tshad de dag dang ldan pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i phan yon brjod pa/ sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i lha bzo dang sbyin bdag gi mtshan nyid brjod pa/ de dag lag tu blang ba'i rim par/ ji skad du/ rgyal ba'i sku gzugs thal mo bcu pa dang*// rgyal sras rnams kyi mtho bcu zhan pa dang*// rgyal yum sogs kyi zhal tshad dgu pa dang*// rgyal dbang khros pa rnams kyi gdong brgyad pa// mi'u thung gi lus tshad mtho drug pa// zhes 'byung ba ltar gyi rgyas par bshad pa ste don tshan bdun gyi sgo nas bstan pa dang*/ de'i rjes su 'brang bar gyur pa dbyangs can lha mos rjes su bzung ba rta nag ri mkhar ba dpal ldan blo gros bzang pos/ gang phyir gang gis gang la gang ltar 'dri// rtags dang skyon yon spang blang ji ltar bya// zhes pa ltar don tshan brgyad kyis bstan pa dang*/ de dag gi rjes su 'brangs nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhas dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtshos lag tu blang ba'i thig 'debs kyi rim pa dbus gtsang phyogs kyi bris 'bur mkhas pa'i lha bzo rnams kyi tshad kyi phyi mo rnams bstun te bai ḍūr g.ya' sel du gsal bar phye ba rnams dang*/ gzhan yang kho bo cag gi yang mes sprul sku sangs rgyas lha dbang gis mdzad pa'i bskor thig gi 'grel pa mthong ba don gsal zhes bya ba dang bcas pa rnams kyi steng nas lag khrid dang thos bsam zhib tu nos pa las/ thog mar dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel chen dri ma med pa'i 'od le'u lnga pa ye shes kyi le'ur gsal bar bstan pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/

dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa/ zla ba bzang po/ lha dbang gzi brjid can/ zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/ lha'i dbang ldan/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ padma dkar po/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa tsi lu paṇa chen/ piṇḍo ā tsārya/ dus zhabs pa che ba/ dus zhabs pa gnyis pa mañdzu kīrti/ sa manta shrī/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ de sras shes rab seng ge bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ shar pa ye shes rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ sku zhang bsod nams mchog grub/ chos rje don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling 'jam dpal bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug 'dren mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen tshe dbang lhun grub/ khyab bdag klu sgrub rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med smon lam lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang brtson 'grus bzang po/ gnas gsar ba kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ dus 'khor bla ma kun dga' phun tshogs/ de las bdag gis so// de dag gi tshad kyi lag khrid dang rgya sman gsar rnying gi lugs srol so so'i khyad par gyi ri mo'i 'gros sogs zhib par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'di yan chad btsal/ de nas karma pa dbyangs can bzang po'i zhabs/ sprul sku sangs rgyas lha'i dbang po/ dbon sprul sku dge 'dun 'od zer/ sprul pa'i bzo bo mkha' ri gdong pa dbon po rgya bo zhes pa/ 'gru dge yag lha bzo/ de las ngag dbang chos 'phel ba/ des bdag la lag khrid du stsal to// yang na dge yag pa nas/ de sras karma chos lung*/ mkhas btsun chen po sangs rgyas chos 'phel/ de las bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis legs par nos so//

༈ //byang chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gzugs rnam du shar ba'i thar pa'i grong khyer gzhal yas khang gi tshad ni/ paṇḍi ta chen po gung ru shes rab bzang pos mdzad pa'i yi ge la brten nas dkyil 'khor spyi'i thig tshad rta babs snam bu bzhi pa dang*/ snam bu bcu gcig pa'i thig 'debs dang*/ bye brag tu rgyud sde bzhis bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi nang thig gi khyad par rnams dang*/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi thab thig dang bcas pa thos bsam gyi sgo nas lag len du gtan la bab cing*/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i kye rdo rje'i rnam bshad zla zer dang*/ gzhal yas khang gi tshad rnam par gzhag pa dang*/ kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi rnam bshad rnams kyi lung legs par nos shing gzhal yas khang blos slong gi cha tshad rnams lag len thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i zla zer gyi brgyud pa ni/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po nas/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel pa/ sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ 'di nas bla ma gnyis tsam btsal/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// man ngag lugs kyi bskyed rim gyi rnam par bshad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge nas/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mus pa'i dge bshes tshul khrims mtshan can/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag la stsal to// ༈ //gnyis pa gsung rten ni gong du smos pa'i yig ris rnams las bod du 'dri srol mchis pa'i nang nas lāñtsa na dang*/

wartu la dang*/ nā ga ra dang*/ sindhu dang*/ pukkaṃ dang*/ dha ri ka dang*/ kasmī ra dang*/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i hor gyi yig gsar la sogs pa lag khrid du byas pa'i slob dpon dang brgyud rim ni gong gi brda sprod pa'i skabs ltar 'ded pas btub bam snyam mo// bod kyi yi ge la slob dpon thu mi saṃ bho ṭas mdzad pa'i yi ge'i rgyun las brgyud de khyung po g.yu khri dang sum pa gnod sbyin sogs kyis dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i rdzab dang gshar ma'i nang gsel lugs srol cung zad 'dra min mchis pa rnams la'ang sbyangs lor bgyis so// ༈ //gsum pa thugs kyi rten ni/ rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa phyag mtshan rnams kyi tshad dang mtshan nyid dang*/ mchod rten la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyad de/ 'di'i go rim gyi thog ma lha babs nas byas pa sogs mi 'dra ba mang du yod cing*/ mnga' ris tshul khrims 'od zer gyis/ pad spungs bltams tshe ser skya'i drung du dar// byang chen rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe rdo rje gdan// sgo mangs chos 'khor bskor tshe wā rā ṇa sīr dang*// cho 'phrul cho 'phrul bstan tshe mnyan yod du// lha babs yum gyi don mdzad gsal ldan grong*// dbyen bzlum dge 'dun 'dums tshe yangs can du// sku tshe'i bdud las rnam rgyal mchod rten che// myang 'das mya ngan 'das tshe rtswa mchog grong*// zhes srid pa tha ma pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sku bltams ma thag nas phyogs rnams su gom pa bdun bdun bor ba'i sar padma skyes pa sogs bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel dang mthun par padma sprungs pas thog drangs par mdzad pa ltar legs shing*/ mchod rten brgyad po de dag gi cha tshad yi ge mang du mthong mod/ yongs su grags pa kun mkhyen bu ston rin chen grub dang*/ sprul sku ri mkhar ba dpal ldan blo gros bzang po dang*/ thar rtse paṇḍi ta nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa sogs yig cha gsar rnying mthong thos byung ba 'ga' zhig la lag len thig 'debs bgyis pa tsam las 'ga' rer lung brgyud ma thos pa dang*/

thos pa'i rigs ni gzhung bshad dang bka' 'bum so so'i skabs nas 'byung ba ltar las 'dir smos ma dgos so// ༈ //bzhi pa gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i rig gnas gnyis pa gso ba rig pa'i skor la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u drug dang*/ bshad pa'i rgyud le'u sum cu so gcig dang*/ man ngag rgyud la le'u dgu bcu go gnyis dang*/ phyi ma rgyud la le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga dang*/ mjug don yongs su gtad pa le'u gnyis te yongs su dril bas le'u brgya dang lnga bcu nga drug yod pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs

'di de sngon ma thob kyang slad thob 'gyur dbang gis bris/ rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po/ 'tsho byed gzhon nu/ sman pa rgyun shes/ nam so skyes/ thang lha 'bar/ rkang gnyis spyod/ 'gro skyong bu/ me bzhi 'jug lug nag rgya skyegs sna/ mda' mchog lan tshwa'i lag pa/ dpal ldan phreng ba/ dpal ldan phun tshogs/ yid las skyes/ nyi ma'i snying po/ zla ba'i snying po/ zla ba'i 'od zer/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ dpal ldan dpa' bo'am pha khol/ paṇa chen zla ba mngon dga'/ lo chen bai ro tsa na/ chos rgyal mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/ gter ston grwa pa mngon shes can/ thar rtse pa'i gsan yig tu med/ dge bshes dbus pa dar grags/ 'tsho byed dkon mchog skyabs/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po/ sum ston ye shes kun dga'/ sum ston 'bum me/ g.yu thog mgon po rin chen/ phag ston shākya mgon po/ brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed/ brang ti dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ brang ti pa kun dga' bzang po/ brang ti stag lha dpal/ brang ti rdo rje dpal bzang*/ brang ti chos rgyal bkra shis/ brang ti lha rje kun dga' don grub/ dge slong nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ dbon 'di phan chad slar dpyad dgos/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ dge slong kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ drung 'tsho ye shes mtshan can/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la bka' drin du stsal to// smras pa/ tshul khrims la gnas blo gros can rnams kyis// bslab bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba// gtsug lag bcu phrag rig pa ston pa'i gzhung*// mthong thos tsam gyis bag chag 'jog tshul byas// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las thun mong ba phyi rig pa'i gnas kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste gsum pa'o// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa nang rig pa'i gnas kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim la gnyis/

sdom pa gsum 'khor dang bcas pa'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim dang*/ de thams cad kyi rgyab brten du lung gi tshogs thos pa'i brgyud rim/ dang po la/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i chos skor thos pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i chos skor thos pa/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim mo// dang po ni lhag par tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ston par byed pa 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi brjod par bya ba'i gtso bo so sor thar pa ste/ de'i mdo las/ 'di ni lang tsho'i rnam 'phrul ba'i// rkang gnyis gzhon nu'i lcags kyu yin// mtsho bas zab pa'i 'khor ba las// sgrol ba'i brgal thabs 'di yin te// 'di ni bzang 'gror 'gro ba yi// nges pa'i chu lon zab pa yin// 'di ni nyon mongs 'pham byed lam// rgyal po yi ni 'dren pa mchog /'di ni thar pa'i grong 'jug pa'i// them skas bzhi dang 'dra bar gnas// zhes dang*/ bshes pa'i spring yig las kyang*/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs// zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan la sogs pa dge legs rin po che rin thang gzhal du med pa ma lus pa 'byung ba'i lag 'gro'i dbang po'i bsti gnas su nges pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi ljon pa rin po che'i rtsa ba'am gzhi ma ni 'di nyid du bstan pas/ yon tan can kun gyi brten gnas su gyur pa'i bslab gzhi bsrung ba'i rten can du sgrub par byed pa la/ rang lo cher son pa legs par sbyar ba'i skad du sa ra bha wa ste/ stod 'grel gyi skad du zil gnon zhes dang*/ ljongs 'dir dbang thang dang bstun pa'i ming du me pho rta'i lor sgrol byed kyi lha mo nag pas nya ba'i zhag gi phung po'i mar ngo sngon du 'gro ba'i dmar phyogs kyi gral tshes dge ba'i nyin/

bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa tshad med pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid/ bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge'i lugs bzang sde snod gsum gyi brjod par bya ba bslab pa gsum gyis thugs rgyud yongs su gtams shing mkhas tshul rnam pa gsum gyi lam nas tshul bzhin du legs par 'doms pa la bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba/ dpal ldan ngag gi dbang phyug chen por yongs su grags shing grub pa/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa tshul khrims lhun grub bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas la mkhan por zhus shing*/ gzhung lugs rgya mtshor sbyangs stobs kyi gru gzings chen pos brgal te yon tan nor bu'i gter la dbang 'byor pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje gzhal du med pa'i bdag nyid can/ chos 'dul smra ba'i dbang phyug dbu mdzad sangs rgyas tshul khrims pas las kyi slob dpon/ bslab pa'i gnas la gus pa 'phags pa rta thul gyi rnam par thar pa 'dzin cing*/ gcig tu sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba'i bdag nyid can chos rje bstan 'dzin lhun grub pas grib tshod pa/ dad pa'i dge 'dun chos 'dul 'dzin pa shākya chos 'phel la sogs pa kha bskang bar 'os pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i dbus su tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa thub phun tshogs lumbi na'i tshal du sku bltams/ pa'i dbang po/ shā ri'i rgyal po'i khab shing thag can du 'khrungs/ bu/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ grong khyer ser skyar/ bram ze ra ḍār 'khrungs pa'i sa ra ha yin/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ 'phags pa lho phyogs be ta'i yul du 'khrungs/ klu sgrub/ gu ṇa 'dis dbu ma rtsa she la 'grel pa mdzad/ mi tra/ rin chen lam 'bras kyi lo rgyus las dharmā mi trar bshad/ bshes gnyen/ dpal ldan chos dharma pā la ste zla ba'i grong du 'khrungs pa'i bi rū pa yin/

skyong gu ṇa pa ti/ chos kyi phreng ba/ 'byung gnas dran pa nyer gzhag phyi 'gyur gyi paṇḍi ta/ sbas pa/ paṇḍi ta chen kha che khri brtan gyi grong khyer pra ba rar 'khrungs/ po shākya shrī/ mkhan chen rdo rje jo gdan/ dpal/ mkhan rgyal ba gser khang pa/ chen 'od zer jo gdan dpal bzang po/ snye mo bong ra ba/ mkhan chen jo gdan/ bsod nams dpal/ yar 'brog sbrang mda' ba yin/ mkhan jo gdan/ chen bkra kha cig 'di 'od zer dpal ba'i sdom phrug rtsibs pa shes mgon gyi sdom drug tu 'dod/ shis tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje btsun lha mchog seng ge 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ 'dul 'dzin shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhas btsun kun dga' legs pa/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan po chen po thub dbang bstan pa'i nyin byed thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la bande tshul khrims rin chen zhes ming dang bcas te e waṃ gandho la chen por nyi ma phyed yol gyi dus la bab pa na legs par stsal to// de ltar rab tu byung nas nyin zhag gnyis kyis bskal pa'i gral tshes dge ba'i nyin ga la bar bslab pa ma lus pa legs par klog cing ston pa'i mkhan po chen po kun mkhyen shākya seng ge'i ring lugs 'dab stong gi dga' tshal bye ba phrag brgya cig car du 'byed pa'i smra ba'i nyi ma chen po gang yin pa de nyid dang*/ las kyi slob dpon dang grib tshod pa mkhan po rin po che'i bkas legs par bskos pa/ gzhung lugs rgya mtsho 'dzin cing chos 'dul smra ba'i dbang phyug chen po gong du bshad ma thag pa'i 'dren mchog chos kyi rje rnam pa gnyis dang*/

tshul khrims kyi bslab pa mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces par bsrung zhing mdo sngags chos kyi tshul la mkhyen dpyod kyi kho lag rdzogs shing*/ ji bzhin smra ba la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa mchog tu mnga' ba khams ston a mgon bla ma rgyal mtshan pas gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon gyi khur bzhes/ kha skong dad pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chos 'dul 'dzin pa'i mchog gyur gong du smos ma thag pa rnams dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ ldan phrug pa bdag cag tshigs phyi ma bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi dngos por bsgrub pa'i sdom pa legs par stsal ba'i brgyud pa ni/ bha ga wānta thā ga taḥ.arha bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ te samyaksaṃ buddhaḥshākya mu niḥ ārya sha ri pu traḥ/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu/ su ta sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ rā hu laḥ prā bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin/ hma rā hu laḥ/ shrī nā dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ thārya nā gārdzu naḥ/ gu ṇa yon tan bshes gnyen/ mi tra/ rin chen bshes gnyen/ ratna mi tra/ lakṣ+mī bandharm+ma pā la/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ yon tan bdag po/ gu ṇa pa tiḥ/ dharm+ma chos kyi phreng ba/ mā la/ zhi ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa/ shāntā ka ra guptaḥ/ mkhas pa chen po shākya dpal bzang po/ ma hā paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha draḥ/ mkhan chen rdo rje dpal bzang po/ ma ho pa dhyā ya badzra shrī bha draḥ/ ma ho mkhan chen 'od zer dpal bzang po/ pa dhyā ya rasmi shrī bha draḥ/ ma ho pa mkhan chen bsod nams dpal bzang po/ dhyā ya puṇyā shrī bha draḥ/ ma ho pa dhyā ya mkhan chen bkra shis tshul khrims/ maṅga la shī laḥ/ pūrb+ba shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ dzñā na dhwa dzaḥ/ dzi na dwi tī ya rgyal ba gnyis pa dang sgrol kun dga' bzang po/
