bhaṭṭā ra kā nanda bha draḥ/ pa ṭu siddha mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ ka shrī māṃ badzra/ pa ri dha ra yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ ratna wardhaḥ/ bhaṭṭa ra ka su rotma rje btsun lha mchog seng ge singhaḥ/ mañdzu 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge gho ṣa buddha singhaḥ/ ma hā paṇḍi ta paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ga ga ṇa shrī bha draḥ/ mañdzu swa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ rā nanda puṇya ni rā bho gaḥ/ mañdzu 'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ nā tha lakṣ+mya gra dhwa dzaḥ/ ma hā mkhas grub chen po 'dul 'dzin sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ pa ṭu siddha bi na ya dha ra buddha lakṣ+mī/ swā khyā to legs gsungs chos 'dul smra ba'i dbang phyug mkhan po chen po tshul khrims lhun grub dpal bzang po/ dharm+ma bi na ya wā dī shwa ra ma ho pa dhyā ya shī la ni rā bho ga shrī bha draḥ/ te na des bdag dam pa'i chos kyi skal ba mi dman pa tshul khrims rin chen zhes bgyi ba la yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dri'i gtsang khang chen por nyi ma shar tsam gyi dus la bab pa na legs par stsal to// me saddharm+ma ṇā ma hī na su bha gi shī lā ratna nā maṃ gu ṇa ratna syā ka ra sampanna e waṃ dharm+ma pa do ma hā gandha ku ṭī ta tra sūryo da ya ma tra ya sye dā nīṃ samp+ra kā shi tam// ༈ //kun mkhyen bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i las chog rab tu byung ba dang*/ zhar byung khyim pa la phan gdags pa'i lag len dri ma med pa'i phreng ba'i lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ slob dpon bsod nams dpal grub/ mkhas pa nor bzang rin chen/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ stong ra kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ de dbon 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/

she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ de dbon mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhas btsun chen po bsod nams dbang phyug e waṃ pa chos 'dul smra ba dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na bu ston/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ sku zhang grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab rje man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen rab chos rje/ zhwa lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhan chen rin chen mkhyen brtse mchog grub/ rmor chen bstan pa'i snang byed kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' ba mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i las chog gi lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang yan kun mkhyen bu ston gyi las chog gi lung brgyud dang 'dra ba las/ de nas shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa ye shes bzang po/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //rtsa ba so sor thar pa'i mdo dzi na mi tra dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston mchog thub dbang*/

'phags pa 'di la nye ba 'khor byas pa'ang byung*/ 'od srungs/ dgra bcom pa kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa sha na'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa nyer sbas/ dgra bcom pa bha wa nanda/ gsan yig 'ga' zhig tu bha dandaḥzhes pa'ang byung*/ dgra bcom pa me tsa ka dgra bcom pa pūrṇa ste bdun ni dgra bcom pa/ slob dpon rta dbyangs/ ku mā ra gzhon nu rol pa/ la ṭi/ shrī la dpal rol pa/ ṭi/ ha ri seng ge bzang po/ bha dra/ shū ra/ dpa' bo/ ba su mi dbyig bshes/ tra/ ba su li dbyig len/ ste bdun ni rgya gar dbus kyi 'dul 'dzin yin no/ /'dus pa bzang po/ sargha bha draḥ/ dbang phyug i shwa ra/ skāndha li/ phung po len/ dge 'dun dbyig saṃ gha ba su/ pūrṇa mi gang ba bshes gnyen/ tra/ dharma datta/ chos sbyin/ buddha de ba/ sangs rgyas lha/ dha ra datta 'dzin sbyin/ ste brgyad ni kha che'i 'dul 'dzin yin no// puṇya se nā/ bsod nams sde/ saṃgha se nā/ dge 'dun sde/ puṇya nanda/

bsod nams dga' ba/ dzñā na tsand+ra/ ye shes zla ba/ dzñā na se nā/ ye shes sde/ a shwa mya ngan med pa'i 'tsho ba/ ka rakṣi ta/ sarba thams cad bsrungs pa/ rakṣi ta/ dharme chos kyi mdzod/ ka ṣa ste brgyad ni khu sen gyi 'dul 'dzin yin no// dharma rakṣi ta/ chos kyi bsrungs pa/ ka lyā ṇa rakṣi ta/ dge bsrungs/ pradzñā rakṣi ta/ shes rab bsrungs pa/ shrī marga u pa de sha dpal lam nye bar ston/ mokṣa thar pa bsrungs pa/ rakṣi ta/ ka lyā ṇa bha dra/ dge ba bzang po/ bi dzi ta pra bha wa/ rnam rgyal 'od/ saṃ gha se nā/ dge 'dun sde/ shī la dā sha tshul khrims 'bangs/ ya sho grags pa'i 'bangs/ dā sha buddha dā sha sangs rgyas 'bangs/ shākya bha draḥ/ shākya bzang po/ gu ṇa yon tan zla ba/ swa maḥ/ a shwa mya ngan med pa'i bshes gnyen/ ka mi tra/ shukla mi tra/ dkar po bshes gnyen/ shākya shākya bshes gnyen/ mi tra ste nyi shu po 'di yu gur gyi 'dul 'dzin yin no// shī la mi tra ni ka ma log gi 'dul 'dzin yin no// des sbal ti dgra bcom pa/ skyor mo lung pa bkra shis dpal/ skyor mo lung pa rin chen 'od zer/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan chen bka' bzhi pa blo gsal/ mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ las chen ye shes lhun grub/ rje grol mchog mkhan chen karma bzang po/ rje shākya bstan 'dzin/ shākya nor bu/ kun dga' legs pa/ bshes gnyen rnam rgyal/ smra dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ drung chen sangs rgyas bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ rje bsam gtan phun tshogs/ shar pa rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba mdo rtsa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/

ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ dgra bcom pa nye ba 'khor/ 'phags pa 'od srungs chen po/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa sha na'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa nyi sbas/ dgra bcom pa nag po/ dgra bcom pa dhi dhi ka dgra bcom pa legs mthong*/ phyir 'ong blos mi 'bebs/ slob dpon yon tan 'od/ chos 'di gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun min pa gsan yig gzhan 'gar ma byung*/ kyi bshes gnyen/ slob dpon shākya 'od/ paṇḍi ta seng ge'i gdong pa can/ kha che dzi na mi tra/ paṇa chen dā na shī la/ lo tsā ba cog ro gaṅgā'i chu rgyun na cog ro 'di med pa'ang byung*/ klu'i rgyal mtshan/ g.yo dge 'byung bla chen/ mu thu rwa ba dgongs pa rab gsal/ gung thang pa/ klu mes tshul khrims byang chub/ gru mer tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ skyogs shes rab 'byung gnas/ gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ sog sog chu kha pa/ tshul khrims bla ma/ ko khyim pa ye shes bla ma/ nyang mtshams pa rin chen bla ma/ de gsum char las rgya 'dul ba dbang phyug tshul khrims/ de nas rma tsho byang chub/ yar lung pa'i zur 'chad/ bya 'dul ba brtson 'grus 'bar/ chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi byang chub/ chos kyi na bza' 'phred gsol ba/ brtson 'grus/ chos chos dbang nas 'di'i bar zul thu'i mkhan po yin/ kyi grags pa/ rin chen dpal bzang*/ bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen/ dmar ston rgya mtsho/ rin chen/ byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge kong ston dbang phyug grub pa/ stag phrug kun dga' dpal 'byor/ drung chen thub bstan rnam rgyal/ gling smad rin chen 'byor ldan/ mkhas grub ngag dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang*/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa bsod nams dngos grub/

mkhan chen ngag dbang don grub/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ chos rje bsam gtan pa/ e waṃ pa rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ de las bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis nos so// yang na bya 'dul nas thag ma'i ka ba chen po g.yor po sbal ti dgra bcom pa/ mkhan chen shes rab seng ge bsam yas pa tshul khrims dbang phyug se ba can pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan bka' bzhi pa blo gsal/ dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen/ dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen man 'dra/ yang na dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen nas/ g.yag ston sangs rgyas dpal/ rong ston shes bya kun rig kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel man 'dra/ yang na gaṅgā'i chu rgyun na dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen nas/ chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ slob dpon don grub shes rab/ rje lha mchog seng ge shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub sogs byung yang rmor chen pa'i gsan yul dang sbrel ma thub// ༈ //'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po 'phags pa dge 'dun 'bangs kyi slob ma dgra bcom pa sa ga lhas mdzad pa'i 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa me tog phreng rgyud kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po shākya paṇa chen gsan yig tu pradzñā kīrti'i 'gyur byung*/ shrī dang khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang*/ 'od srungs chen po/ kun dga' bo/ sha na'i gos can/ nyer sbas/ dhi dhi ka nag po pa/ legs mthong*/ dge 'dun 'bangs/ dgra bcom pa sa ga lha/ slob dpon rmor gyi gsan yig na ma ṇi ka shrī zhes snang*/ ma ti ratna/ kha chen paṇa chen shākya shrī/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ seng ge zil gnon/ rin chen bsod nams seng ge

'um phug gnas rnying pa kun dga' dbang phyug mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ bka' bzhi pa shes rab seng ge bka' bzhi pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon dge ba dpal/ mkhas btsun skal bzang dpal/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje shes rab rgya mtsho/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal grub/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho/ rab 'byams phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ drung chen sangs rgyas bkra shis/ gnas gsar ba kun dga' legs 'byung*/ chos rje bsam gtan phun tshogs/ mkhan chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //sa gsum mnga' bdag 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i chos mngon pa kun las btus pa ye shes sdes bsgyur ba'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ rgyal ba ma pham pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ kha che blo gros brtan pa/ paṇḍi ta gang ba spel/ ratna a ka ra shānti/ paṇḍi ta sa'i rtsa lag paṇḍi ta dā na shī la/ dzi na mi tra/ paṇḍi ta shī lend+ra bodhi/ ska ba dpal brtsigs/ cog gru klu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhang 'di la grol mchog gi gsan yig tu mdo sde dpal zhes snang*/ ye shes sde ste lo tsā ba ska cog zhang gsum/ de nas nam nad zla ba'i rdo rje/ khu lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ sbas rgyal ba ye shes/ de gsum ga las cog gru rgyal ba ye shes/ de nas se btsun dbang phyug gzhon nu/ gar mi yon tan g.yung drung*/ khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung*/ rgya tshul le/ rwa ston khri bzang*/ li ston chos grags/ brang ti dar ma snying po/ mchims brtson 'grus seng ge shong blo brtan/ mang mkhar lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ dpang lo blo gros brtan pa/

lo chen byang rtse/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ mkhas pa chos dpal mgon po/ gzad pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ mkhas pa don yod dpal ba/ paṇa chen shāka mchog las chen ye shes lhun grub/ rje grol mchog karma bzang po/ shākya bstan 'dzin/ shākya nor bu/ kun dga' legs pa/ bshes gnyen rnam rgyal/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ drung chen sangs rgyas bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ rje bsam gtan phun tshogs/ e waṃ pa shar chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i shes bya gzhi lnga ston pa chos mngon pa mdzod gnas brgyad kyi bdag nyid can paṇḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba'i steng nas lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan 'od srungs chen po/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa dbyangs sgrogs/ kha che 'dus bzang*/ mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen/ kha che dri med sbas pa/ paṇḍi ta smṛ ti dzñā na shrī/ mngon pa ba shes rab grags/ rwa zhags zla ba/ mchims zhang btsun/ mchims lha rje go cha/ mchims brtson 'grus seng ge mchims don grub rgyal mtshan/ mchims brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ mchims blo gros brtan pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ mkhas pa yon tan 'od zer/ bshes gnyen chos mgon pa/ skyor mo lung pa blo gros bzang po/ dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen/ dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen/ 'ga' khang pa bsod nams tshul khrims/ mkhas pa don yod dpal/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ las chen ye shes lhun grub/ rje grol mchog mkhan po karma bzang po/ rje btsun shākya bstan 'dzin/ shākya nor bu/ mkhan po kun dga' legs pa/ smra dbang ye shes rnam rgyal/ rab 'byams smra ba phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rje btsun ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ sangs rgyas bkra shis/

rje gnas gsar ba/ chos rje bsam gtan phun tshogs/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ de las bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis thob bo// yang na dbyig gnyen nas/ mngon pa rang las mkhas pa kha che blo gros brtan pa/ slob dpon gang ba spel/ mkhas pa shānti pa/ puṇya shī la/ rngog blo ldan shes rab/ mchims lha rje go cha/ mchims brtson 'grus seng ge man 'dra/ yang na dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen nas/ rong ston shes bya kun rig gzad pa blo rgyam/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rje mi bskyod rdo rje/ dkon mchog yan lag dbang phyug rdo rje/ rin chen chos dbang*/ sman lung pa blo mchog rdo rje/ mngon dga' ba rin chen rgya mtsho/ smra dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhas dbang sangs rgyas bkra shis/ rje gnas gsar ba/ bsam gtan phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// smras pa/ nyes med skye rgyu phun tshogs da ltar gyi// cho gas tshigs gsum gdams pa rim nos nas// gnang bkag bslab pa'i blo mig 'byed pa'i gzhung*// yongs grags bstan bcos mig thur gser ri'i grangs// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste bzhi pa'o// //gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim ni/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dang chos 'dzin dang*// chos sgrub pa dang srog chags snying brtse ba// chos bzhi 'di dag yon tan mtha' med de// 'di dag mtha' ni rgyal ba mi gsung ngo*// zhes dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las kyang*/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur// zhes dang*/

bslab btus las/ sdug bsngal mthar 'byin 'dod pa dang*// bde ba'i mthar yang 'gro 'dod pas// dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan bya ste// byang chub la ni blo brtan bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gzhan thams cad srid zhi'i pha rol du son pa'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa don du gnyer ba'i blo gros can rnams kyis/ gnas skabs su lha mi'i go 'phang tsam mam rang don du zhi bde'i mya ngan las 'das pa lhur byed pa'i bsam sbyor thams cad las rgyang bsrings te/ rgyal ba'i myu gu rnams kyi 'jug sgo chen po 'dir 'jug pa la shin tu 'bad dgos te/ ci'i phyir na/ thub pa'i dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba las/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas rdzogs pa yi// sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i sras las 'khrungs// rgyal sras stong nyid snying rje yi// bdag nyid byang chub sems las 'khrungs// zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung ba ltar dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam theg pa chen po'i mdo sde zab mo thams cad kyi brjod bya'i snying po/ rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 'byung gnas srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du bgrod pa'i them skas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga ste de la lugs srol gnyis las/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo dang*/ nam mkha'i snying pos zhus pa la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis gsungs/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub nas brgyud pa/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i bstan bcos las 'byung ba ltar rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa bla na med pa thub pa'i dbang po/ a nutta ra mu nind+raḥ/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ bhaṭṭā ra ka mañdzu shrī swa raḥ/

dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ shrī nā thārya nā gārdzu naḥ/ slob dpon 'phags pa lha/ ā tsāryā rya de waḥ/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa/ ā tsārya tsand+ra kīrtiḥ/ paṇa chen slob pa'i rdo rje/ ma hā paṇḍi ta shiṣya badzra/ slob dpon dgra las rgyal ba/ ā tsārya dze tā riḥ/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ ma hā badzra sa naḥ.a sho ka shrī/ chung ba don yod rdo rje/ apanyā mo gha badzra/ paṇa chen bsod nams dpal/ ma hā pa ṭu puṇya shrīḥ/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ wa ri lo tsā ratna kīrti/ rje sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ ārya ma hā bhū mi paṇḍa gā nanda garbhaḥ/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ ā tsārya puṇya graḥ/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bhaṭṭā ra kīrti dhwa dzaḥ/ chos kyi rgyal po sa skya'i mkhas pa chen po/ dharma sya rā dza bhū mi paṇḍa ra ma hā paṇḍi ta/

'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan/ ārya ratna ma ti dhwa dzaḥ/ 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston/ mṛ du swa ra khonde shi kaḥ/ byang sems rin chen mgon/ bo dhi satwa ratna nā tha/ rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal/ dzi na su to3 saṃ ga bha dra shrīḥ/ sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims dpal/ ma hā satwa shī la shrī/ gzhon nu rgyal mchog ku mā ra dzi notta ma/ 'phags sde dpal ldan grags pa/ ārya se na shrī māṃ ya shaḥ/ mkhan chen grags pa rgya mtsho/ ma ho pa dhyā ya ya shassa mu dra/ mkhan chen rin chen grags pa/ ma ho pa dhyā ya ratna kīrtiḥ/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas bkra shis/ ma ho pa dhyā buddha maṅga laṃ/ mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang*/ ma ho pa dhyā ye shwa ra shrī bha draḥ/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ ma ho pa dhyā ya wa gī sha dharm+ma ya shaḥ/ mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams bkra shis/ ma ho pa dhyā ya mai tri puṇya maṅga laṃ/ sa skya'i lha khang chen mo'i/ grub chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ ma hā siddha buddha sā ga ra/ ngor mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ ngorma ho pa dhyā ya mañdzu gho ṣa buddha lakṣ+mī/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bkra shis bzang po/ des bdag theg pa chen po'i rigs kyi skal ba dang ldan pa btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen la thugs brtse ba chen pos legs par bka' stsal to// bo dhi satwa ma hā satwa maṅga la bha draḥ/ te nātma ka ma hā yā na ku la sya bha ga bāṃ bande shrī la ra rnatnaṃ tsitta ma hā dā yen swā khyā ta/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ sgro mon can pa rin chen dpal bzang*/ byang sems rin chen mgon po man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje/ khro phu bsod nams seng ge kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che/ rgyal sras thogs med man 'dra'o//

༈ //byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la sogs pa mdo sde'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ 'phags pa mi pham mgon pos gsungs/ 'phags pa thogs med nas brgyud pa/ slob dpon chen po tsand+ra go mi'i lugs srol/ rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ rje btsun ma pham pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ mchog gi sde/ dul ba'i sde/ seng ge bzang po/ ku sa li che chung gnyis/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ dpal mar me mdzad/ rgyal ba 'brom ston pa/ spyan snga ba tshul khrims 'bar/ bya yul ba/ rgyal sras mun sman pa'ang zer/ char chen pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims ston/ mkhan chen seng ge skyabs/ mkhas btsun bsod nams ye shes/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ thogs med bzang po dpal/ grub chen buddha shrī/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ mkhan chen ratna shī la/ rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug 'khor lo'i mgon po dbang phyug rab brtan/ 'jam dpal dbyangs ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ 'di man brgyud pa slar brtag de sras ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug lha khang mkhan chen don grub legs bzang yin nam/ mkhas btsun kun dga' sangs rgyas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rgyal sras thogs med pa nas/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bo dong paṇa chen dbyangs can dga' ba/ mkhan chen bsod rgyal/ paṇa chen shāka mchog paṇa chen don yod pa/ rje kun dga' grol mchog

mkhan chen karma bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man gong bzhin no// ༈ //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sbas don mngon par rtogs pa'i don ma nor bar gsal bar ston pa rgyal tshab mi pham mgon pos mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa paṇḍi ta go mi 'chi med dang lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'i steng nas lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang zas gtsang sras po/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa rnam grol sde/ btsun pa rnam grol sde/ mchog gi sde/ dul ba'i sde/ mkhan po rnam par snang mdzad/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ slob dpon yon tan bshes gnyen/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ shar phyogs pa zla ba bzang po/ 'bum phrag gsum pa'ang zer/ slob dpon bstan skyong*/ lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ 'bre shes rab 'bar/ ar byang chub ye shes/ mtshan dngos gzhon nu tshul khrims/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa dkar mo/ shes rab 'bum/ dkar chung ring mo/ byang chub 'bum/ zhang ye ba/ gnyal zhig 'jam dpal rdo rje/ gzad ring dar ma tshul khrims/ bo dong pa brtson 'grus rdo rje/ khro phu ba bsod nams seng ge lha ston grub pa seng ge tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ de las thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal dang mkhas pa lung mang po gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma/ rong ston shes bya kun rig mkhas pa don yod dpal/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ las chen ye shes lhun grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ dol chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub/

bka' 'gyur ba sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ skyor mda' ba mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug mkhas grub sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //yang phar phyin rnying ma 'brom lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po nas/ ku sa li che ba/ ku sa li chung ba/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ jo bo chen po dpal mar me mdzad/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ 'brom ston btsan nam mgo bla ma/ 'bre chen shes rab 'bar man 'dra/ yang khu lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ jo bo rje nas/ khu chen po lha sdings pa/ rgya rgyal ba tshul khrims seng ge li ston chos grags/ 'bre chen po man 'dra'o// ༈ //dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi tshig le'ur byas pa paṇḍi ta ka na ka dang pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ārya de wa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa/ paṇḍi ta rig pa'i khu byug kha che gzhon nu 'bum/ ha su ma ti/ paṇḍi ta gser gyi go cha/ pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags/ rma bya byang chub ye shes/ rma bya byang chub brtson 'grus/ mtshur gzhon nu seng ge rma bya shākya seng ge zhang chos kyi bla ma/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ bcom ldan ral gri/ de gnyis ka las lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin chen grub/ sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal/ g.yag sangs rgyas dpal/ rong ston shes bya kun rig mkhas pa don yod dpal/ paṇa chen shāka mchog las chen ye shes lhun grub/ rje grol mchog bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ dol ba mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho/ smra dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/

drung chen sangs rgyas bkra shis/ rje gnas gsar ba/ chos rje bsam gtan phun tshogs/ e waṃ pa shar chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rje grol mchog nas/ karma bzang po/ shākya bstan 'dzin/ shākya nor bu/ kun dga' legs pa/ bshes gnyen rnam rgyal/ chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ dol pa phyogs las rnam rgyal man 'dra/ yang na pa tshab lo tsā ba nas/ thang sag pa ye shes 'byung gnas/ 'brom dbang phyug grags/ shes rab rdo rje/ ston tshul ba/ bde ba'i lha/ jo btsun pa/ dbu ra ba shes rab dpal/ dharmā shes rab/ shes rab rin chen/ puṇya singha/ bag ston bsam bzang*/ bag ston gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ rong ston man 'dra'o// ༈ //'phags pa yab sras gnyis kyi bzhed pa phyin ci ma log par ston pa slob dpon chen po dpal ldan zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i dbu ma la 'jug pa pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon 'phags pa lha/ slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa/ kha che gzhon nu 'bum/ paṇḍi ta gser gyi go cha/ pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags/ zhang thang sag pa ye shes 'byung gnas/ 'brom dbang phyug grags/ bla ma shes rab rdo rje/ slob dpon ston tshul ba/ bla ma bde ba'i lha/ jo btsun pa/ dbu ra ba/ shes rab dpal/ dharmā shes rab/ bag ston shes rab rin chen/ rje bsod nams seng ge bag ston bsam gtan bzang po/ dmar ston gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ rong ston shes bya kun rig don yod dpal ba/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ rje btsun grol mchog pa/ ri khrod pa kun dga' mchog ldan/ thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ gnas gsar ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho/ smra dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ drung chen sangs rgyas bkra shis/

ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ chos rje bsam gtan phun tshogs/ shar chen rin mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// ༈ //'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnal 'byor spyod pa bzhi brgya la pa tshab lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub dbang*/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon 'phags pa lha/ paṇḍi ta zla ba grags pa/ paṇḍi ta gser gyi go cha/ pa tshab nyi ma grags/ khu mdo sde 'bar/ rma bya byang chub brtson 'grus/ mtshur gzhon nu seng ge rma bya shākya seng ge zhang chos kyi bla ma/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo smon lam tshul khrims/ dbu ma pa byang chub grub/ dbang phyug grags/ 'di'i mtshan btsal/ mkhan bsod nams mtshan can/ rje grags pa rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ karma dkon mchog gzhon nu/ rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ bla ma don yod dpal/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan/ thar rtse paṇa chen/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ drung chen sangs rgyas bkra shis/ rje gnas gsar ba/ chos rje bsam gtan phun tshogs/ kun mkhyen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ des bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //'phags pa byams pas mdzad pa'i theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan paṇḍi ta shākya singha dang lo tsā ba dpal dang slad kyis lo chen blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang*/ byams mgon/ 'phags pa thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ kha che blo gros brtan pa/ slob dpon gang ba spel/ shānti pa/ dzñā na shrī/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ kha che sadzdza na/ pa ra he ta/ rngog blo ldan shes rab/ gnyal ba chos blo/

phywa pa chos kyi seng ge gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge dpal ldan gro mo che/ mchims brtson 'grus seng ge mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyi ston shāka 'bum/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen dol po/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ 'dren mchog ratna wardha/ rje lha mchog seng ge shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen dpal ldan don grub/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ bka' 'gyur ba sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na pa ra hi ta nas/ blo gros grags pa/ mar pa jo 'phan/ mchims ston don grub/ mchims brtson seng man 'dra'o// ༈ //yang mdo sde rgyan dang dbus mtha' rnam 'byed chos nyid rnam 'byed ye shes sde'i 'gyur gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ byams pa mgon po/ 'phags pa thogs med/ mkhas pa dbyig gnyen/ kha che blo gros brtan pa/ paṇa chen rig pa'i khu byug daṃṣṭ+ra se na/ mche ba'i sde/ bha dra pā da/ bzang po'i zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ gaṅgā dha ra/ puṇya shrī/ kha che dgon pa ba/ bram ze saṅgha pa/ kha che dzñā na shrī/ rngog lo tsā ba chen po/ ba reg lo tsā ba rgyal mtshan/ ba reg ston skyabs/ skyes bu yon tan dga'/ bla ma bkra shis rdo rje/ sdong khrod 'dul 'dzin/ nyang ro kun dga' rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs dar ma 'od zer/ khro phu tshad ma'i skyes bu/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ g.yag sangs rgyas dpal/ rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ don yod dpal/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ las chen ye shes lhun grub/ rje grol mchog bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan/

thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang man gong gi mngon rtogs rgyan dang mdo sde rgyan gnyis dang 'dra'o// ༈ //theg pa chen po'i rgyud phyi ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ston par byed pa'i mdo zab mo rnams kyis dgongs pa 'grel pa rgyud bla ma'i tshig le'ur byas pa mi pham mgon gyis mdzad pa paṇḍi ta sadzdza na dang lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba dang*/ chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa zha ma seng rgyal gyis bsgyur ba de gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ byams pa mgon po/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ paṇḍi ta dga' ba'i grags pa/ sadzdza na/ rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ khyung rin chen grags/ rgya dmar ba byang chub grags/ gro lung ba blo gros 'byung gnas/ phywa pa chos kyi seng ge 'dul dkar ba/ gtsang pa 'gre sgur/ sdong khrod 'dul 'dzin/ slob dpon dar ma 'od zer/ lho pa gru pa seng ge slob dpon rig thigs pa/ bu ston rin po che/ thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ kun mkhyen g.yag pa/ rong ston shes bya kun rig don yod dpal/ rje shākya mchog ldan/ rje grol mchog kun dga' mchog ldan/ brang ti paṇa chen/ rje dpal ldan don grub/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ bka' 'gyur ba sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ skyor mda' ba mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na byams pa'i chos sde lnga ga'i lung gi brgyud pa bsod nams dbang phyug yan 'dra/ de nas mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// ༈ //ā tsārya shānta de was mdzad pa'i bslab pa kun las btus pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur la rngog los 'gyur bcos mdzad pa'i steng nas lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/
bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ ā tsārya shānta de wa pa da/ slob dpon e la dha ri/

mi brjed gzungs thob/ dpa' bo'i sde zer/ slob dpon shu raṃ ga se na/ ku sa li che ba rin chen bzang po/ thar rtse paṇa chen gyi gsan yig na 'di gnyis ma byung ba dgos sam mi dgos brtag chung ba rin chen 'od/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ jo bo dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na/ 'brom chos kyi rgyal po/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ chos lung pa shes rab grags/ gtum ston blo gros grags/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang btsun rdo rje 'od/ zhang chos kyi bla ma/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ thar rtse ba'i gsan yig tu gro ston gyi rjes su mchims byas nas bar gyi bla ma gsum med pa zhig byung*/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri/ skyi stod shāka 'bum/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dol po kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ dwags po phyogs las rnam rgyal/ skyed tshal 'og mkhan po/ mkhas pa lha dbang blo gros/ rab 'byams dpal ldan don grub/ kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ dpal 'byor gling pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ nor rgyas gling pa rin chen rgya mtsho/ don grub chos gling pa bstan pa dar rgyas/ dol po smra ba'i seng ge phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ de las bka' 'gyur ba sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dang*/ skyor mda' ba bsod nams dbang phyug gnyis kyis gsan nam/ de nas mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa le'u bcu pa shlau ka stong phrag gcig gi bdag nyid can 'gyur mang du yod pa las lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bcos pa'i steng nas lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

ston mchog shākya'i rgyal po/ mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ rgyal sras shānta de wa/ mi brjed gzungs thob paṇḍi ta e la dha ri/ grub chen dze tā ri/ zla ba grags pa chung ba/ tsand+ra kīrti ki tsu zhes legs sbyar skad du'o/ /jo bo puṇya shrī/ bal po ka na ka pa/ paṇḍi ta su ma ti kīrti/ rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ cha pa chos kyi seng ge slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgya mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'dren mchog ratna wardha/ lha mchog seng ge shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang dpal ldan don grub/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rab 'byams chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ smra ba'i dbang phyug phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rmor chen ngag gi dbang phyug kun dga' lhun grub/ rab 'byams sangs rgyas bkra shis/ rje btsun gnas gsar pa chen po/ chos rje bsam gtan pa/ mkhan chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na mi brjed gzungs thob e la dha ri nas/ dpa' bo'i sde/ shu raṃ ga se na/ gser gling pa/ dharma kīrti/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ po to ba rin chen gsal sha ra ba yan tan grags/ gtum ston blo gros grags/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ ze'u dgra bcom pa man 'dra/ yang na dpal ldan gro nas mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyi ston shāka 'bum/ skyi ston 'jam dbyangs/ kun mkhyen dol po pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/

sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ yang na rngog lo blo ldan shes rab/ zhang tshe spang ba chos kyi bla ma/ nyang bran pa chos kyi seng ge gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge dpal ldan gro mo che/ kun mkhyen mchims/ ze'u dgra bcom pa/ mkhan chen grags pa shes rab/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ ratna wardha man 'dra/ yang na dpal ldan gro nas/ mchims chen nam mkha' grags/ skyi ston shāka 'bum/ grags rgyala'ang zer/ skyi ston 'jam dbyangs/ kun mkhyen dol po pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge mus chen sangs rin/ gnyug la rje btsun ngag dbang grags pa dpal yang zer/ paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa sogs so// yang na rngog lo nas/ khyung rin chen grags/ stod lung rgya dmar ba/ cha pa chos kyi seng ge 'dzad pa ston skyabs/ mus srad pa chen po/ gtsang po ba bsod nams mdzes/ mkhan po byang chub dpal man 'dra/ yang na kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ gnyug la rje btsun ngag dbang grags pa dpal yang zer/ paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa sogs so// yang na rgyal sras zhi ba lha nas/ thams cad rtsegs/ shākya ma ti/ gu ṇa puṇya/ su ma ti kīrti/ rngog man 'dra'o// yang mkhan chen kun dga' tshul khrims nas yar la gong du smos pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang ma 'brel bar du bla ma kha cig btsal dgos/ mkhan chen kun dga' tshul khrims nas/ chos rje buddha shrī bha dra/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bka' drin zla bral 'jam dbyangs bkra shis bzang po/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la legs par stsal to// ༈ //chos kyi rgyal po sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'i rgyal sras lam bzang thub pa'i dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba dang*/

sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i nges gsang bstan bcos sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba gnyis ka'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi ta/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'dul 'dzin/ chos rje byang seng ba/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ rje shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang po/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ chos rje don grub rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sdom gsum rab dbye kho na'i brgyud pa ni dpal mchog rgyal mtshan nas/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na 'dren mchog rje lha mchog seng ge rje shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mtshungs med nam mkha' sangs rgyas man 'dra'o// ༈ //sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sgyu 'phrul rol pa jo bo dī paṃ kā ra shrī dzñā na la shing rta chen po gnyis kyi gdams pa ma lus pa mnga' ba'i bstan bcos mtha' klas na'ang de'i nang nas/ thogs med sku mched kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa lta spyod ston pa sa rgyan gnyis/ klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa'i lta spyod rdzogs par ston pa bslab spyod gnyis/ de thams cad kyi yan lag 'chad pa skyes rabs dang*/ brjod bya sna tshogs pa ston pas nye bar mkho ba ched du brjod pa'i tshoms gnyis te bka' gdams gzhung drug tu grags pa las byang sa dang mdo sde rgyan gnyis kyi phyi ma'i brgyud pa gong grags chen bco brgyad du song ba ltar dang*/

'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa ye shes sde dang klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba bam po nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ rgyal tshab mi pham mgon/ sa gsum mnga' bdag 'phags pa thogs med/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa dbyig gnyen/ kha che blo gros brtan pa/ jo bo puṇya shrī dhā/ gang ba spel/ lo paṇa gsan yig na 'di gnyis bzhugs kyang mkhyen brtse'i der mi bzhugs pas brtag gaṅgā dha ra/ gaṅgā dzi na ratna/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ kha che sadzdza na/ paṇḍi ta sa ra he ta/ 'di lo pa'i gsan yig tu btsan kha bo che dang gcig par mdzad 'dug par dpyad/ bla ma blo gros grags pa/ mar pa jo 'phan/ mchims ston don grub/ mchims brtson 'grus seng ge mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyi ston shākya 'bum/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen dol po/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ de dbon gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ mkhan chen dkon mchog tshul khrims/ thar lam gsal sgron/ lo pa'i gsan yig na 'di bzhin byung ba tshoms sogs kyi brgyud par dkon mchog tshul khrims dang ratna ā ka ra'i bar du bla ma gzhan mi 'dug cing bla ma'i mtshan mi 'dra bas dpyad/ mkhan chen ratna ā ka ra/ gnyug la ngag dbang grags pa/ lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ rje btsun bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ shar chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rtse thang drung chen dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun grub/ pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ kun mkhyen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ zhwa lu mkhan chen gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ rje phun tshogs legs 'byor/ bka' 'gyur ba chen po ngag dbang rab brtan/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/

ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ sku dbon dam pa rin po che chos grub/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// 'di kha cig mdo sde rgyan sger rkyang gi brgyud par mdzad pa yod kyang lo phyogs kyi gsan yig tu sa rgyan gnyis thun mong gi brgyud par mdzad 'dug pa 'brel che ba'i nang du btang ba yin la/ yang mdo sde rgyan sger rkyang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ kha che blo brtan nas/ rig pa'i khu byug mche ba'i sde/ bzang po'i zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ gaṅgā dha ra/ puṇya shrī/ kha che dgon pa ba/ bram ze saṅga*/ kha che ye shes dpal/ rngog lo tsā ba/ ba reg lo tsā ba rgyal mtshan/ ba reg ston skyabs/ skyes bu yon tan dga'/ bkra shis rdo rje/ sdong khrod 'dul 'dzin/ nyang ro kun dga' rdo rje/ dar ma 'od zer/ tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon/ bu ston rin chen grub/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po/ rgyal tshab rje/ gung ru rin byang*/ gnyal ston pa/ chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma grags pa/ chos kyi bshes gnyen/ ra tshag pa blo bzang e waṃ/ rgyal khang rtse pa/ rje pha bong kha pa man 'dra'o// byang sa'i brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thub dbang*/ byams mgon/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ kha che blo brtan/ gang ba spel/ de las dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ kun mkhyen bu dang mkhan ngag chos pa sogs kyi gsan yig na dzi na mi tra nas grus rgyal ba ye shes kyi bar rnams rim pa bzhin du gnang ba las sdebs su gsan pa'i gsal kha ma byung yang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di ltar snang ba nye brgyud ring brgyud kyi khyad yin nam/ ind+ra bhū ti gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum ka las ska ba dpal brtsegs/ cog gru klu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhang ye shes sde gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum las lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/

nam nad zla ba'i rdo rje/ dbas rgyal ba ye shes gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum las grus rgyal ba ye shes kyis gsan/ de nas grub mchog gi ye shes/ se btsun dbang phyug gzhon nu/ mgar mi yon tan g.yung drung*/ khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung*/ ra khri bzang 'od/ rgya rgyal tshul/ li ston chos grags/ de gnyis las brang ti dar ma snying po dang*/ ko ye 'byung gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las rog chos brtson/ de nas mchims brtson seng*/ mchims don ne/ mchims blo brtan/ zhang ston bsod nams rin chen/ bo dong rin rtse/ stag sde ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ drang lung ba thugs rje shes rab/ rin chen ye shes/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ rgya ma ba yon tan 'od/ chos rje bsod nams blo gros/ bka' bcu pa dar ma bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje man gong dang 'dra'o// ༈ //gnyis pa bslab spyod gnyis kyi dang po ā tsarya shāndha de was mdzad pa'i bslab pa kun las btus pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur la rngog los 'gyur bcos mdzad pa'i steng nas lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ ā tsārya shānta de wa pā da/ slob dpon e mi brjed gzungs thob/ la dha ri/ slob dpa' bo'i sde zer/ dpon shu raṃ ga se na/ ku sa li che ba rin chen bzang po/ thar rtse paṇa chen gyi gsan yig na 'di gnyis ma byung ba dgos sam mi dgos brtag chung ba rin chen 'od/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ jo bo dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na/ 'brom chos kyi rgyal po/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ chos lung pa shes rab grags/ gtum ston blo gros grags/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang btsun rdo rje 'od/ zhang chos kyi bla ma/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ thar rtse pa'i gsan yig tu gro ston gyi rjes su mchims byas nas bar gyi bla ma gsum med pa zhig byung*/

mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri/ skyi ston shāka 'bum/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dol po kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ dwags po phyogs las rje phrin las pa/ rnam rgyal/ mkhas pa skyed tshal 'og mkhan po/ lha dbang blo gros/ rab 'byams dpal ldan don grub/ kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ dpal 'byor gling pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ nor rgyas gling pa rin chen rgya mtsho/ don grub chos gling pa bstan pa dar rgyas/ dol po smra ba'i seng ge phyogs las rnam rgyal/ des ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ rje btsun sangs rgyas bkra shis/ gnas gsar pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ sku dbon rin po che chos grub/ de las bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //spyod 'jug gi brgyud pa gong grags chen bco brgyad kyi skabs su gsal ba ltar ro// ༈ //gsum pa skyes tshoms gnyis kyi dang po slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i skyes rabs so bzhi pa lo tsā ba mañdzu shrī warmas bsgyur ba'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras po/ mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ mkhas mchog dpa' bo/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ gser gling pa/ jo bo chen po/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/ lo chung grags 'byor shes rab/ rgya zur khang pa/ kha mo zi'u pa/ gtsang nag pa/ gro mo che pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ bcom ldan ral gri/ skyi ston shāka 'bum/ skyi ston 'jam dbyangs/ kun mkhyen dol po/ sa bzang ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rgyal ba mus pa/

mkhyen rab rje/ stong rwa ba shākya don grub/ de dbon kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba chen po byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ grub chen kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ rje btsun sangs rgyas bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ sku dbon rin po che chos grub/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang brgyud lugs gcig ni mkhas mchog dpa' bo nas/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ shānti pa/ se'u ri pa/ 'jigs med grags pa/ dge 'byung sbas pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che 'bring chung gsum/ chos kyi bshes gnyen/ puṇya shrī/ steng pa lo tsā ba/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ bla ma rgya/ karma pa rang byung rdo rje/ sngags 'chang g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje/ lho rin po che grags pa yon tan/ chos rje grags pa 'byung gnas/ mi pham gnyis pa tshul khrims dar/ spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan man sa rgyan thun mong gi brgyud pa dang gcig yang na slob dpon dpa' bo nas legs ldan 'byed/ zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug ku mā ra lakṣa/ ha su ma ti/ dza ya ā nanda/ khu lo tsā ba/ legs ldan pa/ gtsang nag pa/ gshen chu skor ba/ gtsang pa jo nag pa/ 'od zer mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs shākya gzhon nu/ rje rang byung rdo rje man 'dra'o// ༈ //

'di sngar ma thob kyang bka' gdam gzhung drug kha tshang ba'i phyir slar zhu ba'i rtsis su bris/ dgra bcom pa chos skyob kyis bsdus pa'i ched du brjod pa'i tshoms dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa rakṣi ta/ dgra bcom pa chos skyob/ dgra bcom pa kṛṣṇa'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa sha na'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa/ rgyal rigs thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs/ slob dpon ārya de wa/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pa/ ratna ā ka ra shānti/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ bar pa/ chung ba/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dpyal chos kyi bzang po/ dpyal padmo can/ mkhan po gzhon nu ye shes/ rong pa shes rab seng ge bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ stong ra ba shākya don grub/ de dbon kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub bkra shis bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas man chad gong gi skyes rabs so bzhi pa'i brgyud pa dang 'dra'am snyam mo// 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i mdo kun las btus pa ye shes sdes bsgyur ba'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni dbu ma rtsa ba'i shes rab dang 'dra'o// ༈ // 'di de sngon ma thob kyang thob 'gyur gyis bris/ 'jig rten dbang phyug bzang po dpal gyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig gi steng nas theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong nyams khrid du legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/

ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ rgyal tshab byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa rnam grol sde/ btsun pa rnam grol sde/ paṇḍi ta gu ṇa mi tra/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po/ bshes gnyen gang ba spel/ ku sā li che chung gnyis/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha rgyal ba 'brom/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ 'chad ka ba ye shes rdo rje/ se spyil bu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi grags zhes pa'ang byung ba brtag lha spyil bu ba lha chen po dbang phyug gzhon nu'am dbang phyug rin po che/ lha lung gi dbang phyug ces grags pa dang 'di gnyis mi gcig pas ma nor dgos/ 'od zer bla ma/ 'di la gaṅgā'i chu rgyun du jo bo'i chos 'byung na byang chub 'od zer dang lo pa spyan snga'i gsan yig na skyes mchog lha chen zer ba snang gsungs/ lha sdings pa byang chub 'bum/ lo pa spyan snga pa'i gsan yig na shes rab 'bum zhes 'dug gsungs/ lha sdings dbon po kun dga' rgya mtsho/ thar rtse pa dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse ngag chos gsum gyi gsan yig na 'di gnyis lha sdings pa yon tan dpal zhes gcig tu bgrangs 'dug kyang ngor chen dang lo pa spyan snga sgrub khang pa gsum gyi gsan yig na 'di bzhin byung bas bla ma gnyis kyi mtshan gcig tu 'dus pa'i bris nor byung ngam snyam/ tshogs pa'i dbu mdzad yon tan dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ mkhan chen bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal/ rgya ma ba yon tan 'od/ 'phags pa blo 'phel ba/ spyan snga tshul khrims dar ma/ spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ rgyal sras bsod nams legs mchog paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa dpal bzang*/ gnyug la paṇa chen/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/

mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ bka' 'gyur ba sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ skyor mda' ba mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rgyal sras thogs med nas/ mang mkhar ba tshul khrims dpal/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ chos rje byams pa chos legs/ mkhan chen rdo rje rin chen/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na slob dpon dbyig gnyen nas/ kha che blo gros brtan pa/ ku sā li che chung gnyis man 'dra/ yang na rgyal sras thogs med dpal nas/ gnyags dbon bsod nams bzang po/ mtshan ldan zhig mo rang grol/ kun dga' dpal mo/ rje ngag dbang grags pa dpal bzang*/ lo pa ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra/ yang na rgyal sras rin po che nas/ mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen grags pa bshes gnyen/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen kun blo ba/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag gi dbang po/ ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra/ yang na rgyal sras rin po che nas/ mang mkhar tshul khrims dpal/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ gung ru shes rab bzang po/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra/ yang na sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog nas/ ri pa dpal ldan grags/ mkhan chen grags pa rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen rin chen grags pa/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas bkra shis/ mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang*/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/

dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags nas/ bla ma dpal ldan chos 'byor/ lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra/ yang na sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan nas/ byams chen rab 'byams pa/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang*/ mkhas pa lha dbang blo gros/ rje byams pa phun tshogs/ 'bum mo che pa dpal 'byor shes rab/ ngor sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub man 'dra/ yang na rgyal sras thogs med dpal nas/ grub chen buddha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o// ༈ //rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal gyi dngos slob rje dpal ldan ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo'am/ blo sbyong gsung sgros mar grags pa'i lo rgyus gdams pa dngos dang bcas pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med dpal nas/ 'gro mgon dpal ldan ye shes/ gzhon nu rgyal mchog mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ gung ston shes rab bzang po/ gnyug la ngag dbang grags pa/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ // 'di de sngon ma thob blar thob 'gyur gyis bris/ sum pa lo tsā ba dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rjes rgya gar du byon dus mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje'i tshig bzhi pa rje btsun ma sgrol mas gsungs pa la brten nas thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i/

sum pa lo tsā ba'i blo sbyong snyan brgyud du grags pa kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zin bris kyi steng nas nyams khrid du legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ sum pa lo tsā ba/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ lo pa ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' ba bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan nas/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen byams pa rab brtan/ rje snying rje bzang po/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ grub thob mtsho 'dar phyar min/ 'phrang ba rin chen bzang po/ mkhas grub chos rje/ ri khrod ras chen/ pradzñā bho dhi/ don zhags pa sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'khrul zhig grags pa tshul khrims/ mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po/ mkhan chen bsod nams rin chen/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po man 'dra'o// ༈ // 'di ma thob kyang thob 'gyur gyis bris/ mkhas pa chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog dang mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpon slob gnyis kyis theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi rgya gzhung bod gzhung shin tu gces pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i skor la/

mus chen sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i glegs bam (ka)dkar chag jo bo chen po lha gcig gis rgyal srid spangs nas thar par byon pa'i rnam par (ka)thar pa bla ma'i yon tan chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ jo bo rjes mnyam med gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa'i drung du byang chub kyi sems 'tshol pa'i slad du dka' ba spyad nas byon pa'i rnam (ka)thar jo bo chen po nyid kyis gsungs pa/ jo bo chen po a ti shas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i (ka)gzhung rgyas pa mchan rtsa ba 'di gnyis la mang nyung yod pas lung so sor gnang ba de ka dngos gtsang ngo*// bcas de las btus pa'i rtsa (ka)ba mchan med gcig 'gor bde legs kun 'byung rin thang med pa'i sku/ zhes yod pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i 'grel pa bka' gdams (ka)yang snying ngo mtshar che'o'i mtha' can/ 'jigs pa'i gcan gzan sna tshogs rgyu ba'i nags khrod du lung rigs dang rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po dharma rakṣi tas bla ma dam pa'i gsung ltar bsdebs nas jo bo a ti sha la gnang ba'i dgra bo gnad la dbab pa'i blo sbyong mtshon cha (kha)'khor lo/ ri nag po'i khong gseng na gnas pa'i bla ma dam pa bshad ma thag pas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong rma bya dug (kha)'joms/ bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i gyer sgom rdo rje'i glu (ga)blangs pas chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du byams pa lha'i rgyal po'i cha byad kyis gsungs pa jo bo chen pos bod du lkog khrid du mdzad pa/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa lugs kyi blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las nyon mongs (ga)pa gtan la dbab pa'i chos/ blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las bzlog phyogs (ga)gnyen po'i chos/ blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las rang rgyud ngan dma' dbab (ga)pa'i chos/ blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las zag bcas dge ba'i stobs bskyed (ga)pa'i chos/

gser gling pas jo bo la mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i ched du gnang ba'i (nga)blo sbyong gi rtsa ba nyon mongs lam du blang ba'i man (ca)ngag nyon mongs pa thams cad la sbyar bar shes par bya ba/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sbyor dngos mjug (ca)gsum gyis bstan pa spyil bu pa'i zhal nas nga'i snying phyung nas bstan kyang sha dmar lhog lhog pa kham gcig las mi gda' zhes bsngags par mdzad pa/ yi ge gsum la (ca)brten nas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba/ 'di la lung rgyun snang bas dkar chag dang gsan yig na mi gsal ba chad dam snyam/ rdo rje sems dpa' la brten nas sha 'khon sbyong ba'i man (ca)ngag rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs nas rnal 'byor ma gnyis kyis dri ba dris lan gyi tshul gyis jo bo chen po la sems sbyong (cha)bar bskul nas gnang ba'i blo sbyong*/ jo bo chen pos gsungs pa'i phan yon brgyad dang ldan pa'i ku sa li'i tshogs (cha)gsog kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po shākya shrīs khro phu lo tsā bar gnang ba'i blo sbyong skyid (ja)sdug lam 'khyer gyi man ngag go'i mtha' can/ grub thob sum pa lo tsā ba la mkha' 'gro ma dmar sngo gnyis kyis dri ba dris lan gyi tshul gyis gnang ba'i snyan brgyud (nya)blo sbyong 'chi rgyu med pa lags so'i mtha' can/ rigs gsum mgon po las byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mdzad pa rlabs che bar bstan pa'i kun tu bzang po'i blo sbyong (ta)'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'byung gsung ba'i mtha' can/ jo bo chen po la byang chub kyi sems ston pa'i bla ma gsum gyi nang nas gser gling pa lhag pa'i lo rgyus dang bcas pa'i blo sbyong thun brgyad (tha)ma zho sha mi bsri bar phan 'dogs gsung ba'i mtha' can/ thun brgyad ma lag len du byed tshul dge bshes ston pa'i (tha)man ngag la zas la brten pa'i blo sbyong le'u dang po/ dbugs la brten pa'i blo sbyong le'u gnyis pa/

lus gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du sprul nas rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i blo sbyong le'u gsum pa/ sha khrag gtong ba'i blo sbyong le'u bzhi pa/ gtor ma la brten pa'i blo sbyong le'u lnga pa/ 'byung ba la brten pa'i blo sbyong le'u drug pa/ lus yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher sprul pa'i blo sbyong le'u bdun pa/ 'chi kha ma'i blo sbyong gi man ngag le'u brgyad pa rnams/ ltas ngan g.yang du lon pa sogs man ngag bzhi la brten pa'i blo sbyong gegs sel (tha)'dod thog tu byed pa yin gyi mtha' can/ brjed pa'i gnas bzhi dang 'chor ba'i gnas bzhi la brten pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i 'gal rkyen spong ba'i blo sbyong (tha)dpal mar me mdzad nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa/ 'gor dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi lam gyi mchog /ces yod pa'i jo bo'i blo sbyong (da)don bdun ma mdo dang bstan bcos rnams la legs par blta'o'i mtha' can/ blo sbyong yid bzhin nor bu dang lhan thabs bzhi pa che bar yang grags/ blo sbyong thun gcig (na)ma zhes pa dpal snar thang gi mkhan po mchims nam mkha' grags pas mdzad pa/ mnyam med jo bo chen po bod du 'byon khar rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu la spyi chos su (pa)gdams pa/ dpal ldan birwa pa'i blo sbyong dar paṇa gyi gsung glo bo lo tsā ba'i khrid yig mnyam med snying rje'i (pha)man ngag dge ba'i bshes gnyen glang thang pa chen pos mdzad pa'i blo sbyong tshig rkang brgyad ma'i rtsa (ba)ba la 'chad ka bas 'grel pa mdzad pa smon lam yang yang gdab par bya'o'i mtha' can/ de'i zhar byung du a tsa ra gzugs ngan gyi gtam rgyud yod pa/ mgon po a ti sha la gser gling pa chos kyi grags pas gsungs pa'i gong gi mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i (da)rtsa ba 'dra min la 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsung bar gda' 'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor byams pa thogs med la sogs dang*/ zhes yod pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma sde snod thams cad kyi bcud tig pa'i nying (da)khu'o'i mtha' can/
'gor kun mkhyen thugs ni brtse ba'i dbang bsgyur cing*/ zhes yod pa'i snar thang pa sangs rgyas sgom pas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong tshogs (cha)bshad chen mo/

zhang ratna gu ru'i tshogs chos kyang zer/ 'dus byas la rtag pa med kyi zhes sogs rgyal ba yang dgon pas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong nyams len gnad thog (ma)tu skyong ngo'i mtha' can/ jo bo rje lha gcig gi blo sbyong byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas na rten 'brel (tsa)snying po zhes bya'o'i mtha' can rnams dang*/ rten 'brel snying po'i khrid kyang zer/ dkar chag tu mi gsal ba blo sbyong (ka)gsung sgros ma'i kha skong du mus chen sems dpa' chen pos sangs rgyas sgom pa'i tshogs bshad nas btus te mdzad pa rnams legs par thob pa'i ka'i rtags yod pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po/ ma pham byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ gu ṇa mi tra/ seng ge bzang po/ gang ba spel/ dge ba can che chung gnyis/ gser gling pa chos grags pa/ jo bo chen po a ti sha 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu ba/ lha lung gi dbang phyug ston pa/ lha sdings 'gro ba'i mgon po/ de dbon kun dga' rgya mtsho/ dbu mdzad yon tan dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med bzang po/ mang mkhar ba tshul khrims dpal/ sems dpa' gzhon nu rgyal mchog mun chen sems dpa' chen po/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mus pa grub mtshan dngos bsod nams lhun grub yin/ pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'khon ston bsod nams dbang phyug lha khang mkhan chen don grub legs bzang*/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/

sku dbon rin po che chos grub/ de yis bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// kha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang*/ byams pa/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ bla ma dharma rakṣi ta/ jo bo chen po/ 'brom/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu ba/ skyes mchog lha chen/ lha 'gro ba'i mgon po/ 'od 'jo ba/ mkhan po dmar ston/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ don zhags pa sangs rgyas rin chen/ bla ma grags pa tshul khrims/ chos rje rgyal ba bzang po/ gnubs chos lung pa bsod nams rin chen/ mkhan chen gzhon nu rgyal mchog man 'dra/ ga'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ jo bo chen po man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/ nga'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ blo gros brtan pa/ ku sā li che chung gnyis/ bla ma gser gling pa/ jo 'brom yab sras/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ mal dro ba/ brag dmar ba/ zhang brag dkar ba/ bla ma dkon mchog byang chub/ gzhon nu grags pa/ slob dpon zhang*/ shes rab bsod nams/ slob dpon brtson 'grus/ slob dpon chos mchog don zhags pa man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/ ca'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ ku sa li gnyis/ gser gling pa/ jo 'brom/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ spyil bu ba/ slob dpon lha/ lha sdings dbon po/ chos kyi seng ge rgya ston byang rgyal/ mkhan po gzhon byang*/ rin chen 'byung gnas dpal/ don zhags pa man 'dra/ cha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo sgrol ma/ khro gnyer can/ jo 'brom gnyis/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ gtsang pa rin po che/ glang lung pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ zam se rin sangs pa/ sgom pa byang skyabs/ ye shes zhabs/ shī la badzra/ don zhags pa man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/ ja'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kha che paṇa chen/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ lho brag pa byang chub dpal/

mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen grags pa bshes gnyen/ gnubs chos lung pa bsod nams rin chen man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/ yang na mkhan chen bde ba dpal nas bka' bzhi pa grags gzhon/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ rje tshul khrims dpal/ gzhon nu rgyal mchog man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/ nya'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo/ sgrol ma/ sum pa lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan/ rje sa paṇa/ grub thob 'dar phyar/ mkhas grub chos rje/ ri khrod ras chen shes rab byang chub/ don zhags pa man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa man skyid sdug lam khyer dang 'dra/ ta'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo chen po/ 'dzeng dgon pa ba dbang rgyal/ sne'u zur pa/ sgyer sgom pa/ sangs rgyas dbon ston gzhon nu 'byung gnas/ zangs dgon pa/ mkhan po chos ldan pa/ slob dpon shākya bkra shis/ rgya ma ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ don zhags pa man 'dra/ tha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ grol sde gnyis/ mchog gi sde/ dul ba'i sde/ rnam snang mdzad/ seng bzang rin po che'i mdo/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa sku mched gsum/ gsum gas glang thang pa rdo rje seng ge dang sha bo sgang pa gnyis la gnang*/ de gnyis kyis slob dpon zhang zhung pa dang ti tang bu khur gnyis la gnang*/ de gnyis kyis sangs rgyas jo bo la gnang*/ de nas lung nang mkhan po/ gaṅgā'i chu rgyun du lo pa'i gsan yig na lung sgom pa dang mkhan po rin chen zhes so sor phral 'dug gsungs/ 'brom ston sher rin/ slob dpon gzhon nu bsam gtan/ don zhags pa man 'dra/ da'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ ḍombi pa/ jo bo rje/ 'dzeng dbang rgyal/ po to ba/

glang thang pa/ rgya lcags ri ba/ lha ri rtsa brgyad pa/ dwags po lha rje/ phag mo gru pa/ rgya sgom zhig po/ rgya mkhar ri pa/ brag dmar ba man mtha' 'khob 'dul ba dang 'dra/ na'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo 'brom gnyis/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu ba/ lha dbon po/ gnas brtan 'dul 'dzin/ mchims chen mo/ mchims yon tan bla ma/ 'gro mgon bshes gnyen/ don zhags pa man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/ pa'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo 'brom yab sras/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu ba/ lha spyil bu ba/ lha 'gro mgon/ 'dod 'jo ba/ mkhan po dmar ston/ jo gdan rlung shod pa/ bshes gnyen shes rab bzang po/ don zhags pa man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/ pha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ birwa pa/ ḍombi pa/ dpal 'dzin/ ma ti pa/ niska laṅka*/ re wend+ra/ chag chos rje dpal/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ blo gros dpal/ ye shes zhabs bzang po/ don zhags pa man 'dra/ ba'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ grol sde gnyis/ seng bzang*/ dge ba can che chung*/ gser gling pa/ jo 'brom gnyis/ po to ba/ glang ri thang pa/ glang thang zhang zhung pa/ sangs rgyas jo bo/ lung sgom pa/ mkhan po rin chen/ 'brog ston sher rin/ slob dpon gzhon bsam/ don zhags pa man 'dra/ ma'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa nas bla ma gnyis tsam zhig ma rnyed/ de nas byang sems gzhon nu rgyal mchog man 'dra/ tsa'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ byams pa/ gser gling pa/ jo 'brom gnyis/ po to ba/ lcags ri ba/ chos kyi g.yung drung*/ snye phu rgya sgom/ brag ram pa/ nyan chen pa/ shes rab 'bum/ thogs med bzang po dpal/ mang mkhar tshul khrims dpal/ sems dpa' gzhon nu rgyal mchog man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra'o// ༈ //rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos zla ba drug gi bar du 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe 'jam dpal dbyangs gtso 'khor gsum pa zhal gzigs pa'i dus su 'jam dpal gtso bos dngos su gsungs pa'i blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral/

de'i 'grel pa rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ 'gor rje btsun chen po sa skya pa'i zhal nas zhes yod pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa nub pa rig 'dzin grags kyis mdzad pa/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi dmigs khrid byang chub sems dpa' rwa lod rdo rjes bskul ba la brten nas kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa/ khrid yig bla ma kun dga' legs pa'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas dge slong kun dga' legs pa'i rin chen gyis zin bris su bkod de chos kyi rgyal po rdo rje 'chang la gzigs su phul nas dag par byas pa rnams kyi lung khrid legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ mus chen nam mkha' dbang phyug rje bkra shis brtan pa/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mus pa grub pa'i dbang po/ dpal sa skya pa khri chen kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang bla ma ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa nas brgyud pa 'di rje grol mchog pa'i khrid brgya'i dbu nas 'byung ba'i khrid yig la rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa dang nub pa rig 'dzin grags kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge rnams kyis rgyas bkab ste mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas rje bkra shis lhun grub pa sogs la stsal 'dug pa de min pa gzhan nas gsan pa'i brgyud pa ni gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por mi bzhugs 'dug pas 'di de'i dbang du btang ba yin/

'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug rje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog rje bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ lcags zam pa ngag dbang nyi ma/ dge steng bla ma kun dga' dpal bzang*/ lcags zam sprul sku kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug de sras sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bka' drin can 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// rmor chen pa'i gsan yig las 'byung ba ni/ mus chen nam mkha' dbang phyug yan gong bzhin las/ de nas stong rwa ba kun dga' legs grub/ de gnyis ka las she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ rmor pa grub dbang kun dga' rnam rgyal/ sems dpa' chen po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' ba mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge nas/ kong ston dbang phyug grub pa/ rje bkra shis brtan pa man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug rje dkon mchog 'phel/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rnam 'dren mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ gu ge paṇa chen/ rwa ston yon tan dpal bzang*/

glo bo mkhan chen/ dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// ༈ //dpal mnyam med dī paṃ kā ra shrī dzñā na'i thugs dam du mdzad pa'i chos chung brgya rtsar grags pa/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta dī paṃ kā ra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 1 spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma jo bos nai pā la'i yul du grogs po'i don du mdzad pa paṇḍi ta de nyid dang nag tsho lo tsā'i 'gyur/ 2 bden pa gnyis la 'jug pa gser gling rgyal pos dge slong de wa ma ti btang ba'i ngor jo bos mdzad pa paṇḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng gi 'gyur/ 3 dbu ma'i man ngag jo bo dang nag tsho lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ 4 snying po bsdu ba jo bo dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims 'byung gnas de ba rtsa'i 'gyur/ 5 snying po nges par bsdu ba jo bos snye thang du mdzad pa paṇḍi ta de nyid dang nag tsho lo tsā'i 'gyur/ 6 byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i phreng ba jo bo nyid kyis sgra rang bsgyur du mdzad pa/ 7 byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdo tsam gdams ngag tu byas pa 'gyur byang mi gsal ba/ 8 'khor ba las yid nges par 'byung bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i glu jo bo dang lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng gis bsgyur ba la slar yang nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas 'gyur bcos mdzad pa/ 9 tshul khrims kyi spyod pa'i glu paṇḍi ta badzra pā ṇi dang chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 10 chos kyi dbyings su blta ba'i glu jo bo dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 11 dran pa gcig pa'i man ngag jo bos lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i ngor mdzad pa lo paṇa de gnyis kyi 'gyur/ 12 byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa'i lam la 'jug par bstan pa jo bos lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi don du mdzad pa paṇḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 13 skyabs su 'gro ba bstan pa 'gyur byang mi gsal ba/

14 theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs yi ge bsdus pa jo bo dang lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 15 theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa 'gyur byang gong 'dra/ 16 rang gi bya ba'i rim pa bskul ba dang bcas pa yi ger bris pa 'gyur byang gong dang 'dra ba/ 17 mdo sde'i don kun las btus pa'i man ngag jo bo dang nag tsho lo tsā'i 'gyur/ 18 mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bstan pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ 19 las rnam par 'byed pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra/ 20 ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u jo bo dang dge slong shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 21 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga 22 kha ton dang glegs bam bklag pa'i sngon du bya ba'i cho ga 23 pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i sātstsha gdab pa'i cho ga 24 bla ma'i bya ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa gong gsal bzhi po de la 'gyur byang mi gsal/ 25 sems bskyed pa dang sdom pa'i cho ga'i rim pa jo bo dang dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur slar yang paṇḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bcos shing gtan la phab pa/ 26 chos tshan nyer drug po 'di rnams dpal dī paṃ kā ra nyid kyis mdzad pa yin/ slob dpon byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho ga paṇḍi ta puṇya shrī mi tra dang lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ 27 dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga paṇḍi ta su rend+ra bo dhi dang bande ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 28 slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang yi dam blang ba'i cho ga mkhan po chen po su ma ti kīrti dang lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 29 slob dpon mkhas pa chen po byang chub sems dpa' dgra las rnam rgyal gsang ba'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa'i las dang po pa'i sa sbyang ba slob dpon kṛṣṇa pa dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/

30 des mdzad pa'i sems rin po che rnam par sbyang ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba'i spring yig ā tsāryā du lo pa dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 31 slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bshes pa'i spring yig slob dpon sarba dzñā de wa dang lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 32 mkhas pa tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa'i slob ma la springs pa'i yi ge lo paṇa bshad ma thag pa'i 'gyur/ 33 slob dpon ma ti tsi

ma khol/ tras mdzad pa'i rgyal po ka ni ka la springs pa'i yi ge paṇḍi ta bidyā kā ra pra bha dang lo tsā ba rin chen mchog gis bsgyur ba slar yang ā tsāryā dpal brtsegs kyis bcos pa/ 34 slob dpon don yod 'char gyis rgyal po snyan ngag mkhan la gdams pa'i dri ma med pa'i dris lan rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta ka ma la gupta dang lo chen rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 35 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis dge slong rab gsal gzhon nu la springs pa sarba dzñā de ba dang lo tsā ba bande dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 36 slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa lo paṇa bshad ma thag pa'i 'gyur/ 37 slob dpon btsun pa chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon dharma kā ra dang lo tsā ba gtsang de wend+ra rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ 38 slob dpon mkhas mchog rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bstan pa slob dpon a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 39 btsun pa chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bstan pa paṇa chen buddha kā ra warma dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 40 slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i mya ngan bsal ba zhes bya ba slob dpon a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 41 slob dpon gsang ba byin gyis mdzad pa'i gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs pa brjod pa 'gyur byang med pa/ 42 slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i yon tan bdun yongs su brjod pa'i gtam paṇḍi ta gaṅgā dha ra dang lo chen rin bzang gi 'gyur/ 43 des mdzad pa'i tshul khrims kyi gtam slob dpon dza len dha ra dang lo tsā ba rin bzang gi 'gyur/ 44 des mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi gtam paṇḍi ta gaṅgā dha ra dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/

45 slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i mi khom pa brgyad kyi gtam slob dpon a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 46 slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i legs par bshad pa rin po che za ma tog lta bu'i gtam le'u brgyad pa slob dpon ru tra dang lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ dpa' bos mdzad pa'i maṇḍal zhes pa'ang 'di nas zur du phyung ba snang ngo*// 47 slob dpon ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa'i phyin ci log bzhi spong ba'i gtam paṇḍi ta buddha bha dra dang lo tsā ba rin bzang gi 'gyur/ 48 des mdzad pa'i rtsod pa'i dus kyi gtam slob dpon a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 49 slob dpon sa 'tsho byin gyis mdzad gsan yig 'ga' zhig tu chos byin zer ba 'di yin/ pa'i dben pa'i gtam paṇḍi ta dī paṃ kā ra dang lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 50 slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rin chen phreng ba las byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu pa/ 51 des ba tsha can gyi chu klung gi mdo las phyung ba'i sems can mgu bar bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu gcig pa slob dpon buddha kā ra warma dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 52 slob dpon btsun pa gzhan la phan pa'i dbyangs dgon pa pas mdzad pa'i smon lam bdun cu pa zhes bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa paṇḍi ta dharma shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba dpal gyi lhun po'i sde'i 'gyur/ ma hā paṇḍi ta dpa' bo stag gis mngon par gtses te nags khrod du snying rje chen pos kun nas blangs te smon lam 'di mdzad ces kyang gsung ngo*// 53 slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i don dam byang chub sems sgom pa'i rim pa rin po che'i sgron ma zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta padmā ka ra warma dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 54 des mdzad pa'i kun rdzob byang chub sems sgom pa'i man ngag padma spungs pa zhes bya ba lo paṇa bshad ma thag pa'i 'gyur/
