sems ni ras yug dkar po 'dra zhes sogs shlau ka bzhi pa zhig 'dug pa bstan bcos rtsom pa po'i gsung yin nam the tshom du mdzad do// 55 slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdo las phyung ba'i 'phags pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa/ 56 chos rjes su dran pa/ 57 dge 'dun rjes su dran pa/ 58 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga'i nyes dmigs bshad pa dang bcas pa'i bzhi slob dpon dharma shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 59 'phags pa rtog pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo sde las byung ba'i sdig pa bshags pa'i cho ga 60 bslab pa kun las btus las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa'i bsrung ba dang sdig pa bshags pa'i cho ga slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa/ 61 slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i mdo sngags gnyis thun mong ba'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga 'gyur byang mi gsal ba/ 62 slob dpon dgra las rnam rgyal gsang bas mdzad pa'i maṇḍal 'bul ba'i cho ga a du lo pa dang chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 63 dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon mkhas pa chen po rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ 64 slob dpon rnyog pa med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga slob dpon a du lo pa dang lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 65 slob dpon kaṃ ma las mdzad pa'i sngags kyi maṇḍal gyi cho ga 'gyur rnying*/ dpe la lar ka ma la shī las mdzad ces byung yang ka ma la shī la ni padma'i ngang tshul zhes par 'gyur la kaṃ ma la ni zla bar 'jug go/ 66 slob dpon byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u zhes bya ba slob dpon bi na ya tsand+ra dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 67 slob dpon nag po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/

68 slob dpon a wa dhū tī pas mdzad pa'i bsam gtan gyi chos drug rnam par gzhag pa slob dpon dharma shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba rin bzang gi 'gyur/ 69 de'i 'grel pa slob dpon dā na shī las mdzad pa 'gyur byang gong dang 'dra ba/ 70 sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las byung ba'i gnas dang spyad par mi bya ba ste ting nge 'dzin ga mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnam par gzhag pa rgya nag gi mkhan po hwa shang zab mo dang lo tsā ba rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'gyur/ 71 dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor rtog pa'i gegs sel zhes bya ba 'gyur rnying yin zhing 'di gsang sngags yo ga'i rgyud la brten nas bshad pa 'dra zer ba snang ngo*/ 72 /mkhas pa chen po byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid bden pa 'gyur byang mi gsal ba/ 73 slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la 'jug pa slob dpon pradzñā warma dang lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 74 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhabs kyi padma'i ze'u 'bru spyi bos len pa'i sde snod gsum pa slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i lam 'gyur byang mi gsal ba/ 75 slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa slob dpon dharma shrī dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 76 slob dpon dge ba'i go chas mdzad pa'i mi sdug pa sgom pa'i rim pa 'gyur rnying*/ 77 slob dpon nag po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i lus yongs su dpyad pa'i sgom pa'i rim pa slob dpon de nyid dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'di'i brjod don lus kyi phyi nang la dpyad cing bsgom pa'i don yin pas das 'bul can min pas mgo can du mi 'dri'o// 78 slob dpon chen po dpal ye shes grags pas mdzad pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa sgom pa'i rim pa'i man ngag slob dpon padmā ka ra warma dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/

79 dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon ma hā ma tis mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bla na med par sgom pa'i mdo'i rjes su 'gro ba zhes pa ā tsārya bi na ya tsand+ra dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'di'i mjug tu mi mchog gang zhig gis ni zhes sogs tshig 'bru bcu gcig snang ba sus mdzad ma nges/ 80 slob dpon chos kyi dbang pos mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i man ngag slob dpon dza lan dha ra dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ phyogs glang gis mdzad pa dang 'di gnyis bstan bcos rgya chen po ni thos nas kyang zhes pa nas bzung ste mang po rnams ni yang dag rdzogs par 'gyur zhes pa'i bar shin tu 'dra bar yod kyang mgo mjug mi gcig pas so sor bzhed do// 81 slob dpon mkhas pa chen po rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom pa'i man ngag slob dpon shānti bha dra dang lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ 82 slob dpon ye shes zla bas mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sgom pa'i don mdor bsdus te bstan pa slob dpon pradzñā warma dang lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 83 mkhas pa chen po dze tā ris mdzad pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon shānti bha dra dang dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 84 slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i yon tan bdun bstan pa'i gtam paṇḍi ta ka ma la gupta dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 85 mkhan po zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i bslab pa kun las btus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ 86 de'i mngon par rtogs pa dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa paṇḍi ta de nyid dang nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 87 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i theg pa chen po nyi shu pa kha che ā nanda dang lo tsā ba grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/

88 des mdzad pa'i 'phags pa sa lu ljang pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa paṇḍi ta dharma shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba legs pa'i blo gros dang dzñā na ku mā ra'i 'gyur la slad kyis dpal brtsegs rakṣi tas bcos pa/ 89 des mdzad pa'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ 90 des mdzad pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i rnam par bshad pa/ 91 de gnyis la 'gyur byang mi gsal/ des mdzad pa'i rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu'i gtam zhes pa kha che shrī ra tha dang lo tsā ba grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 92 des mdzad pa'i byang chub sems kyi rnam par bshad pa chos 'di'i mdzad pa po'i che ba dang brjod bya bzang ba dang rjod byed dbyings su gyur pa'i stobs kyis rtsal phyung zhing bsgyur ba mang du snang ba las lo tsā ba rab zhi chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis bsgyur ba la gzhi byas gu rub chos kyi shes rab/ seng dkar shākya 'od/ shes rab grags pa/ mar pa chos dbang*/ pa tshab nyi ma grags/ mang nad grags 'byor shes rab bdun gyi 'gyur las don gang bzang phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa 'di la byang chub sems 'grel du grags/ 93 des mdzad pa'i bla na med par bstod pa paṇḍi ta lo tra dang lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 94 des mdzad pa'i srid pa las 'das par bstod pa kha che shrī ra tha dang lo tsā ba grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 95 slob dpon dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa'i yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa paṇḍi ta sarb+ba dzñā de wa dang lo tsā ba rin chen mchog gi 'gyur la bande dpal brtsegs kyis bcos pa/ 96 de'i 'grel pa slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa lo paṇa bshad ma thag pa'i 'gyur/ 97 yang des mdzad pa'i yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa'i don gyi tshig le'ur byas pa lo paṇa bshad ma thag pa'i 'gyur/ 98 slob dpon mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad pa'i khyad par du 'phags par bstod pa sgyur byed gong dang 'dra ba/

99 slob dpon bde byed bdag pos mdzad pa'i lha las phul du byung bar bstod pa sgyur byed gong dang 'dra ba/ 100 slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i skyabs su 'gro ba bdun cu pa jo bo rje dang lo tsā ba rin bzang gi 'gyur/ 101 slob dpon bi ma las mdzad pa'i skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa 'gyur byang mi gsal ba/ 102 jo bo chen po a ti shas rgyal po nir ya pha la la brdzangs pa'i dri ma med pa rin po che'i phrin yig de nyid dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur rnams so/ 103 /kha cig 'di dang byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i phreng ba gnyis phal cher gcig pas dpe sna zur du mi 'dren zhes bshad kyang skabs 'gar de dang zhus dag btub pa la bar bar du nor bu'i phreng bar med pa'i tshig mang du yod pa bcas paṇa chen thar rtse ba sogs kyi gsan yig tu'ang so sor bzhag 'dug pas dpe lung gnyis ka zur du nges par dgos so// de ltar chos tshan brgya dang gsum gyi lung legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen dī paṃ kā ra shrī dzñā na/ 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ chu mig pa shes rab grags/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum/ thar rtse paṇa chen gsan yig na gsan yig gzhan du mkhan chen blo bzang pa'i rjes su rgyang ro byang chub 'bum byung yang mchims kyi rnam thar ltar na 'di ltar yin gsung ba khungs btsun par mngon no/ /mchims blo bzang grags pa/ yol ston bsod nams lhun grub/ slob dpon grags pa rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ rgya ston tsand+ra de wa/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog chos 'phel/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/

rje dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar pa byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ sgrub khang pa mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rtse tshogs dbu mdzad kun dga' dngos grub/ rje phun tshogs legs 'byor/ bka' 'gyur ba ngag dbang rab brtan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas bkra shis/ mtshungs med yar lung pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ bshes gnyen dam pa bsam gtan phun tshogs/ mkhan chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// ༈ //yang bshes spring gi brgyud lugs gcig la/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ rje legs 'byor man 'dra'o// byang chub lam sgron la/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan nas/ zur chen/ rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang*/ legs 'byor man 'dra'o// smras pa/ rgyal kun gdung 'tshob byed pa sdom pa'i mchog /rgyal sras zung gi srol ltar legs thob nas// rgyal ba'i myu gu'i lta sgom spyod pa'i gzhung*// rgyal sras lam bzang klu dus zla ba thos// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste lnga pa'o// //bka' bar pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs don lag rtser son pa bdud bzhi'i co 'dri skye med klong du bcil zhing 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad lam du 'khyer ba dang*/ ltas ngan g.yang du len pa'i gdams pa zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul a ma lab kyi sgron ma'i nyams bzhes thos pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ khrid skyong ba'i phyag len ni/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' 'phel bzang gis mdzad pa'i zin bris khrid yig nor bu dpal phreng gi thog nas mdzad cing*/
thun mong ba'i sngon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs kyi skabs zhen pa bzhi bral lam 'bras snang gsum sogs nas drangs nas gsung zhing khrid dmigs

lung khrid lta bu zhig las dmigs thun du bcad pa'i nyams khrid de sngon ma thob kyang slar thob 'gyur gyis bris/ rnams bskyar zhing dmigs thun rnams bsgom du 'jug pa dang*/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa'i zab don gcod kyi khrid yig theg chen lam gyi gsal 'debs sogs kyi steng nas lung khrid du mnos shing*/ 'jug sgo nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi byin rlabs sangs rgyas ston pa'i yi ge bzhin mdzad/ khros ma nag mo lha lnga la brten pa'i dbang bskur chos kyi sgo 'byed sde snod 'dzin pa chos rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas legs par thob bo// gzhan yang lung ma khrid du gnang ba ni rgyal thang pa bsam gtan 'od zer gyi le brgyad yongs rdzogs/ rgod phrug ras pa grags pa 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i dmigs 'bum chen mo dang*/ lung gi skor la/ gcod zab don thugs kyi snying po'i gzhung*/ 'gor bla ma dang rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo sogs dang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis btus pa lags so'i mtha' can/ zab don thugs kyi snying po'i bsdus don mjug tu tshig de nyid rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ zab don thugs kyi snying po'i spyi khrid du bstan pa 'gor 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi zhes dang*/ shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa mañdzu gho ṣa nā thas sbyar ba zhes pa'i mtha' can/ zhal gdams sgo 'byed bcu pa 'gor chos dbyings rnam dag spros bral mi dmigs zhes dang sgo 'byed bcu'i chos rdzogs so zhes pa'i mtha' can/ 'jam dbyangs mgon pos mdzad pa ma gcig gi bro brdung zhes pa ldeb gcig ma/ bka' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab don thugs kyi snying po'i nyams khrid 'gor chos dbyings spros bral pha rol tu phyin ma zhes dang*/ shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa pradzñā swa bhā was nye bar sbyar ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can rnams kyi lung legs par thob bo// de rnams kyi rgyab chos su ārya de ba'i gcod gzhung*/

bka' tshoms/ yang tshoms/ de'i zhus lan so lnga pa/ phaṭa chos sum cu pa/ ma gcig gi rnam thar rgyas pa/ nang le brgyad ma gdan thog gcig ma/ nang rig 'khrul spyod dmigs rdzogs chen mo/ khrid yig nor bu dpal phreng gi lung yang ngo*// lu ma 'grim pa'i phyag len/ rje seng ge rgya mtshos mdzad pa dang*/ mkhan drung blo gros phun tshogs pas mdzad pa gnyis/ chab gtor klu gtor ma ti paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa/ gtor ma brgya rtsa kha skong bcas nag po 'gro shes su bsgrigs pa la/ mchod pa byin rlabs skyabs sems spyan ras gzigs phyag gnyis pa'i bdag bskyed spyan 'dren mchod pa'i skabs su spyod 'jug gi rin chen sems de ma/ chu sbyin la yi dwags bar do dang bcas pa/ dzam ser nag dkar cha bzhi/ brgya rtsa dngos rje btsun mchog gis mdzad pa/ bar do'i gtor ma/ dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi/ brul gtor cha gsum/ wa ru ṇa'i chu gtor sogs shin tu rgyas pa gcig thob/ gzhan yang ltung bshags/ bzang spyod/ bde ba can gyi smon lam mi mjed ma/ byams smon/ thugs rje chen po ma/ spyod 'jug gi bsngo le byams chen rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i smon lam shin rgyas ma/ gcod kyi rgyun gyi nyams len gtor 'bul/ don bstod dgongs spyod sogs thob pa'i gcod skor gyi brgyud pa yongs grags la pho brgyud/ mo brgyud/ gnyis med brgyud pa dang gsum gyi/ dang po pho brgyud che ba ni/ thabs brgyud kyang zer/ bya rgod phung por ston pa sangs rgyas/ ri bo rtse lngar 'jam dpal smra seng*/ rgya gar 'jag spyil du ārya de wa/ pho brgyud chung ba ni/ sras brgyud kyang zer/ bya rgod phung por ston pa sangs rgyas/ dga' ldan lha yul du byams pa mgon po/ ri bo bya rkang du 'phags pa thogs med/ nā landa ru paṇa chen dbyig gnyen/ rgya gar 'jag spyil du ārya de ba/ gnyis pa mo brgyud ni/ shes rab rgyud kyang zer/

'og min du yum chen sher phyin/ g.yu lo bkod par rje btsun sgrol ma/ rgya gar dur phrod du su kha siddhi/ gsum pa pho mo gnyis med dam gsum ka 'dus pa don gyi nyams len lag khrid kyi brgyud pa'ang zer/ brgyud pa ni/ ding ri glang 'khor du dam pa sangs rgyas/ 'dis 'phags pa lha dang bde ba'i dngos grub gnyis ka las gsan/ ra sa chu bzang du skyo chen ye shes bla ma/ ra sa spang lung du skyo chung bsod nams bla ma/ lnga pa'i gsan yig tu gangs par lha khang du zer/ zangs ri mkha' dmar du ma gcig lab sgron/ e chung glang lnga pa'i gsan yig tu e chung glang lung du rgyal ba don grub/ dag pa chos dbyings pho brang du 'jam dbyangs mgon po/ snye mo khu ba'i rwa bar khu sgom chos seng*/ lung du khu sgom chos seng*/ lung smad lcags tshal du dol pa zangs thal/ lnga pa'i gsan yig tu bar 'dir bkra shis mthong smon du rgya sgom ri ba zhes byung*/ g.yo stod chu bo ri rgya nag gcer bu/ rab grong*/ se gling du sangs rgyas rab ston/ zal mo brag dgon du sangs rgyas mtshan bshes gnyen dad pa shes rab/ dge slong*/ kha rag thod phu ru sum sum ston ras pa zhes byung*/ sgom ras pa/ dharma badzra/ /yol lnga pa'i gsan yig tu ri gong dpal gyi gnas su sangs rgyas ston pa zhes byung*/ stod bsam gtan brag rdzong du chos rje ston pa/ brtson 'grus seng ge gnyan sa ri khrod du lha sgom zhig po// bsam rdzong pho brang du kun mkhyen rgyal po// bde chen yang dben du legs pa'i mtshan can// byang chub gling gnas su bya btang nam mkha'// rma bya shug khrod du dbang phyug ras chen// chos rdzong dgon pa ru skyes mchog thar pa// ri khrod rma bya ru rtogs ldan sangs rgyas// rma bya shug khrod du dge slong dpal legs// gar bzhugs dben gnas su mkhas btsun chos rje// dgon pa grwa chen

dkon mchog grags/ du sems dpa' chen po// gung thang nam gling du kun dga' 'phel bzang*// gnyan khrod brgya rtsa ru seng ge rgya mtsho// rnam rgyal lha rtse'i chos lung gdan sa ru blo gros phun tshogs// bde chen zhing khams su phrin las phun tshogs// dben gnas ri khrod du phun tshogs rdo rje// e waṃ chos ldan du sangs rgyas phun tshogs// mdo smad chos grwa ru kun dga' bstan 'dzin// ldan gling nges med du tshul khrims rin chen la'o// de dag ni ma khrid chen mo zab don lugs la sogs pa'i bka' rnying ma'i brgyud pa zhes grags la/ bka' so ma zhes pa rgyal thang lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas dge slong yan gcig cing*// de nas shin tu nye brgyud la ma gcig nas rgyal thang pa bsam 'od yin kyang*/ yongs grags phyag len la sangs rgyas dge slong gi rjes su/ bde chen sdings kyi yang dben du mkhas pa rin 'od/ brag gzhag dpal gyi dgon pa ru zhes pa'ang snang*/ rong gi brag gsum gnyan sa ru tsa tsha ras pa// ngam ro shom mda'i dgon pa ru skye med jo bstan// nyang stod sgyer gyi gnas rnying du mkhan chen chos rin// rta sgo gangs kyi rwa ba ru chos rje zer ba'ang snang*/ rin chen gangs pa// la myag gnyis kyi gdan sa ru dus gsum sangs rgyas/ mchog dkar tshoms sdings zer ba'ang snang*/ chos sdings dpal gyi dgon pa ru gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ rgyal thang chu bzang dgon pa ru bsam gtan 'od zer/ rtsi ba ri rgod tshang dgon pa ru nam mkha' 'od zer/ gar bzhugs chos kyi pho brang du shākya 'od zer/ skyes dpal gyi dgon pa ru bde legs mtshan can// rma bya shug khrod dgon pa ru dge slong dpal legs// de man 'dra'o// rin chen gangs pa shākya bshes gnyen/ rin chen dpal bzang*/ bsam 'od sogs/ yang na/ sangs rgyas rab ston nas bla ma dam pa/ dam pa chos she lha ston zhig po/

zhig po thog rgyugs/ nyan chen pa/ nus rgyan pa/ rdor gzhon nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ mus chen dkon rgyal/ rdo rings pa/ grol mchog go /brgyud pa 'di'i khungs btsun zer/ rgod phrug lugs ni/ rgod phrug grags pa 'byung gnas/ pha rgod bsod bzang*/ rdo ring pa man 'dra/ da rung cung zad btsal dgos pa 'dra 'dug go /de rnams las rgod phrug pa'i dmigs 'bum sogs brgyud par dmigs bsal dgos pa 'ga' re 'dug kyang btsal dgos so// khros ma nag mo lha lnga la brten pa'i dbang bskur chos kyi sgo 'byed rkyang pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ khros ma nag mo/ birwa pa/ ga ya dha ra/ yang na thub pa'i dbang po/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ ārya de wa/ yang na yum chen shes rab phar phyir/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ su kha siddha/ pha gcig dam pa sangs rgyas/ skyo ston khu dbon/ ma gcig lab sgron/ rtsi ston dar ma/ sras rgyal ba don grub/ dge bshes gnyal pa/ grub thob 'ba' chen/ spang po kha pa/ shākya bla ma/ sangs rgyas ras pa/ sras rin chen gzhon nu/ dpal ldan grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs mgon po/ khyung ston ras chen/ bla ma drag sgrub/ sangs rgyas seng ge bsod nams rin chen/ chos grags bzang po/ bya btang chu sgom/ don yod rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab chos rje yon tan dpal 'byung*/ byams pa phun tshogs/ bsam gtan rin chen/ tshul khrims rin chen/ byams pa lha dbang*/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ kun dga' tshul khrims/ khams ston sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du stsal to// yang na kun dga' bstan 'dzin nas/ ldan ma kun dga' rdo rje/ thar lam kun dga' rnam rgyal/ de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed dang bcas pa ni/ ldan ma kun dga' rdo rje dang kun dga' rnam rgyal gnyis ka las/ drung pa bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/

de las bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis nos so// yang na khros ma nag mo lha lnga'i dbang gi brgyud pa mkhyen rab chos rje yon tan dpal 'byung yan sngar bzhin las/ de nas mkhas grub bsod nams shes rab/ bya rgod kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs kun bzang*/ bya rgod sprul sku/ karma bstan 'phel/ paṇa chen snying rje bzang po/ paṇa chen chos rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub bsod nams blo gros/ rin po che dpal 'byor rnam rgyal/ mkhas mchog bsod nams dpal 'byor/ mkhan chen phun tshogs rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun chen po bsod nams dbang phyug chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yig cha ni sde snod 'dzin pa chos rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i steng nas so// he ru ka dpal drung rin po che kun dga' rin chen pa'i lugs kyi gcod skor gyi pusti'i lung thos pa'i rnam grangs la/ gcod yul rgyal ba'i dgongs gsal zhes bya ba bla ma dam pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rin chen gyis dkar phyogs skyong ba sgyogs chen gdong ra'i shar phyogs kyi char sbyar ba'o'i mtha' can/ gcod yul theg chen lam gyi snying po che ba zhes bya ba/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rin chen gyis 'bad ces pa'i mtha' can/ theg chen lam gyi snying po chung ba zhes pa/ kun dga'i ming ldan gyis zin bris su byas pa'o'i mtha' can/ gcod yul rgyal sras lam bzang zhes bya ba kun dga'i ming ldan gyis zin bris byas pa'o'i mtha' can/ lam gtor zab mo zhes pa ri khrod 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen gyis zhes pa'i mtha' can/ gcod kyi spring yig gal 'gag rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba kun dga'i ming ldan gyis zhes pa'i mtha' can/ gcod kyi gdams pa'i skor la/ mjug tu kun dga'i ming ldan sprang pos sbyar zhes pa'i mtha' can/ gcod yul nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rin chen gyis dkar phyogs skyong ba sgyogs chen gdong ra'i lha zhol du sbyar zhes pa'i mtha' can/

tshogs las rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams la bkra shis shog ces pa'i mtha' can/ tshogs las rin chen phreng ba'i zur 'debs zhes bya ba kun dga'i ming ldan bdag gis bkod ces pa'i mtha' can/ tshogs las rgyal ba mnyes byed ces bya ba 'grub par gyur cig gi mtha' can/ lag mchod ces bya ba a nanda ratnas sbyor ba'o'i mtha' can/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i bskang ba rin chen bang mdzod/ zab don thugs kyi snying po'i zhi ba'i me mchod ces bya ba/ las bzhi gang sgrub sngags spel tshig btags zhes pa'i mtha' can/ drag po'i me mchod ces bya ba sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cig gi mtha' can/ zhi ba'i ngar mi'i ro sreg stong gsum mkha' 'gro'i chad pas chod ces pa'i mtha' can/ cho 'phrul mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba la legs par dpyad cing brtag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i mtha' can/ las dang po pa rnams kyi nyams len mdor bsdus dang bcas pa ste de rnams ni drung rin po che nyid kyis mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang tshogs las rin chen phreng ba/ dbang chog 'od kyi phreng ba/ drag tshogs phrin las lhun grub/ sgrub thabs dngos grub sgo 'byed kyi gsal byed/ sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba rnams ni mkhas btsun chen po bsod nams grub kyis mdzad pa rnams dang*/ zab don gyi snying po'i rgyun gyi nyams len nyung ngu rab gsal zhes bya ba shākya'i dge slong dharm+ma bi dza yas mdzad pa/ gcod khrid gdan thog gcig tu nyams su blang ba'i man ngag gi lung rnams rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni yan chad btsal/ dbang bla kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ ldan ma gcod pa kun dga' rdo rje/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' rnam rgyal/ drung pa bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ de las bdag gis thos so// gzhan yang mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig theg chen lam gyi gsal 'debs/ theg pa chen po gcod kyi snying po bsdus pa'i lag len/

nyams len mdor bsdus snying po gsal ba/ gcod zab mo don gyi nying khu/ gnyags ston bsam gtan 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i dbang bskur byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i zur 'debs/ khros nag lha lnga'i phyag len gyi dogs dpyod/ khros nag bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi sbyin sreg gi tho rnams kyi lung bcas legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni bka' 'bum gyi lung gi skabs ltar ro// ༈ //rgya gar dam pa sangs rgyas kyis bod du lan gsum byon pa'i tha mar man ngag 'khyug dpyad dkar nag khra gsum khams kyi klong thang sgrol mar gter du sbas pa mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan ltar khams ston shes rab dpal gyis bton pa'i dang po 'khyug dpyad dkar po'i skor la/ 'khrug pa dang nad zhi ba/ mi kha dang nad ngan phyogs ngan thub pa/ rke nad mkhal nad zhi ba/ mi phyugs kyi nad rgyun chad pa/ sris rme ba/ snying rlung*/ ro stod/ lag pa so dang 'den pa na ba rnams sel ba/ rlung gis mgo na ba/ dpral ba/ mig bad kan gyi nad/ dpung pa/ ro stod/ pus mo/ byin pa/ long bu/ rkang mthil na ba rnams gso ba/ rlung*/ tshad pa/ grang ba/ lus tsha hrab byed pa rnams sel ba/ skyug pa/ 'khru ba/ gzer nad/ mgo gcod sel pa/ rgyun du gnod pa'i 'dre zhi ba rnams so// 'khyug dpyad khra bo la/ rta phyugs kyi nad zhi ba/ 'dre byer ba/ 'thab mo nyung ba/ 'dre gnod thog 'tshag 'od 'khyug zhi ba/ bkra shis shing sa dpyad ngan pa zhi ba/ yams nad chad cing zhi ba/ sa 'dul/ dgra zhi ba/ ngag dang stobs zhi ba/ rlung chen ldang ba/ 'dre thams cad thub pa/ mi kha dang dgra nyung ba/ stobs bskyed pa/ chu/ kha smras/ mes mi 'tshig pa dang me mched pa zhi ba/ phan gnod gang yang sdeb thub pa/ mi kha zhi ba/ dgra 'dre thub pa/ dgra jag 'thab rtsod zhi ba/ 'thab mo mi 'byung ba/ 'khrug pa bzlum pa/ rlung gnon/ lhog pa thub pa/ nam mkha'i nad zhi ba/ sel zhi ba/ nad ngan thub cing don 'grub pa/ 'dre drag po'i gnod pa dang zug gzer gcog pa/

rbad 'dre dang khyi ngu ba mtshan ma ngan pa rnams zhi ba/ ser ba zhi ba/ rkun jag grol ba/ smyo ba'am kha smras dang nad 'byong ba/ thog bsrung rnams so// nag po'i skor la/ 'chi la khad sos pa/ dmag bzlog pa/ dmag byer ba/ gral dpon 'chi ba/ nad kha bsgyur ba/ dmag dang gnod pa kha smras zhi ba/ gzer gyis 'chi ba/ sngo skam la 'gro ba/ khang pa 'gas pa rnams so// zla ba'i 'khyug dpyad la/ dmag bag ma gtong len/ khyim rtsig 'jig lam 'jug ldog ston mo/ gyod len gang la'ang bkra shis par bya ba rnams dang*/ tshes grangs kyi 'khyug dpyad kyis dmag bag ma/ mkhar las/ lam zhugs/ ston mo/ kha mchu sogs gang la'ang shis par bya ba dang*/ yi ge'i 'khyug dpyad kyis zug gcog cing nad rmang nas 'don pa/ skud pa'i 'khyug dpyad kyis nad rnams zhi ba/ mtshon cha'i 'khyug dpyad la/ thog 'tsheg pa dang*/ gdon/ gnod byed zhi ba/ dmag bzlog dgra bgegs zhi ba/ brgyal bar byed pa/ ltas ngan dang gnod pa zhi ba rnams dang*/ 'chi blu'i 'khyug dpyad kyis nad gso ba/ sna tshogs pa'i 'khyug dpyad la/ skyug pa gcod pa/ gzer nad zhi ba/ sbos pa sel ba/ 'khru ba gcod pa/ skran nad gso ba rnams dang*/ drang srong rgyu skar gyi 'khyug dpyad la/ gsum gyi dkar po la/ skar ma so so'i zla dkar la brten pa'i rten 'brel gyi nad gso ba/ nag po'i 'khyug dpyad la/ sngags kyi kha bsgyur bstan pa/ rta/ bong bu/ glang*/ mdzo/ rtol gsod pa/ bu chung ngu ba/ khyi zug pa zhi ba/ mdze 'ong ba/ khyi thams cad sgo la zug pa/ zhing la lo mi skye ba/ lo tog sngo skam la 'gro ba/ chang gtad/ pho mo dbye ba/ khang pa bshig pa/ ltas ngan gtong ba/ 'od yong ba/ me 'byung ba/ bya sna tshogs 'bab pa/ gdung thams cad sbrul du 'gro ba/ chu khrag tu 'gro ba/ khang pa 'jig pa/ rmi lam ngan pa sna tshogs 'byung ba/ zhing sel/ zla mtshan nar mar 'bab pa/ lo tog gtan nas mi skye ba/ ljang pa ser skam du 'gro ba/ zhing ri dwags kyis mi za ba/

smyo bar byed pa/ gnag thams cad 'gum par byed pa/ 'byed pa/ mo mtshan smra bar 'gyur ba/ rabs chad pa/ zhing la ri bong bsrung ba/ dgra thams cad gnyid du 'gro ba rnams kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'gro mgon dam pa sangs rgyas/ khams ston shes rab dpal/ ston pa chos brtson/

khams ston shes rab dpal gyis gter bton nas ja sigs su bcug smon lam gyi gtad rgya dang bcas bskur ba yin no// 'khrul zhig dkon mchog gzhon nu/ mtshungs med rin chen shes rab/ 'khrul zhig ye shes dpal ba/ rgyal sras shes rab bzang po/ mtshungs med kun dga'i mtshan can/ rtse sgang 'jigs med 'od 'phro/ drin chen sangs rgyas bstan pa/ ri khrod pa grags pa bsod nams dpal dbang*/ zhi byed bstan pa'i nyi ma karma chos grags/ grub dbang nyi zla grags pa/ rje mgon po lhun grub/ sprul sku shākya rin chen/ chos rgyal gling pa/ mtshungs med da sha bi dza ya/ ngor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa skya ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la'o// smras pa/ mtha' bral gnas lugs smra bsam yul kun las// 'das pa shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i don// legs par ston pa zab mo gsang ba'i gcod// dam pa'i 'khyug dpyad dang bcas thos pa'i tshul// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gcod kyi skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste drug pa'o// //gsum pa rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim la bzhi/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi chos skor thos pa/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi chos skor thos pa/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi chos skor thos pa/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim mo// dang po bya ba'i rgyud la dbye ba drug yod pa las/ thog mar de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtso bo la dam tshig gsum bkod dam thub pa rdo rje gdan pa gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ rdo rje 'chang zhes pa'ang snang*/

phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun sku mched/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ bla ma gzungs kyi dpal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog ratna wardha/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge rje brang ti pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med shes bya bzang po/ 'jam dpal grub pa mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na/ ngor chen nas mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge dkon mchog 'phel ba man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ dkon mchog 'phel ba man 'dra'o// ༈ //bde bar gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam dang sman la sngags kyis gdab pa sogs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas mkhan po boddhi sa twas bkral ba'i sangs rgyas sman bla mched bdun gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sman bla/ thub dbang*/ 'jam dpal/ bo dhi sa twa che ba/ bo dhi sa twa chung ba/ rgyal po dge ba'i dpal/ a ti sha/ lha btsun byang chub 'od/ ti se ba chen po/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ ong po lo tsā ba/ dgra bcom pa rgyal mtshan/ gya pa dbang mdzes/ gya pa dpal mdzes/ yon tan bzang po/ dbu mdzad ston yon/ mkhan chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ byang sems bzang po/ bla ma byang ye/ bla ma ma ti'i mtshan can/ chos rje bka' 'gyur ba/ chos rje bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ rin po che dpal ldan chos 'byor/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhas btsun kun dga' dpal 'byor/

mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ byams pa bsod nams dpal ldan/ rdo rje 'chang tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na/ slob dpon yon tan dbang phyug bla ma jo brtan/ shangs pa 'dul 'dzin/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags/ rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal/ 'khus lo tsā ba/ 'gro mgon dpal ldan ye shes/ bka' bzhi pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ la lar bsod nams rgyal mtshan zer ba brtag sngags 'chang 'jam dpal rdo rje/ drin chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub dpal ldan dar po/ 'di nas mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyi gsan yig na/ chos rje kun dga' bsod nams/ khyung ston bde legs rgya mtsho/ sngags 'chang dkon mchog legs pa/ zhes 'byung*/ ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje'i gsan yig na/ dpa' dar ba'i rjes la/ nam mkha' dbang phyug blo gros 'byung gnas/ dkon mchog blo gros/ 'bum rams pa rgyal ba blo gros zhes 'byung*/ yang na/ thub dbang 'jam dbyangs bo dhi sa twa dang*/ khri srong lde'u btsun mu ne btsan po dang*/ sad na legs dang khri gtsug ral pa can// lha lung dpal rdor mnga' bdag 'od srungs dang*// dpal 'khor btsan dang skyid lde nyi ma mgon// bkra shis lde dang bla ma ye shes 'od// pho brang zhi 'od lha btsun byang chub 'od// 'od lde rtse lde snar pa byang chub tshul khrims ba/ zhu ldan pa shes rab gya za ra ba dar ma rgyal mtshan dang*/ grong mo che ba rgya sgom pa yi zhabs/ /mchims/ nam mkha' grags dang bsod nams ye shes pa// bsod nams grags pa rgyal sras thogs med sogs// 'di man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na rje ā nanda shrī bhū ti/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs bral bsod nams dpal ldan/ mkhan po chen po kun mkhyen tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po lha lnga'i rjes su gnang ba/

de'i sgrub thabs kyi lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ jo bo dī paṃ ka ra/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ mus sman pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang chos kyi bla ma/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam grub/ bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen gaṅgā bha dra/ 'jam dbyangs sngon po/ kun spangs chos rin/ byang sems bsod nams rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po/ mkhas grub kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang*/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa chen po tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// ༈ //sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen pa'i yi ge'i steng nas bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po la gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gis bskor ba'i rjes gnang phyag mchod dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon legs ldan byed/ zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug gser gling chos kyi grags pa/ jo bo rje/ sems tsam rnam rdzun pa'i paṇḍi ta/ rngog byang chub 'byung gnas/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad kha ba/ se spyil bu ba/ rgan mo lhas pa chen mo/ mchims gro mo che pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ slob dpon sbas pa ston gzhon/ chos sku blo gros 'od/ mkhan chen seng ge rgyal mtshan/ byang sems shākya bsod nams/ chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams lha'i dbang po/

spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rin po che dpal ldan chos 'byor/ gzims 'og pa/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ 'di gnyis ka thub bstan yangs pa can gyi mkhan po yin no// ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ dpal sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang du stsal to// rjes gnang gi yi ge da lta phyag len sngags 'chang chen po kun rin gyis mdzad pa'i steng nas so// ༈ //thams cad mkhyen pa bu na rin po ches mdzad pa'i dbang chog 'chi med grub pa dang*/ lhan thabs rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis mdzad pa kha skong dang bcas pa'i steng nas 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa'i gzungs las gsungs pa'i thub pa'i dbang po lha bdun gyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang ngam rigs gtad legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po/ mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ lha sras mu khri btsun po/ sad na legs 'jing yon/ lha sras gtsang ma/ lha sras 'od srungs/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon/ khri bkra shis mgon/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od/ lha btsun byang chub 'od/ pho brang zhi ba 'od/ mnga' bdag 'od lde/ rtse lde/ mnga' ris/ dgra bcom pa tshul khrims byang chub/ zhu ldan pa shes rab grags/ ra sa chu lhad pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/ gro mo che ba bdud rtsi grags/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po rin chen rnam rgyal/ sku zhang nam mkha' mchog grub/ bla ma rin chen don grub legs pa/

'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ byang gling pa rin chen rgyal po/ zhwa lu ba rin chen bkra shis/ gnubs sgom sbas pa'i rnal 'byor smon lam rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab bstan/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ chen po byang ma pa rin chen bzang po/ rin chen padma phrin las/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na mchims nas/ mkhan zi/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston man 'dra/ yang na jo bo rje/ nag tsho lo tsā ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba/ 'phan yul gu kha ba/ shangs kyi rgya phug pa can/ g.yag sde'i zhang ye shes rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon dbang phyug rin chen/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston man 'dra/ 'od zer dri med kyi gzungs mdo'i lung gi brgyud pa ni dbang dang 'dra'o// ༈ //ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul gyi yi ge dang*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge go bde bklag chog gi steng nas ston pa thub pa'i dbang po gtso 'khor gsum/ thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum/ rje btsun mi g.yo mgon po/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum dang bcas te bka' gdams lha bzhir grags pa'i rjes gnang dang 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub kyis mdzad pa'i lha bzhi'i khrid yig ma thob gi lung bcas thob pa'i dang po thub pa gtso 'khor gsum dang*/ sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ jo bo chen po a ti sha nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba/ bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa brtson 'grus 'bar/ mkhan po chos kyi byang chub/ mkhan po zul phu ba/ slob dpon dkon mchog seng ge

de gnyis ka las mkhas btsun tshul khrims rin chen/ de nas bla ma dar ma bzang po/ chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rgyal mtshan don grub/ chos rje gtsang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bya btang bo dhi satwa/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen grags pa/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang*/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chen po ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag shī la ratna la'o// yang na/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i gsan yul gyi bla ma blta/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ chos rje kun dga' chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen thams cad gzigs pa chen po sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag la dgyes pa chen pos stsal to// yang na jo bo chen po nas/ 'brom chos kyi rgyal po/ dgon pa ba/ sne'u zur pa ye shes 'bar/ rgyang ro dar brtson/ rdzi ma 'od grags/ spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od/ mkhan po zla 'od/ mkhan chen dpal rgyal ba/ grub pa bzang po/ chos rje 'dzim pa/ bla ma chos grags dpal/ bla ma ma ti/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge shāka bzang pa/ mkhas grub kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang man 'dra'o// yang thub pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ thub dbang*/ byams mgon/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ jo bo rje/ bshes gnyen 'brom/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ gtum ston blo gros grags/ gtum ston shes rab grags/ rgyal bzang pa/ mkhan chen kun dga' bzang po ā nandā pa/ ratna'i mtshan can/ blo gros rin chen/ shes rab bzang po/ gnyug la ngag dbang grags pa/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o//

༈ //thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po/ rā hu la gupta badzra/ jo bo a ti sha nag tsho lo tsā ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba/ shes rab 'bar/ wa yu ba shes rab tshul khrims/ lce sgom shes rab rdo rje/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge gnyan ston chos kyi shes rab/ sangs rgyas ston pa brtson 'grus seng ge shangs ston tshul khrims 'bum/ gnyan ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'dren mchog ratna wardha/ rje lha mchog seng ge buddha singha/ mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ e waṃ pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na bla ma gcig tsam btsal nas/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ chos rje kun dga' chos 'phel/ kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag la'o// yang na sangs rgyas ston pa/ grub thob a seng*/ gser gling pa bkra shis dpal ba/ rdo rje dpal ba/ chos dpal shes rab/ grags pa 'byung gnas/ lo pa tshul dar/ bsod nams lha dbang*/ lo pa ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ mchog legs rdo rje man 'dra'o// yang na sangs rgyas ston pa/ shangs ston pa/ rgyal mtshan 'bum/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal/ gser gling pa byams pa/ smon lam dbang phyug bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ shes rab bzang po/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ lo pa ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra'o// yang nye brgyud ni/ thugs rje chen po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge ratna wardha man 'dra'o// ༈ //mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/

jo bo/ dpal ldan dgon pa ba/ sne'u zur pa/ rtogs ldan bzang mo ba/ lha dge 'dun sgang pa/ sangs rgyas jo bo/ bcu bzhi pa tshul khrims mgon po/ tshes bcu pa chos kyi rdo rje/ rgyal steng gser khang pa rin chen 'phel/ lo pa tshul dar pa/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang*/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra'o// yang lha bzhi'i rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig la/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags nas mus chen nam mkha' dbang phyug stong rwa ba kun dga' legs grub/ de gnyis ka las she'u lo tsā ba/ de nas mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po man 'dra'o// ༈ //gnyis pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bdag po'am rig pa'i rgyal po ni 'jam dpal te/ de'ang mnga' ris pa tshul khrims 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog phrin las lhun grub kyi steng nas bya ba spyi'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rigs gsum spyi'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ma hā badzra dhā ra/ badzra pā ṇi/ ma hā ind+ra bhū ti/ ma dhya ma/ mṛ tyu/ nā gārdzu na/ nā ga bo dhi/ kasmi ra dzñā na badzra/ lo chung grags 'byor shes rab/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi ta/ de gnyis ka las do pa dkar ston shākya grags/ bande lung

bde lung zer ba byung*/ pa kun dga' dpal/ dkar gyi dbon po/ gung pa dar ma ye shes/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang*/ gnyags ston byang chub seng ge 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog ratna wardha/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na/ ngor chen nas/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen lags pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ lo pa ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ rje btsun mchog legs rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na ratna wardha nas/ lha mchog seng ge sangs rgyas seng ge man 'dra/ yang na brang ti paṇḍi ta nam mkha' dpal bzang pa'i yi ge'i steng nas thob pa'i brgyud tshul ni/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel yan chad sngar dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas lha mchog seng ge buddha singha*/ paṇḍi ta nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la e waṃ thar pa rtser stsal to// ༈ //'jam dbyangs gang blo ma'i rjes gnang ngam/ 'jam dbyangs ye shes yon tan bzang po'i rigs gtad ces pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs dhī ra pā la zhes pa bod skad du bstan skyong zhes pa ste/ rgya gar gyi paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa yin/ gnyan lo tsā ba'i bla ma yang yin no// dhī ra pā la rngog blo ldan/ gsang phu'i/

/khyung ston rin grags rgya mar byang chub grags// cha pa chos seng gtsang nag brtson seng dang*// dan 'bag dar seng gnyal zhig 'jam rdor dang*// gzad pa dar tshul dge bshes gra thang pa// bla ma bsod rgyal yang rtse rin seng dang*// kun mkhyen bu ston 'di nas bla ma kha cig btsal dgos/ mkhan chen rin rnam pa// bla ma bkras rin ngor chen thams cad mkhyen// paṇa chen grags rgyal bla ma legs 'byung dang*// sa skya lo tsā dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs// dkon mchog dpal ldan shar chen byams bkras pa// rje dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen sher rgyam pa/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ bsod nams dpal ldan/ mkhan chen tshul khrims lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na kun dga' bstan 'dzin nas/ mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin stsal to// ༈ //dam pa sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal smra seng*/ pha dam pa/ kha che gu hya/ glen sgom yab sras/ slob dpon 'od shāka mchog ldan/ skyi ston/ kun mkhyen dol phu pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge brang ti pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang nas dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa ye shes bzang po/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ de nas bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ kun mkhyen bkra shis lhun grub/

des bdag tshul khrims rin chen du bod pa la'o// yang na rje lha mchog seng ge shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs kun rtse gdong khri chen/ dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ thub bstan mkhan chen ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje/ shar chen ye shes bzang po man 'dra/ yang na sgrub khang pa nas/ rje ngag dbang brtan pa man 'dra/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub pas mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas legs par thob bo// de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i ril bu'i sgrub pa dang*/ nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg dang brgyud 'debs rnams kyi lung bcas thos so// ༈ //ma hā paṇḍi ta ma ti'i lugs kyi 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yi ge'i steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ slob dpon ma ti/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ mkhan po bsod nams shes rab/ shes rab mgon/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug rje ratna wardha/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas mkhas btsun kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag la'o// yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs sa lo/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na ratna wardha/ lha mchog pa/ rje buddha singha*/ brang ti pa man 'dra/ yang na dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa sher rgyam/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ chos rje dpal ldan don grub man 'dra'o// gzhan yang byams pa bsod nams bzang po dang*/ kun dga' chos 'phel/

sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ dpal ldan chos skyong bzhi char las mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang pas gsan/ de las bdag gis mnos te de rnams kyis gsan yul so so dang sbrel lo// yang chag lo gsum pa rin chen chos rgyal las brgyud pa drug ldan byas par snang ste des mdzad pa'i yi ger blta'o// mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong dang*/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa las sgrub skor las tshogs rnams kyi lung thob pa ni/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub pa'i thabs ches zab pa kha che'i paṇḍi ta shākya shrī dang khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs bskyed rim dang mthun pa'i bstod pa ma tis mdzad pa gnyan los bsgyur ba/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i phyag len ltar khro phu lo chen byams pa'i dpal gyis bsdebs pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge rgya ston gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub skor la rtsa ba'i sgrub pa/ nyes byas 'joms pa/ yon tan sgrub pa/ rtsod pa bya thabs/ ma sha la brten pa'i las sbyor rnams mkhan po bkra shis lhun grub pa las thos/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa'i las tshogs blo gros padmo kha 'byed dang bsnyen grub kyi yi ge dang*/ sbyin sreg rnams kyi lung sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa sogs las legs par mnos so// ༈ //paṇḍi ta gser gdugs can gyi bzhed srol rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dkar po shes rab 'khor lo'i rjes su gnang ba gong ma'i phyag len bzhin thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ paṇḍi ta gser gdugs can/ mtshan zla ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rā hu la shrī/ bi ma la shrī/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na bi na ya shrī zer/ bikṣa ta de wa/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na bi khya ta zer ba snang*/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra/

lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal/ chos rje bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu ba rin chen dbang phyug mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang*/ khro phu ba rin chen 'bum/ gnyags phu ba bsod nams bzang po/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal ba/ mkhan chen rin chen bzang po/ mkhan chen chos grub seng ge sman sdings pa lo chen ratna bha dra/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen/ chos gter dkon mchog legs pa/ e waṃ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ khyab bdag zhwa lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku kun dga' bsod nams/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// de'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bya tshul rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i ma nor rab gsal sgron ma zhes bya ba'i lung dang bcas pa thos// ༈ //gsum pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum la thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog bde dga' rgya mtsho dang*/ bco brgyad 'jam dbyangs chos rjes mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi steng nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum du gtogs pa bcom ldan 'das ma bsrung ba lnga lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/ grub chen dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi ta/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po rin chen rnam rgyal/ sku zhang nam mkha' mchog grub/ ka bzhi pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/

mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ de dbon kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje nas/ sku zhang 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan/ de dbon sku zhang bsod nams lhun grub/ sku zhang ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ de dbon sku zhang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ sku zhang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang na rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ sku zhang rin chen mkhyen brtse mchog grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na ba ri lo tsā ba nas/ gnyan ston grags/ gnyan rin chen grags/ lha pa'i gnas brtan dkon mchog de sras rngog ston kha'u rgyal/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug rong pa shes rab seng ge 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston man 'dra/ yang na bu ston nas/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma a mo gha/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rin chen/ chos lung mkhan chen don yod rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bshes gnyen bkra shis grub mchog ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ mkhan chen dkon mchog tshul khrims/ gung pa mgon po rgyal mtshan/ grub mchog ngag dbang rnam rgyal man 'dra'o// ༈ //'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs dang brgya rtsa'i chings ltar 'od zer can gtso rkyang gi rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ mkhas pa gzungs kyi dpal ba/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ rje ratna shī la/ rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rje nam mkha' dpal ldan/ 'dren mchog snying rje bzang po/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab ngag dbang lhun grub/ byams pa kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// dbang phyug rab brtan pa'i gsung gi gsang ba zhes pa'i gdams pa gzhi 'gro 'dug sogs shar tshe don 'grub pa'i las tshogs kyang thos so// ༈ //ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje'i yi ge'i steng nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum 'phags pa rig pa chen mo'am/ gza' rnams kyi yum gtso 'khor gyi tshom bu la brten pa'i rjes su gnang ba yi ge'i lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan birwa pa/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twa/ 'khon klu'i dbang pos bsrungs pa/ 'khon rdo rje rin chen/ 'khon dge skyabs/ 'khon dge mthong*/ 'khon ston bal po/ 'khon gtsug tor shes rab/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ 'khon kun dga' snying po/ 'khon bsod nams rtse mo/ 'khon grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'khon kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'khon blo gros rgyal mtshan/ gzhon nu dpal grags/ 'phags 'od/ gzhon nu bsod nams/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/

mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ rje lha mchog seng ge rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas dpal bzang po/ gang des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// ༈ //bzhi pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtsug tor gyi lha ni ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs stong mchod rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i rjes gnang lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas phyag na rdo rje dze tā ri// rdo rje gdan pa gnyis dang ba ri ba// sa skya bla chen rje btsun sku mched gnyis// chos rje khu dbon zhang ston dkon mchog dpal// brag phug bsod dpal ri khrod blo gros brtan// mtshungs med dpal tshul shar chen ye rgyal dang*// ngor chen kun bzang mus chen dkon rgyal che// yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel dang sa lo tsā// dkon mchog lhun grub sangs rgyas seng ge dang*// nam mkha' dpal bzang shar chen kun dga'i mtshan// shes rab 'byung gnas kun dga' dpal 'byor dang*// sangs rgyas phun tshogs tshul khrims lhun grub zhabs// de nas mnos pa tshul khrims rin chen no// yang na mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*// bstan 'dzin lhun grub bkra shis lhun grub kyis// rjes su bzung ba bdag go yang na ni// bstan 'dzin lhun grub dpal ldan chos skyong las// legs par thos de tshul khrims rin chen no// yang na grub chen dkon mchog blo gros nas/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams man gong bzhin no// yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po nas/
rgyal tshab kun dbang*/ yongs 'dzin/ rje lha mchog pa/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ brang ti pa/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen sher 'byung man 'dra/ yang zhabs drung rgyal rtse pa la'ang

rje 'dis zhabs drung a mi lags la'ang gsan no// rje kun dga' dpal 'byor pas gsan pa 'dra'o// ༈ //mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis mdzad pa'i cho ga khrigs rin chen bsam 'phel gyi steng nas 'phags pa kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med pa lha lnga'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang ngam rigs gtad legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po/ jo bo dī paṃ kā ra/ nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba/ bshes gnyen bya yul ba/ skar chung sbyin pa/ gze pa don grub ye shes/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon po/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ thogs ston shes rab rdo rje/ mes ston grags pa 'od zer/ bla chen grags pa rin chen/ kun mkhyen nam mkha' 'od zer/ chos rje nam mkha' tshul khrims/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring kun spangs pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ chen po byang ma rin chen bzang po/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang padma phrin las/ mkhyen rab ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub dpal bzang po/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// ༈ //sngags 'chang snye mdo shākya dpal ba'i yi ge'i steng nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtsug tor gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang ngam rigs gtad legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon bsam gtan bcu pa/ mkhas pa tsand+ra go mi/ slob dpon gi ra wa ti/ slob dpon rdo rje rnon po/ slob dpon padma lcags kyu/

bram ze rin chen rdo rje/ dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan pa mya ngan med pa/ paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ ldan ma'i skyu ra a skyabs/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ de las stod lung gad ser ba dang*/ pho rog pa mdo sde mgon gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka nas khams chen rgan mo lhas pa byang chub dpal/ bla ma ye shes rin chen/ rje rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma cha rgan pa/ bla ma grags chen pa/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ sngags 'chang shākya dpal ba/ rje chos dpal ba/ rje rin chen dpal bzang*/ mkhas pa lha dbang blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ mnga' bdag kun dga' lhun grub bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// rje nyid kyi gsan yig na tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa'i mdos chog shākya dpal ba'i dbang chog dang mdos 'di'i lung ma thob/ chog gnyis/ lhan thabs zhwa lu mkhan chen gyis mdzad pa bcas pa'i lung ni/ shākya dpal/ rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ chos rje rgyal mtshan bkra shis/ slob dpon dbang chen rgyal po/ bla ma byang chub bzang po/ mkhan chen rin chen kun ldan/ rig 'dzin kun dga' don grub/ phyi rum dge steng pa byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas/ khyab bdag rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ sku zhang rin chen mkhyen brtse mchog grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi khro bo gshin rje'i gshed dang gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba sogs te/ slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ra'i bzhed srol chag lo gsum pas mdzad pa'i sreg byed me'i mtshon cha'i steng nas dam pa'i phyag len ltar lung gsum gyi chings kyi sgo nas khro bo'i rgyal po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

de bzhin gshegs pa sā la'i dbang po/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya seng ge paṇa grub a bha yā ka ra/ bhaṃ ga la'i paṇa chen shu bhaṃ kā ra gupta/ de la kha che'i paṇḍi ta buddha shrī dzñā na dang*/ grub chen ā nanda gupta gnyis kyis zhus/ gnyis ka las chag lo dgra bcom/ de nas chag lo chos rje dpal/ gtsang nag sbug pa mkhan chen dbang phyug chos rje dpal ba'i gdan sa pa yin/ shes rab/ chag dbon bstan 'dzin dpal bzang*/ 'jag mon mkhas pa grub chen maṅga la shrī/ ti'u ra'i zur khang du bzhugs pa dgung lo brgya bzhes pa/ rje btsun dpal chen bzang po/ chos rje ye shes dpal bzang*/ de las rgyal sras blo bzang dpal 'byor dang rdo rje 'dzin pa chos skyong bzang po gnyis kyis gsan/ yab sras gsum ga nas chag lo gsum pa rin chen chos rgyal/ bla ma rin chen rgyal mchog chos rdzong pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ zhwa lu mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// de'i rjes gnang bya tshul tho chung rje nyid kyis mdzad pa dang*/ rjes gnang gi yi ge sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa thob/ chag los mdzad pa'i sreg byed me'i 'khor lo'i las tshogs la/ lo rgyus phyir bzlog byad chu bor bskyur ba dang bcas pa'i lung ni/ chag lo/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// bstod phrin gyi rab byed ces pa'i lung yang nos so// ༈ //rin po che dpal 'di rigs kyi pho nyar bzhag 'os kyang gtsug tor gyi rigs phyogs gcig tu bya ba'i phyir 'dir bris so//

ldan don grub pas mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can/ slob dpon tsand+ra go mi/ gi ra wa ti/ badzra dakṣi/ shu raṃ ga bha dra/ buddha gu hya/ kha che paṇḍi ta dkar po/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin chen ye shes/ zhang ye ba/ bla ma dkon mchog tshul khrims/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang pa/ bla ma byang chub seng ge 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ rje dkon mchog 'phel ba/ lha mchog seng ge sangs rgyas seng ge shar khang pa pradzñā dhwa dza/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag shī la ratna'i ming can la'o// yang na sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro ma bde ba sbyin/ kha che ratna badzra/ bram ze sadzdza na/ sras māñdza na pā la/ gnyal ston ye shes dbang phyug dge bsrungs/ gdong sngon pa/ spu ston 'bar thog pho rog dar ma mdo sde/ thod pa jo 'bur ba/ jo ldan dbang rin/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ ston pa dar ma shākya/ spur bsod nams dbang phyug lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims man 'dra'o// 'di'i rjes gnang dang gtor chog bcas dpal ldan don grub pas mdzad pa'i lung yang nos so// ༈ //thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul gyi yi ge la brten nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi pho nyar bzhag cing 'ga' zhig tu rigs kyi khro bor 'dod pa khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

mi g.yo ba/ 'od byed 'byung gnas sbas pa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dā na shī la/ yon tan khri/ 'dul 'dzin byang sems/ rgyal tsha chos dbang*/ rgyal tsha gzhon nu grags/ mkhan chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ g.yag ston sangs rgyas dpal/ rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen grags rgyal/ mkhan chen legs 'byung ba/ sa skya lo tsā ba/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa/ de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis legs par thob bo// yang na dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ shrī ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/ nub dgon pa sbyin pa grags/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra'o// yang gong du smos pa'i yi ge de'i steng nas rjes su gnang ba dang*/ lung gi skor la 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta dā na shī las rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ mkhas pa yon tan khris mdzad pa'i mi g.yo ba dkar po la brten pa'i shes rab blo 'phel gyi sgrub thabs bcud kyi snying por bkod pa/ des mdzad pa'i spro bsdu/ bogs 'byin/ le brgan te zhal gyi gdams pa gsum/ skyor mo lung gi chos grwar mkhas pa yon tan khris sgrub pa mdzad skabs byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba byung tshul rnams brjed byang du mdzad pa/ de'i yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod pa yan lag bdun ldan ma dang bcas pa rnams rmor chen pas phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i lung*/ des mdzad pa'i byin rlabs rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba/ paṇa grub a bha yā ka ra gupta/ ā nanda ka ra gupta/ slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa/ paṇa chen dā na shī la/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi ta/

'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge bcom ldan 'das ral gri/ slob dpon bsod nams bzang po/ mkhan chen puṇye bha dra/ bla ma dar ma bzang po/ mkhan chen bsod nams shes rab/ mkhan po shes rab mgon/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ 'dren mchog mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas btsun bkra shis dbang phyug mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na dkon mchog rgya mtsho nas/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na dā na shī la nas/ bcom ldan ral gri/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ grwa rings pa/ mtshur ston rin chen ye shes/ karma dkon gzhon/ 'dis 'bri khung dpal 'dzin rtsod pa'i sgo nas rmig med du bcom ste dpal 'dzin la klog go chod cig las mi 'dug gsung skad/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ mkhan chen ratna shī la/ rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra/ yang na dā na shī la/ 'dul 'dzin byang sems/ mkhas pa lung gi dbang phyug rgyal tsha lung mang po/ rgyal sras gzhon nu grags pa/ jo nang chos kyi rgyal po/ g.yag mi pham sangs rgyas dpal/ rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ rje btsun sgo rum pa man 'dra'o// yang na nye brgyud ni/

khro bo'i dbang po/ paṇḍi ta dā na shī la/ de las sa paṇa dang bcom ral gnyis kyis gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen rab chos rje nas kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags man 'dra/ yang rjes gnang nye brgyud ni/ khro bo mi g.yo ba/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar klungs pa mkhas grub seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog bdag chen 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring kun spangs pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje dbang rab man 'dra/ lung rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nas/ mchod dpon drung pa dkon mchog rdo rje 'chang dbang rab man 'dra/ yang na lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ kun mkhyen g.yag pa nas/ rong ston shes bya kun rig rgyu 'gul paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ bkra shis dbang phyug sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag la'o// yang na dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ shrī ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sdom brtson sbyin pa grags pa/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra'o// shin tu nye brgyud ni/ mi g.yo ba/ g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma man 'dra/ mi g.yo ba'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i zhag bdun thog zhal dkar nang du mi g.yo ba'i sku mtheb sor tsam pa mang po byung ba bgegs kyi sprul par mkhyen nas lhag med tu zhal du gsol bas thul zhing bcom ldan 'das zhal gzigs pa'i lo rgyus snang ngo*//

༈ //thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang byed tshul gyi yi ge la brten nas mi g.yo ba sngon po'i rjes gnang dam pa'i phyag len ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ grub chen dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba/ rdo rje gdan pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi ta/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal ba/ rgyal ba na bza' brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs mus pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ mkhan chen tshul khrims lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ bkra shis lhun grub/ de las tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// yang na ngor chen/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// rigs kyi khro mo ro langs ma dang gzhan gyis mi thub ma sogs ni ma byung*/ drug pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi pho nya ni shin tu stobs dang*/

shin tu rdo rje sogs dang*/ pho nya mo ni khro mo chen mo dang rab gtum chen mo la sogs pa ste de rnams kyang ma byung zhing*/ brgyad pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad la sogs pa ste/ gang gi rigs kyi bdag po'i skabs de rnams las gzhan de sngon ma byung ngo*// rigs sngags 'chang gi sde snod kun gyi gzhi// bya rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lha// rgyal ba rgyal ba'i yum dang gtsug tor rigs// khro bor gtogs pa sde tshan nyi shu gcig /ces dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste bdun pa'o// //gnyis pa padma'i rigs la/ dang por rigs kyi gtso bo ni snang ba mtha' yas la sogs pa ste/ 'dir slob dpon dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal zhes pa dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu bzhugs pa de nyid las brgyud pa/ dpal sa skya pa yab sras kyi gdams pa bya rgyud padma'i rigs tshe dpag med lha dgu ma'i tshe dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bha ga wāṃ a pa ri mī tā yurdzñā na/

bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa/ garbha sya pā daḥ snying po'i zhabs/ dze tā riḥ dgra las rgyal ba/ bo dhi bha draḥ byang chub bzang po/ sa mā dhi bha draḥ ting 'dzin bzang po/ badzrā sa nā sho ka shrīḥ rdo rje gdan pa mya ngan med dpal/ a mo gha badzraḥ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri ratna kīrtiḥ ba ri rin chen grags pa/ ma hā gu ru bhū mī paṇḍa kaḥ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ puṇyā grāḥ bsod nams rtse mo/ kīrti dhwa dzaḥ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ paṇḍa ra paṇḍi tā nanda dhwa dzaḥ sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ pūrba ka badzra rasmiḥ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ maṅga laṃ shuḥ bkra shis 'od/ ai pa kho naṣe shi kaḥ e pa 'khod ston/ ma hā gu ru mañdzu gho ṣaḥ bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po/ bo dhi satwa dzi na dzñā naḥ byang sems rgyal ye/ kīrti lakṣ+mīḥ grags pa dpal/ sru lu dā nanda pra ṇi dhaḥ sru lung kun dga' smon lam/ shī la gu ha kaḥ brag phug pa/ ma ti bī raḥ blo gros brtan pa/ gu ru shrī māṃ shī laḥ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ dharm+ma swa mi dzñā na dhwa dzaḥ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ badzra dha rā nanda bha draḥ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ dzi na yu ba nā nande shwa raḥ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug nā ya kā gra ratna wardhaḥ 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel ba/ swa mī su rottam singhaḥ rje lha mchog seng ge buddha singhaḥ sangs rgyas seng ge branti ga ga na shrī bha draḥ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ swa mī ga ga na buddhaḥ de'i dbon/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ bhaṭṭā ra ka ga ga na shrī bha draḥ hor se chen gan gyi rgyud/ rje btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ pa ṭu siddho buddha lakṣ+mīḥ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/

sarba dzñā na shī la ni rā bho gaḥ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ te nātma bande shī la ratnaṃ pra yatstshaḥ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to/ /pā pa ṭu siddhi buddha lakṣ+myaḥ yang na mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ swa mi dzñe ya bha draḥ rje shes bya bzang po/ ma ho pagdhya shī la ni rā bho ga pūrba batra/ mkhan chen tshul khrims lhun grub sngar bzhin no// yang na ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson 'grus seng ge rgya zhang dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ bla ma cha gan grags pa man 'dra/ yang na rgya zhang phug pa/ 'jad pa ri sha e pa 'khon ston man 'dra/ yang na grags pa dpal/ chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin chen seng ge bu ston lo tsā ba byang chub rtse mo/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man 'dra/ yang na brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang ma ti/ theg chen pa/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dpal chos pa/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo sngags 'chang chen po/ brang ti pa man 'dra/ yang na sa lo/ kun dga' dpal ldan/ paṇa chen man 'dra/ yang na rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rtse gdong khri chen 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas man 'dra/ yang na brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ brang ti nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ brang ti nam mkha' rin chen dang se chen gan nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kas/ 'dren pa shes rab rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs man 'dra'o// de la brten pa'i tshe sgrub kyi gdams pa zab mo snying gar tshe dpag med gtso 'khor lnga dang spyi bor ye shes tshe dpag med bsgom pa'i tshe sgrub kyi lung ni/ mkhas btsun chen po bkra shis bzang po las thob bo/ de pa'i gsan yul gang yin btsal bar bya'o// ༈ //bya ba'i rgyud kyi padma'i rigs su gtogs pa'i tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra zhes grags pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

tshe dpag med/ snying po'i zhabs/ dze tā ri/ bho dhi bha dra/ ting 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson 'grus seng ge rgya zhang phug pa/ 'jad pa shes rab rin chen/ e pa 'khon ston thugs rje rin chen/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po gzhi thog pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ bla ma grags pa dpal bzang*/ bla ma chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ sku zhang chos rje nam mkha' mchog grub/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ bsod nams mchog grub/ rje byang gling pa/ rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ gnas gsar ba/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de'i dbon po/ grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang thams cad a mi lags/ mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan/ dpal bzang po/ shar pa bdag chen 'jam mgon ye shes bzang po bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ de las bsod nams dpal ldan yin nam/ de nas byams pa bsod nams bzang po yin nam/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub gang yin ma nges/ de rjes chos rje bstan pa rgyal mtshan/ de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis thos so// yang na mkhyen rab chos rje yan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ des sgra bsgyur chos skyong bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub/ rgyal tshab ratna shrī wan/ paṇḍi ta chen po nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ a mi lags man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na sa lo/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa blo gros man sngar dang 'dra'o// dkyil chog paṇa chen nam bzang gis mdzad pa'i tho yig 'chi med bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs kyi steng nas mdzad cing*/

bzlas lung gi skabs su gzungs ring gi bzlas lung bcas pa thos so// ༈ //ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas grub chen mi tra dzo ki nas brgyud pa'i tshe dpag tu med pa dkar po'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ lo ke shwa ra/ grub chen mi tra dzo ki paṇa chen buddha shrī/ chag lo dgra bcom/ grum ston dar ma shes rab/ skrag phug pa shes rab dpal/ grub thob legs ldan 'od/ chos rje dpal chen bzang po/ ye shes dpal bzang po/ rgyal sras blo bzang dpal 'byor/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs sa lo/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje btsun nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rje tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen man 'dra// ༈ //dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis grub rgyal gling pa sa rgyal gyi thugs dam du gnang ba'i tshe sgrub zab mo snga dro mal nas langs ma thag par/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mdor bsdus sngon du btang nas/ rang gi snying sgo nga stong pa lta bu'i nang du padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du dbus su sangs rgyas tshe dpag med nas/ nub byang du mi g.yo tshe dpag med kyi bar lha dgu bskyed nas/ sku re re la dmigs nas gzungs ring tshar re ste dgu bzlas nas 'dod don gsol gdab dang dge ba bsngos pas 'chi ba bslu ba'i mchog tu 'gyur te/ slob dpon dze tā ri'i thugs kyi yang snying sa skya pa'i gdams pa zhes yod pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ brag phug pa yan chad tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang gi brgyud pa dang 'dra'am snyam ste dpyad par bya zhing*/

de nas bdag gi drin chen bla ma bkra shis bzang po pa'i bar btsal/ de las bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis nos so// ༈ //bya ba'i rgyud kyi bcangs pa tsam gyis skye ba dran pa'i gzungs sngags yig 'bru lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa byang sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe'i rang gzungs su grags pa thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa lu lo tsā ba chen pos bslab pa kun las btus pa'i lus bsrung ba'i sngags su bshad pa nyid/ de'i rgya dpe las dngos su phyung ste dag par mdzad cing*/ lo rgyus yongs grags su lha'i dge bsnyen zhig gis sgra mi snyan nas dngos su blangs te dgra bcom pa blo gros dpal la gtad pa'i sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe gzungs la yig cha mi mthun pa sna tshogs 'dug pa las tshe dpag med lhung bzed bsnams pa'i mngon rtogs dang 'brel pa'i tshe dbang la bsdus pa paṇa chen nags rin nas brgyud pa sogs kyang yod par grags mod ma thos la/ 'dir sgra mi snyan pa'i rang gzungs zhes yongs grags lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i sngags dang*/ rang lus lcags kyi rdo rjer bsgom pa'i zhal shes dang bcas zhib par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ lha'i dge bsnyen/ dgra bcom pa blo gros dpal/ lo stong bzhugs/ bal po ha ngu tsand+ra/ lo lnga brgya bzhugs/ slob dpon dar ma grags/ lo nyis brgya thub/ mnga' ris pa dpal chen rgyal ba grub/ lo brgyad cur slebs nas kyang lus stobs chung du ma song zer/ slob dpon ye shes lo sum brgya thub/ rgyal po/ slob dpon shes lo nyis brgya lon nas lha sa lan gsum bskor/ rab grags/ dzñā na siddhi/ slob dpon tshad ma'i skyes bu'i gcen yin/ bla ma sangs rgyas grags/ rdo rje rin chen/ bka' bzhi pa dpal ldan grags pa/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/ paṇa chen shāka mchog spyang lung gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun grol mchog bar 'dir bla ma 'ga' zhig ma rnyed/
