de nas bka' drin mnyam med rdo rje 'chang bkra shis bzang po/ des bdag bande tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas las kyang sngon gyi lo rgyus dang bcas pa yod pa'i sngags la zhwa lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang pos zhus dag mdzad pa'i steng nas thob kyang de'i brgyud pa slar btsal dgos// ༈ //lus bsrung ba'i man ngag ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thugs sras rin po che yan gong ltar la/ de nas rje bkra shis rin chen/ ngor pa rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs sa lo/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ de dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen bsod nams dpal ldan/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na dkon mchog lhun grub las thar rtse pas gsan pa man 'dra// ༈ //gnyis pa padma'i rigs kyi bdag po ni spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ste/ de'ang kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i bya rgyud padma'i rigs kyi 'phags pa thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal lha so bdun ma'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha des lha btsun pa byang chub 'od/ bshes gnyen 'brom ston pa/ rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje gsum la gnang ba las/ 'dir 'brom ston pa/ spyan snga rin po che/ bshes gnyen bya yul ba/ mus sman pa/ snar thang pa dpal ldan gro mo che/ spyil bo pa stag ston shes rab 'od zer/ dmar ston bsod nams 'phel/ slob dpon grags 'bum/ don zhabs sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhan chen grags pa tshul khrims/ mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po/

mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ dbon kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba kun dga' chos grags/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ sku dbon ngag dbang mkhyen brtse rab brtan/ mchod dpon kun dga' rab brtan/ des rjes su bzung ba lho drung chos rje tshul khrims dbang phyug des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //padma'i rigs kyi bdag po 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa dpal mo lugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ paṇḍi ta zla ba gzhon nu/ ye shes bzang po/ bal po pe nya ba/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ grub thob nyi phug pa chos kyi grags pa/ spru pa rdo rje rgyal po/ zhang ston dgra 'jigs/ mkhan chen rtsi 'dul ba thugs rje byang chub/ 'dzin pa bde ba can pa/ chu bzang pa byang chub 'bar/ rin po che shes rab 'bum/ rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal/ bla ma buddha shrī/ khyab bdag kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje btsun brang ti pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhas btsun kun dga' legs pa/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// lhun grub dpal ldan pa las kyang tshul khrims lhun grub pas gsan pa yin pas de pa'i gsan yul gang yin brtag/ ༈ //'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge la brten nas dpal mo lugs kyi 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal gtso 'khor lnga'i rjes su gnang ba dang*/

rje mchog legs rdo rjes mdzad pa'i smyung gnas kyi cho ga rjes gnang yi ge'i lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po/ dngos grub brnyes pa'i dge slong ma dpal mo/ paṇḍi ta tsand+ra ku mā ra/ paṇḍi ta shrī dzñā na bha dra/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta pe nya ba/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ grub thob nyi phug pa chos kyi grags pa/ spru pa rdo rje rgyal po/ zhang ston dgra 'jigs/ mkhan chen rtsi 'dul ba thugs rje byang chub/ mkhan chen bde ba can pa/ byang sems chu bzang pa byang chub 'bar/ rin po che shes rab 'bum pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa bzang po dpal/ grub chen buddhā shrī/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ rmor pa grub chen kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rgyal sras thogs med nas/ gnyags dbon bsod nams bzang po/ 'phags pa bsod nams dar/ 'phags chen kun dga' bzang po/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub man 'dra'o// ༈ //dge slong ma dpal mo lugs kyi smyung gnas kyi cho ga rgyal sras thogs med pas mdzad pa dang dkon mchog dpal ldan pas mdzad pa gnyis kyi cho ga'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ grub mchog dge slong dpal mo/ paṇa chen zla ba gzhon nu/ paṇa chen ye shes bzang po/ paṇa chen bal po pe nya ba/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ grub thob nyi phug pa chos kyi grags pa/ spru pa rdo rje rgyal po/ zhang dgra 'jigs pa/ mkhan chen rtsi 'dul ba/ bde ba can pa/ byang sems chu bzang pa chen po/ chos rje shes rab 'bum/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ grub chen buddha shrī/
sa bzang 'phags pa/ kun spangs chos rin/

rdo rje 'chang gis sa bzang 'phags pa las gsan pas kun spangs ma bcug kyang chog go/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ byang sems bsod nams rin chen/ mus chen/ mkhas grub dpal rdor ba/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje btsun bsod nams dbang phyug rnams gang rung gis kyang 'thus/ thams cad bcug kyang byin rlabs che/ yongs 'dzin sangs rin/ bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge mkhas grub grags pa blo gros dang*/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub gang rung*/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge 'dren mchog blo gros chos 'phags/ rje kun dga' lung rigs/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen kun dga' tshul khrims/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ 'dren mchog bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ rgyal ba'i sras chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// gzhan yang bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan pas mdzad pa dang*/ rje kun dga' lung rigs pas mdzad pa'i smyung gnas kyi cho ga rnams kyi lung ni/ bla ma gzhan dang gzhan so so nas thob kyang so so'i brgyud pa btsal dgos/ gnyags dbon bsod nams bzang pos mdzad pa'i smyung gnas bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar gyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gnyags dbon bsod nams bzang po/ 'phags mchog bsod nams dar/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgya mtsho nas rim par/ mkhan chen brag ston pa/ bla ma shākya rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon nam mkha' dpal 'byor/ rje dam pa rin po che/ smra dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ grub dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas btsun sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas 'phags pa don yod zhags pa lha lnga'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ e ra pa ti/ rigs ngan gyi rnal 'byor ma/

paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ rje btsun lho pa/ zhang nyi phug pa chos kyi grags pa/ drang pho lung pa grags tshul/ skyu ra mkhan po rgyal mtshan mgon/ slob dpon bsod nams grub/ dge bshes kun dga' tshul khrims/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ don zhabs pa sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhan chen shes rab mgon/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na ngor chen nas/ gu ge paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ smra ba'i nyi ma kun dga' bsod nams/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po man 'dra'o// ༈ //spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa sa lugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ bsod nams skyabs/ gzungs kyi dpal/ dpal tshul ba/ shar chen ye rgyal/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen dkon rgyal/ kun mkhyen bsod seng*/ rje ratna wardha/ rje lha mchog pa/ buddha singha*/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang pa/ mkhas dbang dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ bla ma dam pa kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ de las bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis mnos so// shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas kyis/

shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis la'ang gsan no// skyer sgang pa'i brgyud pa ltar na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ grub chen rā hu la/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho lo tsā ba/ phyag sor ba/ shes tshul ba/ lce sgom pa/ skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston pa/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ shangs ston pa/ khyung po tshul mgon/ ras chen sangs rgyas seng ge shangs dkar ba rin chen/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ grub chen nam rgyal/ rgya sgom legs rgyal/ dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang chen po dkon gsang sngags gsar rnying gi sngags 'chang*/ mchog legs 'dzin/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub man gong dang 'dra'o// ༈ //'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ de'i rjes gnang gi chings sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ltar las ma ṇi'i rjes zlos brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du byed pa'i rjes su gnang ba snyan brgyud kyi tshul du bzhugs pa thob pa'i brgyud pa'ang kun dga' legs pa yan chad gtso 'khor gsum pa ji lta ba bzhin yin la/ de nas 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des rjes su bzung ba bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis thob bo// yang na kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag la stsal to// 'di dang spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs tshigs su bcad pa mdo khams shar phyogs mar grags pa rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung yang thob cing 'di gnyis sgrub thabs brgyud tshul bcas gcig pa nyid do// ༈ //mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ stong ra kun dga' legs grub kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rigs gtad thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

'phags pa thugs rje chen po/ grub chen rā hu la gupta badzra/ jo bo dī paṃ kā ra shrī dzñā na/ nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba shes rab 'bar/ wa yu ba shes rab tshul khrims/ lce sgom shes rab rdo rje/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge gnyan ston sbas pa'i chos kyi shes rab/ rnal 'byor/ chos rje rngog brtson 'grus mkhas grub shangs ston yang zer/ seng ge 'gro mgon shangs ston tshul khrims 'bum/ gnyan ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ sngags 'chang rdo rje gzhon nu/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'dren mchog ratna wardha/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ mkhyen rab ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas ston pa/ grub thob a seng*/ gser gling pa bkra shis dpal/ rdo rje dpal ba/ chos dpal shes rab/ grags pa 'byung gnas/ lo pa tshul dar/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ mchog legs rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas ston pa/ shangs ston pa/ rgyal mtshan 'bum/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal/ gser gling pa byams pa dpal/ smon lam dbang phyug bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ shes rab bzang po/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ lo pa ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra/ yang nye brgyud ni/ thugs rje chen po mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge ratna wardha man 'dra/ mus chen gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i lung yang thob/ yang na shangs ston nas/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal bzang*/ 'jag pa blo gros dpal bzang*/ 'jag chen kun dga'/ rje chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/

kun mkhyen shākya don grub man 'dra'o// ༈ //'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun seng ge sgra/ slob dpon tsand+ra go mī/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ jo bo nā ro ta pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ asthu la badzra/ bha ro phyag rdum/ mañdza gling pa thugs rje chen po'ang zer/ de gnyis ka las mal lo tsā bas gsan/ de las sa skya pa chen pos gsan/ gnyan gtsug tor/ de'i nye gnas/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ shar pa ye shes 'byung gnas/ shar pa dus 'khor pa/ ye shes rin chen/ kun dga' byang chub/ mkhan po rgyal bzang pa/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje lha mchog seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ 'dren pa brang ti mkhas pa/ rje dpal ldan don grub/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ rje mkhas btsun dam pa kun dga' legs pa/ mkhan po chen po buddha lakṣ+mī/ 'dren mchog shes bya bzang po/ mkhyen brtse'i gter chen bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos lcags ri las mi 'da' ba bcu gsum gyi steng du gcig bsnan pa'i klu pa'i gser chos bcu bzhir grags pa'i ya gyal seng ge sgra'i ngag bsrung 'grol gyi man ngag shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug myong bas thon pa'i lung man ngag dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa seng ge slob dpon dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa mya ngan med pa/ paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ bla chen yar sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/

mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mchod dpon drung pa dkon mchog pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag padma phrin las/ 'phags mchog ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// gser chos tshe dpag med sprul sku'i brgyud pa ni gong du song*// ༈ //dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i lugs kyi gsang sgrub skor gsum gyi nang tshan spyan ras gzigs gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu/ mtshan ldan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ byang sems sbyin pa bzang po/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ brgyud 'dzin blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub dpal ldan dar po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang bstan pa rab rgyas/ mang thos bsod nams chos 'phel/ grub thob sangs rgyas bstan pa/ thugs sras sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis thob bo// ༈ //thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas mig gsal byed dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyang ston sgrub pos lho brag mkhar chu'i gter nas bton pa/ gter ston dngos kyi rtsa ba dang*/ des skabs don gsum gyi gsal byed shrī bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes sbyar ba brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ padma 'byung gnas/ nyang ston sgrub pa po/ 'gro mgon shākya bzang po/ ngag gi dbang po/ bkra shis rnam rgyal/ dkon mchog dpal 'byor/ rig 'dzin padma'i mtshan can/ blo bzang don grub/ de nas bla ma gnyis tsam btsal/ yang na gnas gsar ba kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ chos rje bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ chos rje bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ des bdag la'o// yang na kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas nas/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho/ de las bdag gis thos so// ༈ //gsum pa padma'i rigs kyi yum ni sgrol ma la sogs pa ste/ 'di bla med du gtogs par bzhed kyang 'dir mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung blang dgos pa dang sde tshan gcig tu gzhag pa'i phyir rta mchog gi rigs sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud nas gsungs shing gnyan lo tsā bas spyan drangs pa'i dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi thugs dam gnyan gyi sgrol ma yan lag drug pa'i rjes su gnang ba thun mong ma yin pa mtshan brgya'i lung dang bcas pa/ de'i yig cha ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ba linta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ dpal bde ba/ dri med sbas pa/ ratna badzra/ ratna kīrti/ bar 'dir bande ba chen po 'byung ba'ang yod/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ grags pa gzhon nu/ bsod nams grags pa/ grags pa tshul khrims/ thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ rgyal bzang ba/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dbang*/ dkon mchog 'phel/ lha mchog seng ge sangs rgyas seng ge 'dren mchog kun dga' lung rigs/

nub dgon pa sbyin pa grags/ sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa rje rgyal rtse ba/ dpal sa skya pa chen po grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ bdag po rgyal rtse ba/ rje 'dis shes rab 'byung gnas las kyang gsan no// byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dbu mdzad kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bka' drin can rje btsun bkra shis bzang po/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na dkon mchog 'phel ba nas/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ lha mchog seng ge man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyu 'gul paṇa chen/ glo bo legs 'byung*/ 'jam dbyangs sa lo/ dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// rje btsun rin po che grags pas mdzad pa'i 'di'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug dang ldan pa'i brgyud pa ni sa skya bka' 'bum gyi brgyud pa ltar ro// ༈ //dam pa'i phyag len ltar padma'i rigs kyi yum seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma gtso rkyang gi rjes su gnang ba lung gsum gyi chings ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma/ dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ chung ba don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa/ sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi ta/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab rdo rje 'chang*/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ sems dpa' chen po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/

ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha bshes gnyen 'brom ston pa/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ bya 'chad kha ba ye shes rdo rje/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ ze'u sku mched/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ kun mkhyen rong ston chen po/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog stag lung pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ de dbon ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po man 'dra'o// seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma gtso 'khor
